flavorText.red-blue: A strange seed was planted on its back at birth. The plant sprouts and grows with this POKéMON.
flavorText.yellow: It can go for days without eating a single morsel. In the bulb on its back, it stores energy.
flavorText.gold-silver: The seed on its back is filled with nutrients. The seed grows steadily larger as its body grows.
flavorText.crystal: While it is young, it uses the nutrients that are stored in the seeds on its back in order to grow.
flavorText.ruby-sapphire: BULBASAUR can be seen napping in bright sunlight. There is a seed on its back. By soaking up the sun’s rays, the seed grows progressively larger.
flavorText.emerald: BULBASAUR can be seen napping in bright sunlight. There is a seed on its back. By soaking up the sun’s rays, the seed grows progressively larger.
flavorText.firered-leafgreen: There is a plant seed on its back right from the day this POKéMON is born. The seed slowly grows larger.
flavorText.diamond-pearl: For some time after its birth, it grows by gaining nourishment from the seed on its back.
flavorText.platinum: For some time after its birth, it grows by gaining nourishment from the seed on its back.
flavorText.heartgold-soulsilver: The seed on its back is filled with nutrients. The seed grows steadily larger as its body grows.

flavorText.red-blue: When the bulb on its back grows large, it appears to lose the ability to stand on its hind legs.
flavorText.yellow: The bulb on its back grows by drawing energy. It gives off an aroma when it is ready to bloom.
flavorText.gold-silver: Exposure to sun light adds to its strength. Sunlight also makes the bud on its back grow larger.
flavorText.crystal: The bulb on its back grows as it absorbs nutrients. The bulb gives off a pleasant aroma when it blooms.
flavorText.ruby-sapphire: There is a bud on this POKéMON’s back. To support its weight, IVYSAUR’s legs and trunk grow thick and strong. If it starts spending more time lying in the sunlight, it’s a sign that the bud will bloom into a large flower soon.
flavorText.emerald: To support its bulb, IVYSAUR’s legs grow sturdy. If it spends more time lying in the sunlight, the bud will soon bloom into a large flower.
flavorText.firered-leafgreen: There is a plant bulb on its back. When it absorbs nutrients, the bulb is said to blossom into a large flower.
flavorText.diamond-pearl: When the bud on its back starts swelling, a sweet aroma wafts to indicate the flower’s coming bloom.
flavorText.platinum: When the bud on its back starts swelling, a sweet aroma wafts to indicate the flower’s coming bloom.
flavorText.heartgold-soulsilver: Exposure to sunlight adds to its strength. Sunlight also makes the bud on its back grow larger.
flavorText.black-white: When the bud on its back starts swelling, a sweet aroma wafts to indicate the flower’s coming bloom.
flavorText.black-2-white-2: When the bud on its back starts swelling, a sweet aroma wafts to indicate the flower’s coming bloom.

flavorText.lets-go-pikachu-eevee: The bud on its back grows by drawing energy. It gives off an aroma when it is ready to bloom.
flavorText.sword-shield: When the bulb on its back grows large, it appears to lose the ability to stand on its hind legs.

flavorText.red-blue: The plant blooms when it is absorbing solar energy. It stays on the move to seek sunlight.
flavorText.yellow: The flower on its back catches the sun's rays. The sunlight is then absorbed and used for energy.
flavorText.gold-silver: By spreading the broad petals of its flower and catching the sun's rays, it fills its body with power.
flavorText.crystal: As it warms it self and absorbs the sunlight, its flower petals release a pleasant fragrance.
flavorText.ruby-sapphire: There is a large flower on VENUSAUR’s back. The flower is said to take on vivid colors if it gets plenty of nutrition and sunlight. The flower’s aroma soothes the emotions of people.
flavorText.emerald: VENUSAUR’s flower is said to take on vivid colors if it gets plenty of nutrition and sunlight. The flower’s aroma soothes the emotions of people.
flavorText.firered-leafgreen: A bewitching aroma wafts from its flower. The fragrance becalms those engaged in a battle.
flavorText.diamond-pearl: After a rainy day, the flower on its back smells stronger. The scent attracts other Pokémon.
flavorText.platinum: After a rainy day, the flower on its back smells stronger. The scent attracts other Pokémon.
flavorText.heartgold-soulsilver: By spreading the broad petals of its flower and catching the sun’s rays, it fills its body with power.
flavorText.black-white: After a rainy day, the flower on its back smells stronger. The scent attracts other Pokémon.
flavorText.black-2-white-2: After a rainy day, the flower on its back smells stronger. The scent attracts other Pokémon.

flavorText.lets-go-pikachu-eevee: The flower on its back catches the sun’s rays. The sunlight is then absorbed and used for energy.
flavorText.sword-shield: Its plant blooms when it is absorbing solar energy. It stays on the move to seek sunlight.

flavorText.red-blue: Obviously prefers hot places. When it rains, steam is said to spout from the tip of its tail.
flavorText.yellow: The flame at the tip of its tail makes a sound as it burns. You can only hear it in quiet places.
flavorText.gold-silver: The flame on its tail shows the strength of its life force. If it is weak, the flame also burns weakly.
flavorText.crystal: If it's healthy, the flame on the tip of its tail will burn vigor ously, even if it gets a bit wet.
flavorText.ruby-sapphire: The flame that burns at the tip of its tail is an indication of its emotions. The flame wavers when CHARMANDER is enjoying itself. If the POKéMON becomes enraged, the flame burns fiercely.
flavorText.emerald: The flame that burns at the tip of its tail is an indication of its emotions. The flame wavers when CHARMANDER is happy, and blazes when it is enraged.
flavorText.firered-leafgreen: From the time it is born, a flame burns at the tip of its tail. Its life would end if the flame were to go out.
flavorText.diamond-pearl: The fire on the tip of its tail is a measure of its life. If healthy, its tail burns intensely.
flavorText.platinum: The fire on the tip of its tail is a measure of its life. If healthy, its tail burns intensely.
flavorText.heartgold-soulsilver: The flame on its tail shows the strength of its life force. If it is weak, the flame also burns weakly.
flavorText.black-white: The fire on the tip of its tail is a measure of its life. If healthy, its tail burns intensely.
flavorText.black-2-white-2: The fire on the tip of its tail is a measure of its life. If healthy, its tail burns intensely.
flavorText.x-y: The flame on its tail indicates Charmander’s life force. If it is healthy, the flame burns brightly.
flavorText.omega-ruby-alpha-sapphire: The flame that burns at the tip of its tail is an indication of its emotions. The flame wavers when Charmander is enjoying itself. If the Pokémon becomes enraged, the flame burns fiercely.
flavorText.lets-go-pikachu-eevee: The flame at the tip of its tail makes a sound as it burns. You can only hear it in quiet places.
flavorText.sword-shield: It has a preference for hot things. When it rains, steam is said to spout from the tip of its tail.

flavorText.red-blue: When it swings its burning tail, it elevates the temperature to unbearably high levels.
flavorText.yellow: Tough fights could excite this POKéMON. When excited, it may blow out bluish- white flames.
flavorText.gold-silver: It is very hot headed by nature, so it constantly seeks opponents. It calms down only when it wins.
flavorText.crystal: If it becomes agitated during battle, it spouts intense flames, incinerating its surroundings.
flavorText.ruby-sapphire: CHARMELEON mercilessly destroys its foes using its sharp claws. If it encounters a strong foe, it turns aggressive. In this excited state, the flame at the tip of its tail flares with a bluish white color.
flavorText.emerald: Without pity, its sharp claws destroy foes. If it encounters a strong enemy, it becomes agitated, and the flame on its tail flares with a bluish white color.
flavorText.firered-leafgreen: It lashes about with its tail to knock down its foe. It then tears up the fallen opponent with sharp claws.
flavorText.diamond-pearl: In the rocky mountains where CHARMELEON live, their fiery tails shine at night like stars.
flavorText.platinum: In the rocky mountains where CHARMELEON live, their fiery tails shine at night like stars.
flavorText.heartgold-soulsilver: It is very hotheaded by nature, so it constantly seeks opponents. It calms down only when it wins.
flavorText.black-white: In the rocky mountains where Charmeleon live, their fiery tails shine at night like stars.
flavorText.black-2-white-2: In the rocky mountains where Charmeleon live, their fiery tails shine at night like stars.
flavorText.x-y: It lashes about with its tail to knock down its foe. It then tears up the fallen opponent with sharp claws.
flavorText.omega-ruby-alpha-sapphire: Charmeleon mercilessly destroys its foes using its sharp claws. If it encounters a strong foe, it turns aggressive. In this excited state, the flame at the tip of its tail flares with a bluish white color.
flavorText.lets-go-pikachu-eevee: Tough fights could excite this Pokémon. When excited, it may breathe out bluish-white flames.
flavorText.sword-shield: It has a barbaric nature. In battle, it whips its fiery tail around and slashes away with sharp claws.

flavorText.black-white: It is said that Charizard’s fire burns hotter if it has experienced harsh battles.
flavorText.red-blue: Spits fire that is hot enough to melt boulders. Known to cause forest fires unintentionally.
flavorText.yellow: When expelling a blast of super hot fire, the red flame at the tip of its tail burns more intensely.
flavorText.gold-silver: If CHARIZARD be comes furious, the flame at the tip of its tail flares up in a whitish- blue color.
flavorText.crystal: It uses its wings to fly high. The temperature of its fire increases as it gains exper ience in battle.
flavorText.ruby-sapphire: CHARIZARD flies around the sky in search of powerful opponents. It breathes fire of such great heat that it melts anything. However, it never turns its fiery breath on any opponent weaker than itself.
flavorText.emerald: A CHARIZARD flies about in search of strong opponents. It breathes intense flames that can melt any material. However, it will never torch a weaker foe.
flavorText.firered-leafgreen: Its wings can carry this POKéMON close to an altitude of 4,600 feet. It blows out fire at very high temperatures.
flavorText.diamond-pearl: It is said that CHARIZARD’s fire burns hotter if it has experienced harsh battles.
flavorText.platinum: It is said that CHARIZARD’s fire burns hotter if it has experienced harsh battles.
flavorText.heartgold-soulsilver: If CHARIZARD becomes furious, the flame at the tip of its tail flares up in a light blue shade.
flavorText.black-2-white-2: It is said that Charizard’s fire burns hotter if it has experienced harsh battles.
flavorText.x-y: When expelling a blast of superhot fire, the red flame at the tip of its tail burns more intensely.
flavorText.omega-ruby-alpha-sapphire: Charizard flies around the sky in search of powerful opponents. It breathes fire of such great heat that it melts anything. However, it never turns its fiery breath on any opponent weaker than itself.
flavorText.lets-go-pikachu-eevee: When this Pokémon expels a blast of superhot fire, the red flame at the tip of its tail burns more intensely.
flavorText.sword-shield: It spits fire that is hot enough to melt boulders. It may cause forest fires by blowing flames.

flavorText.red-blue: After birth, its back swells and hardens into a shell. Powerfully sprays foam from its mouth.
flavorText.yellow: Shoots water at prey while in the water. Withdraws into its shell when in danger.
flavorText.gold-silver: The shell is soft when it is born. It soon becomes so resilient, prod ding fingers will bounce off it.
flavorText.crystal: When it feels threatened, it draws its legs inside its shell and sprays water from its mouth.
flavorText.ruby-sapphire: SQUIRTLE’s shell is not merely used for protection. The shell’s rounded shape and the grooves on its surface help minimize resistance in water, enabling this POKéMON to swim at high speeds.
flavorText.emerald: Its shell is not just for protection. Its rounded shape and the grooves on its surface minimize resistance in water, enabling SQUIRTLE to swim at high speeds.
flavorText.firered-leafgreen: When it retracts its long neck into its shell, it squirts out water with vigorous force.
flavorText.diamond-pearl: It shelters itself in its shell, then strikes back with spouts of water at every opportunity.
flavorText.platinum: It shelters itself in its shell, then strikes back with spouts of water at every opportunity.
flavorText.heartgold-soulsilver: The shell is soft when it is born. It soon becomes so resilient, prodding fingers will bounce off it.
flavorText.black-white: It shelters itself in its shell, then strikes back with spouts of water at every opportunity.
flavorText.black-2-white-2: It shelters itself in its shell then strikes back with spouts of water at every opportunity.
flavorText.x-y: It shelters itself in its shell, then strikes back with spouts of water at every opportunity.
flavorText.omega-ruby-alpha-sapphire: Squirtle’s shell is not merely used for protection. The shell’s rounded shape and the grooves on its surface help minimize resistance in water, enabling this Pokémon to swim at high speeds.
flavorText.lets-go-pikachu-eevee: Shoots water at prey while in the water. Withdraws into its shell when in danger.
flavorText.sword-shield: When it retracts its long neck into its shell, it squirts out water with vigorous force.

flavorText.red-blue: Often hides in water to stalk unwary prey. For swimming fast, it moves its ears to maintain balance.
flavorText.yellow: When tapped, this POKéMON will pull in its head, but its tail will still stick out a little bit.
flavorText.gold-silver: It is recognized as a symbol of longevity. If its shell has algae on it, that WARTORTLE is very old.
flavorText.crystal: Its long, furry tail is a symbol of longevity, making it quite popular among older people.
flavorText.ruby-sapphire: Its tail is large and covered with a rich, thick fur. The tail becomes increasingly deeper in color as WARTORTLE ages. The scratches on its shell are evidence of this POKéMON’s toughness as a battler.
flavorText.emerald: Its large tail is covered with rich, thick fur that deepens in color with age. The scratches on its shell are evidence of this POKéMON’s toughness in battle.
flavorText.firered-leafgreen: This POKéMON is very popular as a pet. Its fur-covered tail is a symbol of its longevity.
flavorText.diamond-pearl: It is said to live 10,000 years. Its furry tail is popular as a symbol of longevity.
flavorText.platinum: It is said to live 10,000 years. Its furry tail is popular as a symbol of longevity.
flavorText.heartgold-soulsilver: It is a well-established symbol of longevity. If its shell has algae on it, that WARTORTLE is very old.
flavorText.black-white: It is said to live 10,000 years. Its furry tail is popular as a symbol of longevity.
flavorText.black-2-white-2: It is said to live 10,000 years. Its furry tail is popular as a symbol of longevity.
flavorText.x-y: When tapped, this Pokémon will pull in its head, but its tail will still stick out a little bit.
flavorText.omega-ruby-alpha-sapphire: Its tail is large and covered with a rich, thick fur. The tail becomes increasingly deeper in color as Wartortle ages. The scratches on its shell are evidence of this Pokémon’s toughness as a battler.
flavorText.lets-go-pikachu-eevee: When tapped on its head, this Pokémon will pull it in, but its tail will still stick out a little bit.
flavorText.sword-shield: It is recognized as a symbol of longevity. If its shell has algae on it, that Wartortle is very old.

flavorText.red-blue: A brutal POKéMON with pressurized water jets on its shell. They are used for high speed tackles.
flavorText.yellow: Once it takes aim at its enemy, it blasts out water with even more force than a fire hose.
flavorText.gold-silver: It deliberately makes itself heavy so it can with stand the recoil of the water jets it fires.
flavorText.crystal: It firmly plants its feet on the ground before shooting water from the jets on its back.
flavorText.ruby-sapphire: BLASTOISE has water spouts that protrude from its shell. The water spouts are very accurate. They can shoot bullets of water with enough accuracy to strike empty cans from a distance of over 160 feet.
flavorText.emerald: The waterspouts that protrude from its shell are highly accurate. Their bullets of water can precisely nail tin cans from a distance of over 160 feet.
flavorText.firered-leafgreen: It crushes its foe under its heavy body to cause fainting. In a pinch, it will withdraw inside its shell.
flavorText.diamond-pearl: The jets of water it spouts from the rocket cannons on its shell can punch through thick steel.
flavorText.platinum: The jets of water it spouts from the rocket cannons on its shell can punch through thick steel.
flavorText.heartgold-soulsilver: It deliberately makes itself heavy so it can withstand the recoil of the water jets it fires.
flavorText.black-white: The jets of water it spouts from the rocket cannons on its shell can punch through thick steel.
flavorText.black-2-white-2: The jets of water it spouts from the rocket cannons on its shell can punch through thick steel.
flavorText.x-y: It crushes its foe under its heavy body to cause fainting. In a pinch, it will withdraw inside its shell.
flavorText.omega-ruby-alpha-sapphire: Blastoise has water spouts that protrude from its shell. The water spouts are very accurate. They can shoot bullets of water with enough accuracy to strike empty cans from a distance of over 160 feet.
flavorText.lets-go-pikachu-eevee: Once it takes aim at its enemy, it blasts out water with even more force than a fire hose.
flavorText.sword-shield: It crushes its foe under its heavy body to cause fainting. In a pinch, it will withdraw inside its shell.

flavorText.red-blue: Its short feet are tipped with suction pads that enable it to tirelessly climb slopes and walls.
flavorText.yellow: If you touch the feeler on top of its head, it will release a horrible stink to protect itself.
flavorText.gold-silver: For protection, it releases a horri ble stench from the antenna on its head to drive away enemies.
flavorText.crystal: It crawls into foliage where it camouflages itself among leaves that are the same color as its body.
flavorText.ruby-sapphire: CATERPIE has a voracious appetite. It can devour leaves bigger than its body right before your eyes. From its antenna, this POKéMON releases a terrifically strong odor.
flavorText.emerald: Its voracious appetite compels it to devour leaves bigger than itself without hesitation. It releases a terribly strong odor from its antennae.
flavorText.firered-leafgreen: It is covered with a green skin. When it grows, it sheds the skin, covers itself with silk, and becomes a cocoon.
flavorText.diamond-pearl: It releases a stench from its red antenna to repel enemies. It grows by molting repeatedly.
flavorText.platinum: It releases a stench from its red antenna to repel enemies. It grows by molting repeatedly.
flavorText.heartgold-soulsilver: For protection, it releases a horrible stench from the antennae on its head to drive away enemies.
flavorText.black-white: It releases a stench from its red antenna to repel enemies. It grows by molting repeatedly.
flavorText.black-2-white-2: It releases a stench from its red antenna to repel enemies. It grows by molting repeatedly.
flavorText.x-y: For protection, it releases a horrible stench from the antennae on its head to drive away enemies.
flavorText.omega-ruby-alpha-sapphire: Caterpie has a voracious appetite. It can devour leaves bigger than its body right before your eyes. From its antenna, this Pokémon releases a terrifically strong odor.
flavorText.sun-moon: When attacked by bird Pokémon, it resists by releasing a terrifically strong odor from its antennae, but it often becomes their prey.
flavorText.ultra-sun-ultra-moon: Perhaps because it would like to grow up quickly, it has a voracious appetite, eating a hundred leaves a day.
flavorText.lets-go-pikachu-eevee: If you touch the feeler on top of its head, it will release a horrible stink to protect itself.
flavorText.sword-shield: For protection, it releases a horrible stench from the antenna on its head to drive away enemies.

flavorText.red-blue: This POKéMON is vulnerable to attack while its shell is soft, exposing its weak and tender body.
flavorText.yellow: Hardens its shell to protect itself. However, a large impact may cause it to pop out of its shell.
flavorText.gold-silver: Inside the shell, it is soft and weak as it pre pares to evolve. It stays motion less in the shell.
flavorText.crystal: This is its pre- evolved form. At this stage, it can only harden, so it remains motionless to avoid attack.
flavorText.ruby-sapphire: The shell covering this POKéMON’s body is as hard as an iron slab. METAPOD does not move very much. It stays still because it is preparing its soft innards for evolution inside the hard shell.
flavorText.emerald: Its shell is as hard as an iron slab. A METAPOD does not move very much because it is preparing its soft innards for evolution inside the shell.
flavorText.firered-leafgreen: Even though it is encased in a sturdy shell, the body inside is tender. It can’t withstand a harsh attack.
flavorText.diamond-pearl: A steel-hard shell protects its tender body. It quietly endures hardships while awaiting evolution.
flavorText.platinum: A steel-hard shell protects its tender body. It quietly endures hardships while awaiting evolution.
flavorText.heartgold-soulsilver: Inside the shell, it is soft and weak as it prepares to evolve. It stays motionless in the shell.
flavorText.black-white: A steel-hard shell protects its tender body. It quietly endures hardships while awaiting evolution.
flavorText.black-2-white-2: A steel-hard shell protects its tender body. It quietly endures hardships while awaiting evolution.
flavorText.x-y: A steel-hard shell protects its tender body. It quietly endures hardships while awaiting evolution.
flavorText.omega-ruby-alpha-sapphire: The shell covering this Pokémon’s body is as hard as an iron slab. Metapod does not move very much. It stays still because it is preparing its soft innards for evolution inside the hard shell.
flavorText.sun-moon: Its shell is filled with its soft innards. It doesn’t move much because of the risk it might carelessly spill its innards out.
flavorText.ultra-sun-ultra-moon: Its shell is filled with a thick liquid. All of the cells throughout its body are being rebuilt in preparation for evolution.
flavorText.lets-go-pikachu-eevee: Hardens its shell to protect itself. However, a large impact may cause it to pop out of its shell.
flavorText.sword-shield: It is waiting for the moment to evolve. At this stage, it can only harden, so it remains motionless to avoid attack.

flavorText.red-blue: In battle, it flaps its wings at high speed to release highly toxic dust into the air.
flavorText.yellow: Its wings, covered with poisonous powders, repel water. This allows it to fly in the rain.
flavorText.gold-silver: It collects honey every day. It rubs honey onto the hairs on its legs to carry it back to its nest.
flavorText.crystal: It flits from flower to flower, collecting honey. It can even identify distant flowers in bloom.
flavorText.ruby-sapphire: BUTTERFREE has a superior ability to search for delicious honey from flowers. It can even search out, extract, and carry honey from flowers that are blooming over six miles from its nest.
flavorText.emerald: It has a superior ability to search for delicious honey from flowers. It can seek, extract, and carry honey from flowers blooming over six miles away.
flavorText.firered-leafgreen: The wings are protected by rain-repellent dust. As a result, this POKéMON can fly about even in rain.
flavorText.diamond-pearl: It loves the honey of flowers and can locate flower patches that have even tiny amounts of pollen.
flavorText.platinum: It loves the honey of flowers and can locate flower patches that have even tiny amounts of pollen.
flavorText.heartgold-soulsilver: It collects honey every day. It rubs honey onto the hairs on its legs to carry it back to its nest.
flavorText.black-white: It loves the honey of flowers and can locate flower patches that have even tiny amounts of pollen.
flavorText.black-2-white-2: It loves the honey of flowers and can locate flower patches that have even tiny amounts of pollen.
flavorText.x-y: It loves the honey of flowers and can locate flower patches that have even tiny amounts of pollen.
flavorText.omega-ruby-alpha-sapphire: Butterfree has a superior ability to search for delicious honey from flowers. It can even search out, extract, and carry honey from flowers that are blooming over six miles from its nest.
flavorText.sun-moon: Close examination of its large eyes reveals that each eye is composed of a myriad of tiny eyes.
flavorText.ultra-sun-ultra-moon: Its wings are covered in toxic scales. If it finds bird Pokémon going after Caterpie, Butterfree sprinkles its scales on them to drive them off.
flavorText.lets-go-pikachu-eevee: Its wings, covered with poisonous powder, repel water. This allows it to fly in the rain.
flavorText.sword-shield: In battle, it flaps its wings at great speed to release highly toxic dust into the air.

flavorText.red-blue: Often found in forests, eating leaves. It has a sharp venomous stinger on its head.
flavorText.yellow: Beware of the sharp stinger on its head. It hides in grass and bushes where it eats leaves.
flavorText.gold-silver: Its poison stinger is very powerful. Its bright-colored body is intended to warn off its enemies.
flavorText.crystal: The barb on top of its head secretes a strong poison. It uses this toxic barb to protect itself.
flavorText.ruby-sapphire: WEEDLE has an extremely acute sense of smell. It is capable of distinguishing its favorite kinds of leaves from those it dislikes just by sniffing with its big red proboscis (nose).
flavorText.emerald: A WEEDLE has an extremely acute sense of smell. It distinguishes its favorite kinds of leaves from those it dislikes by sniffing with its big red proboscis (nose).
flavorText.firered-leafgreen: Often found in forests and grasslands. It has a sharp, toxic barb of around two inches on top of its head.
flavorText.diamond-pearl: It eats its weight in leaves every day. It fends off attackers with the needle on its head.
flavorText.platinum: It eats its weight in leaves every day. It fends off attackers with the needle on its head.
flavorText.heartgold-soulsilver: Its poison stinger is very powerful. Its bright-colored body is intended to warn off its enemies.
flavorText.black-white: It eats its weight in leaves every day. It fends off attackers with the needle on its head.
flavorText.black-2-white-2: It eats its weight in leaves every day. It fends off attackers with the needle on its head.
flavorText.x-y: Often found in forests and grasslands. It has a sharp, toxic barb of around two inches on top of its head.
flavorText.omega-ruby-alpha-sapphire: Weedle has an extremely acute sense of smell. It is capable of distinguishing its favorite kinds of leaves from those it dislikes just by sniffing with its big red proboscis (nose).
flavorText.lets-go-pikachu-eevee: Beware of the sharp stinger on its head. It hides in grass and bushes where it eats leaves.

flavorText.red-blue: Almost incapable of moving, this POKéMON can only harden its shell to protect itself from predators.
flavorText.yellow: Able to move only slightly. When endangered, it may stick out its stinger and poison its enemy.
flavorText.gold-silver: Although it is a cocoon, it can move a little. It can extend its poison barb if it is attacked.
flavorText.crystal: Nearly incapable of movement, it leans against stout trees while waiting for its evolution.
flavorText.ruby-sapphire: KAKUNA remains virtually immobile as it clings to a tree. However, on the inside, it is extremely busy as it prepares for its coming evolution. This is evident from how hot the shell becomes to the touch.
flavorText.emerald: It remains virtually immobile while it clings to a tree. However, on the inside, it busily prepares for evolution. This is evident from how hot its shell becomes.
flavorText.firered-leafgreen: This POKéMON is in a temporary stage while making its body. It is almost completely unable to move on its own.
flavorText.diamond-pearl: While awaiting evolution, it hides from predators under leaves and in nooks of branches.
flavorText.platinum: While awaiting evolution, it hides from predators under leaves and in nooks of branches.
flavorText.heartgold-soulsilver: Although it is a cocoon, it can move a little. It can extend its poison barb if it is attacked.
flavorText.black-white: While awaiting evolution, it hides from predators under leaves and in nooks of branches.
flavorText.black-2-white-2: While awaiting evolution, it hides from predators under leaves and in nooks of branches.
flavorText.x-y: Almost incapable of moving, this Pokémon can only harden its shell to protect itself when it is in danger.
flavorText.omega-ruby-alpha-sapphire: Kakuna remains virtually immobile as it clings to a tree. However, on the inside, it is extremely busy as it prepares for its coming evolution. This is evident from how hot the shell becomes to the touch.
flavorText.lets-go-pikachu-eevee: Able to move only slightly. When endangered, it may stick out its stinger and poison its enemy.

flavorText.red-blue: Flies at high speed and attacks using its large venomous stingers on its forelegs and tail.
flavorText.yellow: It has 3 poisonous stingers on its forelegs and its tail. They are used to jab its enemy repeatedly.
flavorText.gold-silver: It can take down any opponent with its powerful poi son stingers. It sometimes attacks in swarms.
flavorText.crystal: It uses sharp, poisonous stings to defeat prey, then takes the victim back to its nest for food.
flavorText.ruby-sapphire: BEEDRILL is extremely territorial. No one should ever approach its nest - this is for their own safety. If angered, they will attack in a furious swarm.
flavorText.emerald: A BEEDRILL is extremely territorial. For safety reasons, no one should ever approach its nest. If angered, they will attack in a swarm.
flavorText.firered-leafgreen: May appear in a swarm. Flies at violent speeds, all the while stabbing with the toxic stinger on its rear.
flavorText.diamond-pearl: Its best attack involves flying around at high speed, striking with poison needles, then flying off.
flavorText.platinum: Its best attack involves flying around at high speed, striking with poison needles, then flying off.
flavorText.heartgold-soulsilver: It can take down any opponent with its powerful poison stingers. It sometimes attacks in swarms.
flavorText.black-white: Its best attack involves flying around at high speed, striking with poison needles, then flying off.
flavorText.black-2-white-2: Its best attack involves flying around at high speed, striking with poison needles, then flying off.
flavorText.x-y: It has three poisonous stingers on its forelegs and its tail. They are used to jab its enemy repeatedly.
flavorText.omega-ruby-alpha-sapphire: Beedrill is extremely territorial. No one should ever approach its nest—this is for their own safety. If angered, they will attack in a furious swarm.
flavorText.lets-go-pikachu-eevee: It has three poisonous stingers on its forelegs and its tail. They are used to jab its enemy repeatedly.

flavorText.red-blue: A common sight in forests and woods. It flaps its wings at ground level to kick up blinding sand.
flavorText.yellow: Very docile. If attacked, it will often kick up sand to protect itself rather than fight back.
flavorText.gold-silver: It usually hides in tall grass. Be cause it dislikes fighting, it pro tects itself by kicking up sand.
flavorText.crystal: It rapidly flaps its wings in the grass, stirring up a dust cloud that drives insect prey out into the open.
flavorText.ruby-sapphire: PIDGEY has an extremely sharp sense of direction. It is capable of unerringly returning home to its nest, however far it may be removed from its familiar surroundings.
flavorText.emerald: It has an extremely sharp sense of direction. It can unerringly return home to its nest, however far it may be removed from its familiar surroundings.
flavorText.firered-leafgreen: Does not like to fight. It hides in tall grass and so on, foraging for food such as small bugs.
flavorText.diamond-pearl: It is docile and prefers to avoid conflict. If disturbed, however, it can ferociously strike back.
flavorText.platinum: It is docile and prefers to avoid conflict. If disturbed, however, it can ferociously strike back.
flavorText.heartgold-soulsilver: It usually hides in tall grass. Because it dislikes fighting, it protects itself by kicking up sand.
flavorText.black-white: It is docile and prefers to avoid conflict. If disturbed, however, it can ferociously strike back.
flavorText.black-2-white-2: It is docile and prefers to avoid conflict. If disturbed, however, it can ferociously strike back.
flavorText.x-y: A common sight in forests and woods. It flaps its wings at ground level to kick up blinding sand.
flavorText.omega-ruby-alpha-sapphire: Pidgey has an extremely sharp sense of direction. It is capable of unerringly returning home to its nest, however far it may be removed from its familiar surroundings.
flavorText.lets-go-pikachu-eevee: Very docile. If attacked, it will often kick up sand to protect itself rather than fight back.

flavorText.red-blue: Very protective of its sprawling territorial area, this POKéMON will fiercely peck at any intruder.
flavorText.yellow: This POKéMON is full of vitality. It constantly flies around its large territory in search of prey.
flavorText.gold-silver: It has outstanding vision. However high it flies, it is able to distin guish the move ments of its prey.
flavorText.crystal: It slowly flies in a circular pat tern, all the while keeping a sharp lookout for prey.
flavorText.ruby-sapphire: PIDGEOTTO claims a large area as its own territory. This POKéMON flies around, patrolling its living space. If its territory is violated, it shows no mercy in thoroughly punishing the foe with its sharp claws.
flavorText.emerald: This POKéMON flies around, patrolling its large territory. If its living space is violated, it shows no mercy in thoroughly punishing the foe with its sharp claws.
flavorText.firered-leafgreen: The claws on its feet are well developed. It can carry prey such as an EXEGGCUTE to its nest over 60 miles away.
flavorText.diamond-pearl: It flies over its wide territory in search of prey, downing it with its highly developed claws.
flavorText.platinum: It flies over its wide territory in search of prey, downing it with its highly developed claws.
flavorText.heartgold-soulsilver: It has outstanding vision. However high it flies, it is able to distinguish the movements of its prey.
flavorText.black-white: It flies over its wide territory in search of prey, downing it with its highly developed claws.
flavorText.black-2-white-2: It flies over its wide territory in search of prey, downing it with its highly developed claws.
flavorText.x-y: The claws on its feet are well developed. It can carry prey such as an Exeggcute to its nest over 60 miles away.
flavorText.omega-ruby-alpha-sapphire: Pidgeotto claims a large area as its own territory. This Pokémon flies around, patrolling its living space. If its territory is violated, it shows no mercy in thoroughly punishing the foe with its sharp claws.
flavorText.lets-go-pikachu-eevee: This Pokémon is full of vitality. It constantly flies around its large territory in search of prey.

flavorText.red-blue: When hunting, it skims the surface of water at high speed to pick off unwary prey such as MAGIKARP.
flavorText.yellow: This POKéMON flies at Mach 2 speed, seeking prey. Its large talons are feared as wicked weapons.
flavorText.gold-silver: Its well-developed chest muscles make it strong enough to whip up a gusty windstorm with just a few flaps.
flavorText.crystal: Its outstanding vision allows it to spot splashing MAGIKARP, even while flying at 3300 feet.
flavorText.ruby-sapphire: This POKéMON has a dazzling plumage of beautifully glossy feathers. Many TRAINERS are captivated by the striking beauty of the feathers on its head, compelling them to choose PIDGEOT as their POKéMON.
flavorText.emerald: This POKéMON has gorgeous, glossy feathers. Many TRAINERS are so captivated by the beautiful feathers on its head that they choose PIDGEOT as their POKéMON.
flavorText.firered-leafgreen: It spreads its gorgeous wings widely to intimidate enemies. It races through the skies at Mach-2 speed.
flavorText.diamond-pearl: By flapping its wings with all its might, PIDGEOT can make a gust of wind capable of bending tall trees.
flavorText.platinum: By flapping its wings with all its might, PIDGEOT can make a gust of wind capable of bending tall trees.
flavorText.heartgold-soulsilver: Its well-developed chest muscles make it strong enough to whip up a gusty windstorm with just a few flaps.
flavorText.black-white: By flapping its wings with all its might, Pidgeot can make a gust of wind capable of bending tall trees.
flavorText.black-2-white-2: By flapping its wings with all its might, Pidgeot can make a gust of wind capable of bending tall trees.
flavorText.x-y: When hunting, it skims the surface of water at high speed to pick off unwary prey such as Magikarp.
flavorText.omega-ruby-alpha-sapphire: This Pokémon has a dazzling plumage of beautifully glossy feathers. Many Trainers are captivated by the striking beauty of the feathers on its head, compelling them to choose Pidgeot as their Pokémon.
flavorText.lets-go-pikachu-eevee: This Pokémon flies at Mach 2 speed, seeking prey. Its large talons are feared as wicked weapons.

flavorText.gold-silver: Living wherever there is food available, it ceaselessly scav enges for edibles the entire day.
flavorText.red-blue: Bites anything when it attacks. Small and very quick, it is a common sight in many places.
flavorText.yellow: Will chew on any thing with its fangs. If you see one, it is certain that 40 more live in the area.
flavorText.crystal: This POKéMON's impressive vital ity allows it to live anywhere. It also multiplies very quickly.
flavorText.ruby-sapphire: RATTATA is cautious in the extreme. Even while it is asleep, it constantly listens by moving its ears around. It is not picky about where it lives - it will make its nest anywhere.
flavorText.emerald: A RATTATA is cautious in the extreme. Even while it is asleep, it constantly moves its ears and listens for danger. It will make its nest anywhere.
flavorText.firered-leafgreen: Its fangs are long and very sharp. They grow continuously, so it gnaws on hard things to whittle them down.
flavorText.diamond-pearl: Cautious in the extreme, its hardy vitality lets it live in any kind of environment.
flavorText.platinum: Cautious in the extreme, its hardy vitality lets it live in any kind of environment.
flavorText.heartgold-soulsilver: It eats anything. Wherever food is available, it will settle down and produce offspring continuously.
flavorText.black-white: Cautious in the extreme, its hardy vitality lets it live in any kind of environment.
flavorText.black-2-white-2: It searches for food all day. It gnaws on hard objects to wear down its fangs, which grow constantly during its lifetime.
flavorText.x-y: Living wherever there is food available, it ceaselessly scavenges for edibles the entire day.
flavorText.omega-ruby-alpha-sapphire: Rattata is cautious in the extreme. Even while it is asleep, it constantly listens by moving its ears around. It is not picky about where it lives—it will make its nest anywhere.
flavorText.sun-moon: Its incisors continue growing until its death. If its Trainer doesn’t offer it a file to gnaw on, it will gnaw on door frames, table legs, and so on.
flavorText.ultra-sun-ultra-moon: Its incisors grow continuously throughout its life. If its incisors get too long, this Pokémon becomes unable to eat, and it starves to death.
flavorText.lets-go-pikachu-eevee: Will chew on anything with its fangs. If you see one, you can be certain that 40 more live in the area.

flavorText.red-blue: It uses its whis kers to maintain its balance. It apparently slows down if they are cut off.
flavorText.yellow: Its hind feet are webbed. They act as flippers, so it can swim in rivers and hunt for prey.
flavorText.gold-silver: Gnaws on anything with its tough fangs. It can even topple concrete buildings by gnaw ing on them.
flavorText.crystal: The webs on its hind legs enable it to cross rivers. It search es wide areas for food.
flavorText.ruby-sapphire: RATICATE’s sturdy fangs grow steadily. To keep them ground down, it gnaws on rocks and logs. It may even chew on the walls of houses.
flavorText.emerald: A RATICATE’s sturdy fangs grow steadily. To keep them ground down, it gnaws on rocks and logs. It may even chew on the walls of houses.
flavorText.firered-leafgreen: Its rear feet have three toes each. They are webbed, enabling it to swim across rivers.
flavorText.diamond-pearl: It whittles its constantly growing fangs by gnawing on hard things. It can chew apart cinder walls.
flavorText.platinum: It whittles its constantly growing fangs by gnawing on hard things. It can chew apart cinder walls.
flavorText.heartgold-soulsilver: Gnaws on anything with its tough fangs. It can even topple concrete buildings by gnawing on them.
flavorText.black-white: It whittles its constantly growing fangs by gnawing on hard things. It can chew apart cinder walls.
flavorText.black-2-white-2: With its long fangs, this surprisingly violent Pokémon can gnaw away even thick concrete with ease.
flavorText.x-y: It whittles its constantly growing fangs by gnawing on hard things. It can chew apart cinder walls.
flavorText.omega-ruby-alpha-sapphire: Raticate’s sturdy fangs grow steadily. To keep them ground down, it gnaws on rocks and logs. It may even chew on the walls of houses.
flavorText.sun-moon: Its hind feet are webbed, so it’s a strong swimmer. It can cross rivers and sometimes even oceans.
flavorText.ultra-sun-ultra-moon: People say that it fled from its enemies by using its small webbed hind feet to swim from island to island in Alola.
flavorText.lets-go-pikachu-eevee: Its hind feet are webbed. They act as flippers, so it can swim in rivers and hunt for prey.

flavorText.red-blue: Eats bugs in grassy areas. It has to flap its short wings at high speed to stay airborne.
flavorText.yellow: Inept at flying high. However, it can fly around very fast to protect its ter ritory.
flavorText.gold-silver: It flaps its short wings to flush out insects from tall grass. It then plucks them with its stubby beak.
flavorText.crystal: To protect its territory, it flies around ceaselessly, making high- pitched cries.
flavorText.ruby-sapphire: SPEAROW has a very loud cry that can be heard over half a mile away. If its high, keening cry is heard echoing all around, it is a sign that they are warning each other of danger.
flavorText.emerald: Its loud cry can be heard over half a mile away. If its high, keening cry is heard echoing all around, it is a sign that they are warning each other of danger.
flavorText.firered-leafgreen: It busily flits around here and there. Even if it is frail, it can be a tough foe that uses MIRROR MOVE.
flavorText.diamond-pearl: It flaps its small wings busily to fly. Using its beak, it searches in grass for prey.
flavorText.platinum: It flaps its small wings busily to fly. Using its beak, it searches in grass for prey.
flavorText.heartgold-soulsilver: It flaps its short wings to flush out insects from tall grass. It then plucks them with its stubby beak.
flavorText.black-white: It flaps its small wings busily to fly. Using its beak, it searches in grass for prey.
flavorText.black-2-white-2: It flaps its small wings busily to fly. Using its beak, it searches in grass for prey.
flavorText.x-y: Very protective of its territory, it flaps its short wings busily to dart around at high speed.
flavorText.omega-ruby-alpha-sapphire: Spearow has a very loud cry that can be heard over half a mile away. If its high, keening cry is heard echoing all around, it is a sign that they are warning each other of danger.
flavorText.sun-moon: Its short wings make it inept at flying. It moves about hurriedly and pecks at Bug-type Pokémon in the tall grass.
flavorText.ultra-sun-ultra-moon: Its reckless nature leads it to stand up to others—even large Pokémon—if it has to protect its territory.
flavorText.lets-go-pikachu-eevee: Inept at flying high. However, it can fly around very fast to protect its territory.

flavorText.red-blue: With its huge and magnificent wings, it can keep aloft without ever having to land for rest.
flavorText.yellow: A POKéMON that dates back many years. If it senses danger, it flies high and away, instantly.
flavorText.gold-silver: It shoots itself suddenly high into the sky, then plummets down in one fell swoop to strike its prey.
flavorText.crystal: It uses its long beak to attack. It has a surprisingly long reach, so it must be treated with caution.
flavorText.ruby-sapphire: FEAROW is recognized by its long neck and elongated beak. They are conveniently shaped for catching prey in soil or water. It deftly moves its long and skinny beak to pluck prey.
flavorText.emerald: Its long neck and elongated beak are ideal for catching prey in soil or water. It deftly moves this extended and skinny beak to pluck prey.
flavorText.firered-leafgreen: Its huge and magnificent wings can keep it aloft in the sky. It can remain flying a whole day without landing.
flavorText.diamond-pearl: It has the stamina to fly all day on its broad wings. It fights by using its sharp beak.
flavorText.platinum: It has the stamina to fly all day on its broad wings. It fights by using its sharp beak.
flavorText.heartgold-soulsilver: It shoots itself suddenly high into the sky, then plummets down in one fell swoop to strike its prey.
flavorText.black-white: It has the stamina to fly all day on its broad wings. It fights by using its sharp beak.
flavorText.black-2-white-2: It has the stamina to fly all day on its broad wings. It fights by using its sharp beak.
flavorText.x-y: With its huge and magnificent wings, it can keep aloft without ever having to land for rest.
flavorText.omega-ruby-alpha-sapphire: Fearow is recognized by its long neck and elongated beak. They are conveniently shaped for catching prey in soil or water. It deftly moves its long and skinny beak to pluck prey.
flavorText.sun-moon: It’s tough and has excellent stamina. It has no problem flying continuously for a whole day carrying a heavy load.
flavorText.ultra-sun-ultra-moon: Carrying food through Fearow’s territory is dangerous. It will snatch the food away from you in a flash!
flavorText.lets-go-pikachu-eevee: A Pokémon that dates back many years. If it senses danger, it flies high and away, instantly.

flavorText.red-blue: Moves silently and stealthily. Eats the eggs of birds, such as PIDGEY and SPEAROW, whole.
flavorText.yellow: The older it gets, the longer it grows. At night, it wraps its long body around tree branches to rest.
flavorText.gold-silver: It can freely de tach its jaw to swallow large prey whole. It can be come too heavy to move, however.
flavorText.crystal: It flutters the tip of its tongue to seek out the scent of prey, then swallows the prey whole.
flavorText.ruby-sapphire: EKANS curls itself up in a spiral while it rests. Assuming this position allows it to quickly respond to a threat from any direction with a glare from its upraised head.
flavorText.emerald: An EKANS curls itself up in a spiral while it rests. This position allows it to quickly respond to an enemy from any direction with a threat from its upraised head.
flavorText.firered-leafgreen: A very common sight in grassland, etc. It flicks its tongue in and out to sense danger in its surroundings.
flavorText.diamond-pearl: It sneaks through grass without making a sound and strikes unsuspecting prey from behind.
flavorText.platinum: It sneaks through grass without making a sound and strikes unsuspecting prey from behind.
flavorText.heartgold-soulsilver: It can freely detach its jaw to swallow large prey whole. It can become too heavy to move, however.
flavorText.black-white: It sneaks through grass without making a sound and strikes unsuspecting prey from behind.
flavorText.black-2-white-2: It sneaks through grass without making a sound and strikes unsuspecting prey from behind.
flavorText.x-y: The older it gets, the longer it grows. At night, it wraps its long body around tree branches to rest.
flavorText.omega-ruby-alpha-sapphire: Ekans curls itself up in a spiral while it rests. Assuming this position allows it to quickly respond to a threat from any direction with a glare from its upraised head.
flavorText.ultra-sun-ultra-moon: By dislocating its jaw, it can swallow prey larger than itself. After a meal, it curls up and rests.
flavorText.lets-go-pikachu-eevee: The older it gets, the longer it grows. At night, it wraps its long body around tree branches to rest.

flavorText.red-blue: It is rumored that the ferocious warning markings on its belly differ from area to area.
flavorText.yellow: The frightening patterns on its belly have been studied. Six variations have been confirmed.
flavorText.gold-silver: Transfixing prey with the face-like pattern on its belly, it binds and poisons the frightened victim.
flavorText.crystal: To intimidate foes, it spreads its chest wide and makes eerie sounds by expelling air from its mouth.
flavorText.ruby-sapphire: This POKéMON is terrifically strong in order to constrict things with its body. It can even flatten steel oil drums. Once ARBOK wraps its body around its foe, escaping its crunching embrace is impossible.
flavorText.emerald: This POKéMON has a terrifically strong constricting power. It can even flatten steel oil drums. Once it wraps its body around its foe, escaping is impossible.
flavorText.firered-leafgreen: The pattern on its belly appears to be a frightening face. Weak foes will flee just at the sight of the pattern.
flavorText.diamond-pearl: The pattern on its belly is for intimidation. It constricts foes while they are frozen in fear.
flavorText.platinum: The pattern on its belly is for intimidation. It constricts foes while they are frozen in fear.
flavorText.heartgold-soulsilver: Transfixing prey with the face-like pattern on its belly, it binds and poisons the frightened victim.
flavorText.black-white: The pattern on its belly is for intimidation. It constricts foes while they are frozen in fear.
flavorText.black-2-white-2: The pattern on its belly is for intimidation. It constricts foes while they are frozen in fear.
flavorText.x-y: The pattern on its belly appears to be a frightening face. Weak foes will flee just at the sight of the pattern.
flavorText.omega-ruby-alpha-sapphire: This Pokémon is terrifically strong in order to constrict things with its body. It can even flatten steel oil drums. Once Arbok wraps its body around its foe, escaping its crunching embrace is impossible.
flavorText.ultra-sun-ultra-moon: The latest research has determined that there are over 20 possible arrangements of the patterns on its stomach.
flavorText.lets-go-pikachu-eevee: The frightening patterns on its belly have been studied. Six variations have been confirmed.

flavorText.red-blue: When several of these POKéMON gather, their electricity could build and cause lightning storms.
flavorText.yellow: It keeps its tail raised to monitor its surroundings. If you yank its tail, it will try to bite you.
flavorText.gold-silver: This intelligent POKéMON roasts hard BERRIES with electricity to make them tender enough to eat.
flavorText.crystal: When it is anger ed, it immediately discharges the energy stored in the pouches in its cheeks.
flavorText.ruby-sapphire: Whenever PIKACHU comes across something new, it blasts it with a jolt of electricity. If you come across a blackened berry, it’s evidence that this POKéMON mistook the intensity of its charge.
flavorText.emerald: It stores electricity in the electric sacs on its cheeks. When it releases pent-up energy in a burst, the electric power is equal to a lightning bolt.
flavorText.firered-leafgreen: It has small electric sacs on both its cheeks. If threatened, it looses electric charges from the sacs.
flavorText.diamond-pearl: It lives in forests with others. It stores electricity in the pouches on its cheeks.
flavorText.platinum: It occasionally uses an electric shock to recharge a fellow PIKACHU that is in a weakened state.
flavorText.heartgold-soulsilver: This intelligent Pokémon roasts hard berries with electricity to make them tender enough to eat.
flavorText.black-white: It occasionally uses an electric shock to recharge a fellow Pikachu that is in a weakened state.
flavorText.black-2-white-2: It occasionally uses an electric shock to recharge a fellow Pikachu that is in a weakened state.
flavorText.x-y: It raises its tail to check its surroundings. The tail is sometimes struck by lightning in this pose.
flavorText.omega-ruby-alpha-sapphire: Whenever Pikachu comes across something new, it blasts it with a jolt of electricity. If you come across a blackened berry, it’s evidence that this Pokémon mistook the intensity of its charge.
flavorText.sun-moon: A plan was recently announced to gather many Pikachu and make an electric power plant.
flavorText.ultra-sun-ultra-moon: Its nature is to store up electricity. Forests where nests of Pikachu live are dangerous, since the trees are so often struck by lightning.
flavorText.lets-go-pikachu-eevee: This forest-dwelling Pokémon stores electricity in its cheeks, so you’ll feel a tingly shock if you touch it.
flavorText.sword-shield: Pikachu that can generate powerful electricity have cheek sacs that are extra soft and super stretchy.
flavorText.legends-arceus: Possesses cheek sacs in which it stores electricity. This clever forest-dweller roasts tough berries with an electric shock before consuming them.

flavorText.red-blue: Its long tail serves as a ground to protect itself from its own high voltage power.
flavorText.yellow: When electricity builds up inside its body, it becomes feisty. It also glows in the dark.
flavorText.gold-silver: When its electric ity builds, its muscles are stimu lated, and it be comes more aggres sive than usual.
flavorText.crystal: If its electric pouches run empty, it raises its tail to gather electri city from the atmosphere.
flavorText.ruby-sapphire: If the electrical sacks become excessively charged, RAICHU plants its tail in the ground and discharges. Scorched patches of ground will be found near this POKéMON’s nest.
flavorText.emerald: If it stores too much electricity, its behavior turns aggressive. To avoid this, it occasionally discharges excess energy and calms itself down.
flavorText.firered-leafgreen: Its electric charges can reach even 100,000 volts. Careless contact can cause even an Indian elephant to faint.
flavorText.diamond-pearl: It turns aggressive if it has too much electricity in its body. It discharges power through its tail.
flavorText.platinum: Its tail discharges electricity into the ground, protecting it from getting shocked.
flavorText.heartgold-soulsilver: When its electricity builds, its muscles are stimulated, and it becomes more aggressive than usual.
flavorText.black-white: Its tail discharges electricity into the ground, protecting it from getting shocked.
flavorText.black-2-white-2: Its tail discharges electricity into the ground, protecting it from getting shocked.
flavorText.x-y: When its electricity builds, its muscles are stimulated, and it becomes more aggressive than usual.
flavorText.omega-ruby-alpha-sapphire: If the electrical sacs become excessively charged, Raichu plants its tail in the ground and discharges. Scorched patches of ground will be found near this Pokémon’s nest.
flavorText.sun-moon: It unleashes electric shocks that can reach 100,000 volts. When agitated, it can knock out even an Indian elephant.
flavorText.ultra-sun-ultra-moon: As electricity builds up inside its body, it becomes more aggressive. One theory is that the electricity buildup is actually causing stress.
flavorText.lets-go-pikachu-eevee: When electricity builds up inside its body, it becomes feisty. It also glows in the dark.
flavorText.sword-shield: Its long tail serves as a ground to protect itself from its own high-voltage power.
flavorText.legends-arceus: It can discharge bursts of electricity exceeding 100,000 volts— a single strike with that amount of power would incapacitate one of the Copperajah of my homeland.

flavorText.red-blue: Burrows deep underground in arid locations far from water. It only emerges to hunt for food.
flavorText.yellow: Its body is dry. When it gets cold at night, its hide is said to become coated with a fine dew.
flavorText.gold-silver: If it fell from a great height, this POKéMON could save itself by rolling into a ball and bouncing.
flavorText.crystal: It prefers dry, sandy places because it uses the sand to protect itself when threatened.
flavorText.ruby-sapphire: SANDSHREW’s body is configured to absorb water without waste, enabling it to survive in an arid desert. This POKéMON curls up to protect itself from its enemies.
flavorText.emerald: When it curls up in a ball, it can make any attack bounce off harmlessly. Its hide has turned tough and solid as a result of living in the desert.
flavorText.firered-leafgreen: It burrows and lives underground. If threatened, it curls itself up into a ball for protection.
flavorText.diamond-pearl: To protect itself from attackers, it curls up into a ball. It lives in arid regions with minimal rainfall.
flavorText.platinum: To protect itself from attackers, it curls up into a ball. It lives in arid regions with minimal rainfall.
flavorText.heartgold-soulsilver: If it fell from a great height, this Pokémon could save itself by rolling into a ball and bouncing.
flavorText.black-white: To protect itself from attackers, it curls up into a ball. It lives in arid regions with minimal rainfall.
flavorText.black-2-white-2: It digs deep burrows to live in. When in danger, it rolls up its body to withstand attacks.
flavorText.x-y: It burrows and lives underground. If threatened, it curls itself up into a ball for protection.
flavorText.omega-ruby-alpha-sapphire: Sandshrew’s body is configured to absorb water without waste, enabling it to survive in an arid desert. This Pokémon curls up to protect itself from its enemies.
flavorText.sun-moon: It can roll its body into a ball. It moves through the desert by rolling at high speeds.
flavorText.ultra-sun-ultra-moon: It lives in areas of limited rainfall. When danger approaches, it curls up into a ball to protect its soft stomach.
flavorText.lets-go-pikachu-eevee: Its body is dry. When it gets cold at night, its hide is said to become coated with a fine dew.
flavorText.sword-shield: It loves to bathe in the grit of dry, sandy areas. By sand bathing, the Pokémon rids itself of dirt and moisture clinging to its body.

flavorText.red-blue: Curls up into a spiny ball when threatened. It can roll while curled up to attack or escape.
flavorText.yellow: It is skilled at slashing enemies with its claws. If broken, they start to grow back in a day.
flavorText.gold-silver: In an attempt to hide itself, it will run around at top speed to kick up a blinding dust storm.
flavorText.crystal: Adept at climbing trees, it rolls into a spiny ball, then attacks its enemies from above.
flavorText.ruby-sapphire: SANDSLASH’s body is covered by tough spikes, which are hardened sections of its hide. Once a year, the old spikes fall out, to be replaced with new spikes that grow out from beneath the old ones.
flavorText.emerald: It curls up in a ball to protect itself from enemy attacks. It also curls up to prevent heatstroke during the daytime when temperatures rise sharply.
flavorText.firered-leafgreen: It is adept at attacking with the spines on its back and its sharp claws while quickly scurrying about.
flavorText.diamond-pearl: It curls up, then rolls into foes with its back. Its sharp spines inflict severe damage.
flavorText.platinum: It curls up, then rolls into foes with its back. Its sharp spines inflict severe damage.
flavorText.heartgold-soulsilver: In an attempt to hide itself, it will run around at top speed to kick up a blinding dust storm.
flavorText.black-white: It curls up, then rolls into foes with its back. Its sharp spines inflict severe damage.
flavorText.black-2-white-2: The spikes on its body are made up of its hardened hide. It rolls up and attacks foes with its spikes.
flavorText.x-y: If it digs at an incredible pace, it may snap off its spikes and claws. They grow back in a day.
flavorText.omega-ruby-alpha-sapphire: Sandslash’s body is covered by tough spikes, which are hardened sections of its hide. Once a year, the old spikes fall out, to be replaced with new spikes that grow out from beneath the old ones.
flavorText.sun-moon: Although they are sharp, its claws and spikes often break off. They grow back the next day, so it is not bothered by the temporary loss.
flavorText.ultra-sun-ultra-moon: Its claws and horns often break off. The broken claws and horns can be used to carve plows for tilling farm fields.
flavorText.lets-go-pikachu-eevee: It is skilled at slashing enemies with its claws. If broken, they start to grow back in a day.
flavorText.sword-shield: The drier the area Sandslash lives in, the harder and smoother the Pokémon’s spikes will feel when touched.

flavorText.red-blue: Although small, its venomous barbs render this POKéMON dangerous. The female has smaller horns.
flavorText.yellow: A mild-mannered POKéMON that does not like to fight. Beware, its small horns secrete venom.
flavorText.gold-silver: The poison hidden in its small horn is extremely po tent. Even a tiny scratch can have fatal results.
flavorText.crystal: Small and very docile, it pro tects itself with its small, poison ous horn when attacked.
flavorText.ruby-sapphire: NIDORAN has barbs that secrete a powerful poison. They are thought to have developed as protection for this small-bodied POKéMON. When enraged, it releases a horrible toxin from its horn.
flavorText.emerald: Its highly toxic barbs are thought to have developed as protection for this small- bodied POKéMON. When enraged, it releases a horrible toxin from its horn.
flavorText.firered-leafgreen: Though small, it must be treated with caution because of its powerfully toxic barbs. The female has smaller horns.
flavorText.diamond-pearl: While it does not prefer to fight, even one drop of the poison it secretes from barbs can be fatal.
flavorText.platinum: While it does not prefer to fight, even one drop of the poison it secretes from barbs can be fatal.
flavorText.heartgold-soulsilver: The poison hidden in its small horn is extremely potent. Even a tiny scratch can have fatal results.

flavorText.lets-go-pikachu-eevee: A mild-mannered Pokémon that does not like to fight. Beware—its small horn secretes venom.

flavorText.red-blue: The female's horn develops slowly. Prefers physical attacks such as clawing and biting.
flavorText.yellow: When resting deep in its burrow, its thorns always retract. This is proof that it is relaxed.
flavorText.gold-silver: When feeding its young, it first chews and tender izes the food, then spits it out for the offspring.
flavorText.crystal: It has a docile nature. If it is threatened with attack, it raises the barbs that are all over its body.
flavorText.ruby-sapphire: When NIDORINA are with their friends or family, they keep their barbs tucked away to prevent hurting each other. This POKéMON appears to become nervous if separated from the others.
flavorText.emerald: When it is with its friends or family, its barbs are tucked away to prevent injury. It appears to become nervous if separated from the others.
flavorText.firered-leafgreen: The female has a gentle temperament. It emits ultrasonic cries that have the power to befuddle foes.

flavorText.black-white: When it senses danger, it raises all the barbs on its body. These barbs grow slower than Nidorino’s.

flavorText.lets-go-pikachu-eevee: When resting deep in its burrow, its barbs always retract. This is proof that it is relaxed.
flavorText.sword-shield: The horn on its head has atrophied. It’s thought that this happens so Nidorina’s children won’t get poked while their mother is feeding them.

flavorText.red-blue: Its hard scales provide strong protection. It uses its hefty bulk to execute powerful moves.
flavorText.yellow: Tough scales cover the sturdy body of this POKéMON. It appears that the scales grow in cycles.
flavorText.gold-silver: Its body is cover ed with needle- like scales. It never shows signs of shrinking from any attack.
flavorText.crystal: The hard scales that cover its strong body serve as excellent protection from any attack.
flavorText.ruby-sapphire: NIDOQUEEN’s body is encased in extremely hard scales. It is adept at sending foes flying with harsh tackles. This POKéMON is at its strongest when it is defending its young.
flavorText.emerald: It is adept at sending foes flying with harsh tackles using its tough, scaly body. This POKéMON is at its strongest when it is defending its young.
flavorText.firered-leafgreen: The body is covered by stiff, needle- like scales. If it becomes excited, the needles bristle outwards.
flavorText.diamond-pearl: Its entire body is armored with hard scales. It will protect the young in its burrow with its life.
flavorText.platinum: Its entire body is armored with hard scales. It will protect the young in its burrow with its life.
flavorText.heartgold-soulsilver: Its body is covered with needle-like scales. It never shows signs of shrinking from any attack.

flavorText.sword-shield: Nidoqueen is better at defense than offense. With scales like armor, this Pokémon will shield its children from any kind of attack.

flavorText.yellow: Its large ears are always kept upright. If it senses danger, it will attack with a poisonous sting.
flavorText.gold-silver: It is small, but its horn is filled with poison. It charges then stabs with the horn to inject poison.
flavorText.crystal: It constantly moves its large ears in many directions in order to detect danger right away.
flavorText.ruby-sapphire: The male NIDORAN has developed muscles for moving its ears. Thanks to them, the ears can be freely moved in any direction. Even the slightest sound does not escape this POKéMON’s notice.
flavorText.emerald: The male NIDORAN has developed muscles that freely move its ears in any direction. Even the slightest sound does not escape this POKéMON’s notice.
flavorText.firered-leafgreen: Its large ears are flapped like wings when it is listening to distant sounds. It extends toxic barbs when angered.
flavorText.diamond-pearl: It scans its surroundings by raising its ears out of the grass. Its toxic horn is for protection.
flavorText.platinum: It scans its surroundings by raising its ears out of the grass. Its toxic horn is for protection.
flavorText.heartgold-soulsilver: It is small, but its horn is filled with poison. It charges then stabs with the horn to inject poison.
flavorText.black-white: It scans its surroundings by raising its ears out of the grass. Its toxic horn is for protection.
flavorText.black-2-white-2: It scans its surroundings by raising its ears out of the grass. Its toxic horn is for protection.

flavorText.lets-go-pikachu-eevee: Its large ears are always kept upright. If it senses danger, it will attack with a poisonous sting.
flavorText.sword-shield: The horn on a male Nidoran’s forehead contains a powerful poison. This is a very cautious Pokémon, always straining its large ears.

flavorText.red-blue: An aggressive POKéMON that is quick to attack. The horn on its head secretes a powerful venom.
flavorText.yellow: Its horns contain venom. If they are stabbed into an enemy, the impact makes the poison leak out.
flavorText.gold-silver: It raises its big ears to check its surroundings. If it senses any thing, it attacks immediately.
flavorText.crystal: It is easily agitated and uses its horn for offense as soon as it notices an attacker.
flavorText.ruby-sapphire: NIDORINO has a horn that is harder than a diamond. If it senses a hostile presence, all the barbs on its back bristle up at once, and it challenges the foe with all its might.
flavorText.emerald: Its horn is harder than a diamond. If it senses a hostile presence, all the barbs on its back bristle up at once, and it challenges the foe with all its might.
flavorText.firered-leafgreen: It is easily angered. By swinging its well- developed horn wildly, it can even punch through diamond.
flavorText.diamond-pearl: It has a violent disposition and stabs foes with its horn, which oozes poison upon impact.
flavorText.platinum: It has a violent disposition and stabs foes with its horn, which oozes poison upon impact.
flavorText.heartgold-soulsilver: It raises its big ears to check its surroundings. If it senses anything, it attacks immediately.
flavorText.black-white: It has a violent disposition and stabs foes with its horn, which oozes poison upon impact.
flavorText.black-2-white-2: It has a violent disposition and stabs foes with its horn, which oozes poison upon impact.

flavorText.omega-ruby-alpha-sapphire: Nidorino has a horn that is harder than a diamond. If it senses a hostile presence, all the barbs on its back bristle up at once, and it challenges the foe with all its might.
flavorText.lets-go-pikachu-eevee: Its horn contains venom. If it stabs an enemy with the horn, the impact makes the poison leak out.
flavorText.sword-shield: With a horn that’s harder than diamond, this Pokémon goes around shattering boulders as it searches for a moon stone.

flavorText.red-blue: It uses its powerful tail in battle to smash, constrict, then break the prey's bones.
flavorText.yellow: Its steel-like hide adds to its powerful tackle. Its horns are so hard, they can pierce a diamond.
flavorText.gold-silver: It swings its big tail around during battle. If its foe flinches, it will charge with its sturdy body.
flavorText.crystal: It uses its thick arms, legs and tail to attack forcefully. Melee combat is its specialty.
flavorText.ruby-sapphire: NIDOKING’s thick tail packs enormously destructive power. With one swing, it can topple a metal transmission tower. Once this POKéMON goes on a rampage, there is no stopping it.
flavorText.emerald: A NIDOKING’s thick tail packs enormously destructive power capable of toppling a metal transmission tower. Once it goes on a rampage, there is no stopping it.
flavorText.firered-leafgreen: It is recognized by its rock-hard hide and its extended horn. Be careful with the horn as it contains venom.
flavorText.diamond-pearl: One swing of its mighty tail can snap a telephone pole as if it were a matchstick.
flavorText.platinum: One swing of its mighty tail can snap a telephone pole as if it were a matchstick.
flavorText.heartgold-soulsilver: It swings its big tail around during battle. If its foe flinches, it will charge with its sturdy body.

flavorText.black-2-white-2: One swing of its mighty tail can snap a telephone pole as if it were a matchstick.
