flavorText.omega-ruby-alpha-sapphire: Nidoking’s thick tail packs enormously destructive power. With one swing, it can topple a metal transmission tower. Once this Pokémon goes on a rampage, there is no stopping it.
flavorText.lets-go-pikachu-eevee: Its steel-like hide adds to its powerful tackle. Its horns are so hard, they can pierce a diamond.
flavorText.sword-shield: When it goes on a rampage, it’s impossible to control. But in the presence of a Nidoqueen it’s lived with for a long time, Nidoking calms down.

flavorText.red-blue: Its magical and cute appeal has many admirers. It is rare and found only in certain areas.
flavorText.yellow: Adored for their cute looks and playfulness. They are thought to be rare, as they do not appear often.
flavorText.gold-silver: The moonlight that it stores in the wings on its back apparently gives it the ability to float in midair.
flavorText.crystal: Though rarely seen, it becomes easier to spot, for some reason, on the night of a full moon.
flavorText.ruby-sapphire: On every night of a full moon, groups of this POKéMON come out to play. When dawn arrives, the tired CLEFAIRY return to their quiet mountain retreats and go to sleep nestled up against each other.
flavorText.emerald: On every night of a full moon, they come out to play. When dawn arrives, the tired CLEFAIRY go to sleep nestled up against each other in deep and quiet mountains.
flavorText.firered-leafgreen: Its adorable appearance makes it popular as a pet. However, it is rare and difficult to find.
flavorText.diamond-pearl: Thought to live with others on quiet mountains, it is popular for its adorable nature.
flavorText.platinum: It is said that happiness will come to those who see a gathering of CLEFAIRY dancing under a full moon.
flavorText.heartgold-soulsilver: The moonlight that it stores in the wings on its back apparently gives it the ability to float in midair.
flavorText.black-white: It is said that happiness will come to those who see a gathering of Clefairy dancing under a full moon.
flavorText.black-2-white-2: On nights with a full moon, Clefairy gather from all over and dance. Bathing in moonlight makes them float.
flavorText.x-y: It is said that happiness will come to those who see a gathering of Clefairy dancing under a full moon.
flavorText.omega-ruby-alpha-sapphire: On every night of a full moon, groups of this Pokémon come out to play. When dawn arrives, the tired Clefairy return to their quiet mountain retreats and go to sleep nestled up against each other.
flavorText.sun-moon: Its adorable behavior and appearance make it popular with men and women, young and old. Its numbers are few, however.
flavorText.ultra-sun-ultra-moon: They’re popular, but they’re rare. Trainers who show them off recklessly may be targeted by thieves.
flavorText.lets-go-pikachu-eevee: Adored for their cute looks and playfulness. They are thought to be rare, as they do not appear often.
flavorText.sword-shield: It is said that happiness will come to those who see a gathering of Clefairy dancing under a full moon.
flavorText.legends-arceus: It can be found in quiet mountain areas on a full moon's night. Its dancing and its tiny, faintly glowing wings confer upon it a lovely fairylike quality.

flavorText.red-blue: A timid fairy POKéMON that is rarely seen. It will run and hide the moment it senses people.
flavorText.yellow: They appear to be very protective of their own world. It is a kind of fairy, rarely seen by people.
flavorText.gold-silver: With its acute hearing, it can pick up sounds from far away. It usually hides in quiet places.
flavorText.crystal: Said to live in quiet, remote mountains, this type of fairy has a strong aversion to being seen.
flavorText.ruby-sapphire: CLEFABLE moves by skipping lightly as if it were flying using its wings. Its bouncy step lets it even walk on water. It is known to take strolls on lakes on quiet, moonlit nights.
flavorText.emerald: A CLEFABLE uses its wings to skip lightly as if it were flying. Its bouncy step lets it even walk on water. On quiet, moonlit nights, it strolls on lakes.
flavorText.firered-leafgreen: It has an acute sense of hearing. It can easily hear a pin being dropped nearly 1,100 yards away.
flavorText.diamond-pearl: Rarely seen by people, it is said to be drawn by the full moon to play at deserted lakes.
flavorText.platinum: It is very wary and rarely shows itself to people. Its ears can hear a pin drop over half a mile away.
flavorText.heartgold-soulsilver: With its acute hearing, it can pick up sounds from far away. It usually hides in quiet places.
flavorText.black-white: It is very wary and rarely shows itself to people. Its ears can hear a pin drop over half a mile away.
flavorText.black-2-white-2: Their ears are sensitive enough to hear a pin drop from over a mile away, so they’re usually found in quiet places.
flavorText.x-y: Its hearing is so acute it can hear a pin drop over half a mile away. It lives on quiet mountains.
flavorText.omega-ruby-alpha-sapphire: Clefable moves by skipping lightly as if it were flying using its wings. Its bouncy step lets it even walk on water. It is known to take strolls on lakes on quiet, moonlit nights.
flavorText.sun-moon: They don’t like to reveal themselves in front of people. They live quietly in packs deep in the mountains.
flavorText.ultra-sun-ultra-moon: It can’t help but hear a pin drop from over half a mile away, so it lives deep in the mountains where there aren’t many people or Pokémon.
flavorText.lets-go-pikachu-eevee: They appear to be very protective of their own world. It is a kind of fairy, rarely seen by people.
flavorText.sword-shield: A timid fairy Pokémon that is rarely seen, it will run and hide the moment it senses people.
flavorText.legends-arceus: Legend says that on clear, quiet nights, it listens for the voices of its kin living on the moon. I, too, often think of my homeland, so far away.

flavorText.red-blue: At the time of birth, it has just one tail. The tail splits from its tip as it grows older.
flavorText.yellow: Both its fur and its tails are beautiful. As it grows, the tails split and form more tails.
flavorText.gold-silver: As it develops, its single white tail gains color and splits into six. It is quite warm and cuddly.
flavorText.crystal: As its body grows larger, its six warm tails become more beautiful, with a more luxur ious coat of fur.
flavorText.ruby-sapphire: At the time of its birth, VULPIX has one white tail. The tail separates into six if this POKéMON receives plenty of love from its TRAINER. The six tails become magnificently curled.
flavorText.emerald: It can freely control fire, making fiery orbs fly like will-o’-the-wisps. Just before evolution, its six tails grow hot as if on fire.
flavorText.firered-leafgreen: While young, it has six gorgeous tails. When it grows, several new tails are sprouted.
flavorText.diamond-pearl: It controls balls of fire. As it grows, its six tails split from their tips to make more tails.
flavorText.platinum: It controls balls of fire. As it grows, its six tails split from their tips to make more tails.
flavorText.heartgold-soulsilver: As it develops, its single white tail gains color and splits into six. It is quite warm and cuddly.
flavorText.black-white: It controls balls of fire. As it grows, its six tails split from their tips to make more tails.
flavorText.black-2-white-2: As each tail grows, its fur becomes more lustrous. When held, it feels slightly warm.
flavorText.x-y: When it is born, it has just one snow-white tail. The tail splits from its tip as it grows older.
flavorText.omega-ruby-alpha-sapphire: At the time of its birth, Vulpix has one white tail. The tail separates into six if this Pokémon receives plenty of love from its Trainer. The six tails become magnificently curled.
flavorText.sun-moon: Its beautiful fur and tails have made it very popular. As it grows, its tails split to form more tails.
flavorText.ultra-sun-ultra-moon: Its beautiful tails have made it very popular. However, if it’s not brushed diligently, it will be a mass of tangles before you know it.
flavorText.lets-go-pikachu-eevee: Both its fur and its tails are beautiful. As it grows, the tails split and form more tails.
flavorText.sword-shield: While young, it has six gorgeous tails. When it grows, several new tails are sprouted.
flavorText.legends-arceus: In its belly burns a fire, which Vulpix spits out in the form of fireballs. When young, this Pokémon has but one white tail. As the Pokémon matures, this single tail splits into six.

flavorText.red-blue: Very smart and very vengeful. Grabbing one of its many tails could result in a 1000-year curse.
flavorText.yellow: According to an enduring legend, 9 noble saints were united and reincarnated as this POKéMON.
flavorText.gold-silver: Some legends claim that each of its nine tails has its own unique type of special mystical power.
flavorText.crystal: It is said to live a thousand years, and each of its tails is loaded with supernatural powers.
flavorText.ruby-sapphire: NINETALES casts a sinister light from its bright red eyes to gain total control over its foe’s mind. This POKéMON is said to live for a thousand years.
flavorText.emerald: It has long been said that each of the nine tails embody an enchanted power. A long-lived NINETALES will have fur that shines like gold.
flavorText.firered-leafgreen: It has nine long tails and fur that gleams gold. It is said to live for 1,000 years.
flavorText.diamond-pearl: Its nine tails are said to be imbued with a mystic power. It can live for a thousand years.
flavorText.platinum: Its nine tails are said to be imbued with a mystic power. It can live for a thousand years.
flavorText.heartgold-soulsilver: Some legends claim that each of its nine tails has its own unique type of special mystical power.
flavorText.black-white: Its nine tails are said to be imbued with a mystic power. It can live for a thousand years.
flavorText.black-2-white-2: Each of its nine tails is imbued with supernatural power, and it can live for a thousand years.
flavorText.x-y: It has nine long tails and fur that gleams gold. It is said to live for 1,000 years.
flavorText.omega-ruby-alpha-sapphire: Ninetales casts a sinister light from its bright red eyes to gain total control over its foe’s mind. This Pokémon is said to live for a thousand years.
flavorText.sun-moon: Legend has it that this mystical Pokémon was formed when nine saints coalesced into one.
flavorText.ultra-sun-ultra-moon: It is vindictive and relentless by nature. Those who cross it even once will be cursed for a thousand years, along with their descendants.
flavorText.lets-go-pikachu-eevee: According to an enduring legend, nine noble saints were united and reincarnated as this Pokémon.
flavorText.sword-shield: It is said to live 1,000 years, and each of its tails is loaded with supernatural powers.
flavorText.legends-arceus: The coat of gleaming golden fur is quite magnificent. This species is said to store sacred power in its nine long tails and to live for a millennium.

flavorText.red-blue: When its huge eyes light up, it sings a mysteriously soothing melody that lulls its enemies to sleep.
flavorText.yellow: Uses its alluring eyes to enrapture its foe. It then sings a pleasing melody that lulls the foe to sleep.
flavorText.gold-silver: If it inflates to SING a lullaby, it can perform longer and cause sure drowsiness in its audience.
flavorText.crystal: It rolls its cute eyes as it sings a soothing lullaby. Its gentle song puts anyone who hears it to sleep.
flavorText.ruby-sapphire: JIGGLYPUFF’s vocal chords can freely adjust the wavelength of its voice. This POKéMON uses this ability to sing at precisely the right wavelength to make its foes most drowsy.
flavorText.emerald: Nothing can avoid falling asleep hearing a JIGGLYPUFF’s song. The sound waves of its singing voice match the brain waves of someone in a deep sleep.
flavorText.firered-leafgreen: It captivates foes with its huge, round eyes, then lulls them to sleep by singing a soothing melody.
flavorText.diamond-pearl: When it wavers its big, round eyes, it begins singing a lullaby that makes everyone drowsy.
flavorText.platinum: When it wavers its big, round eyes, it begins singing a lullaby that makes everyone drowsy.
flavorText.heartgold-soulsilver: If it inflates to sing a lullaby, it can perform longer and cause sure drowsiness in its audience.
flavorText.black-white: When it wavers its big, round eyes, it begins singing a lullaby that makes everyone drowsy.
flavorText.black-2-white-2: Looking into its cute, round eyes makes it start singing a song so pleasant listeners can’t help but fall asleep.
flavorText.x-y: It captivates foes with its huge, round eyes, then lulls them to sleep by singing a soothing melody.
flavorText.omega-ruby-alpha-sapphire: Jigglypuff’s vocal cords can freely adjust the wavelength of its voice. This Pokémon uses this ability to sing at precisely the right wavelength to make its foes most drowsy.
flavorText.sun-moon: It hugely inflates its stomach and sings a mysterious melody. If you hear this melody, you’ll become sleepy right away.
flavorText.ultra-sun-ultra-moon: Recordings of Jigglypuff’s strange lullabies can be purchased from department stores. These CDs can be found near the bedding area.
flavorText.lets-go-pikachu-eevee: Uses its cute round eyes to enrapture its foe. It then sings a pleasing melody that lulls the foe to sleep.
flavorText.sword-shield: Jigglypuff has top-notch lung capacity, even by comparison to other Pokémon. It won’t stop singing its lullabies until its foes fall asleep.

flavorText.red-blue: The body is soft and rubbery. When angered, it will suck in air and inflate itself to an enormous size.
flavorText.yellow: Its body is full of elasticity. By inhaling deeply, it can continue to inflate itself without limit.
flavorText.gold-silver: Their fur feels so good that if two of them snuggle together, they won't want to be separated.
flavorText.crystal: The rich, fluffy fur that covers its body feels so good that anyone who feels it can't stop touching it.
flavorText.ruby-sapphire: WIGGLYTUFF has large, saucerlike eyes. The surfaces of its eyes are always covered with a thin layer of tears. If any dust gets in this POKéMON’s eyes, it is quickly washed away.
flavorText.emerald: Its fur is the ultimate in luxuriousness. Sleeping alongside a WIGGLYTUFF is simply divine. Its body expands seemingly without end when it inhales.
flavorText.firered-leafgreen: Its fur is extremely fine, dense, and supple. The exquisitely pleasant fur conveys an image of luxury.
flavorText.diamond-pearl: Its fine fur feels sublime to the touch. It can expand its body by inhaling air.
flavorText.platinum: Its fine fur feels sublime to the touch. It can expand its body by inhaling air.
flavorText.heartgold-soulsilver: Their fur feels so good that if two of them snuggle together, they won’t want to be separated.
flavorText.black-white: Its fine fur feels sublime to the touch. It can expand its body by inhaling air.
flavorText.black-2-white-2: Its fine fur feels so pleasant, those who accidentally touch it cannot take their hands away.
flavorText.x-y: Their fur feels so good that if two of them snuggle together, they won’t want to be separated.
flavorText.omega-ruby-alpha-sapphire: Wigglytuff has large, saucerlike eyes. The surfaces of its eyes are always covered with a thin layer of tears. If any dust gets in this Pokémon’s eyes, it is quickly washed away.
flavorText.sun-moon: It sheds its fine fur when the seasons change. The fur is gathered and spun into a luxurious yarn.
flavorText.ultra-sun-ultra-moon: Thanks to its bouncy body and fine fur, this Pokémon is sought after. Holding one in your arms while you sleep feels great.
flavorText.lets-go-pikachu-eevee: Its body is very elastic. By inhaling deeply, it can continue to inflate itself without limit.
flavorText.sword-shield: The more air it takes in, the more it inflates. If opponents catch it in a bad mood, it will inflate itself to an enormous size to intimidate them.

flavorText.x-y: It has no eyes. Instead, it relies on its ultrasonic cries for echolocation to flit about in darkness.
flavorText.red-blue: Forms colonies in perpetually dark places. Uses ultrasonic waves to identify and approach targets.
flavorText.yellow: Emits ultrasonic cries while it flies. They act as a sonar used to check for ob jects in its way.
flavorText.gold-silver: While flying, it constantly emits ultrasonic waves from its mouth to check its sur roundings.
flavorText.crystal: During the day, it gathers with others and hangs from the ceilings of old buildings and caves.
flavorText.ruby-sapphire: ZUBAT remains quietly unmoving in a dark spot during the bright daylight hours. It does so because prolonged exposure to the sun causes its body to become slightly burned.
flavorText.emerald: While living in pitch-black caverns, their eyes gradually grew shut and deprived them of vision. They use ultrasonic waves to detect obstacles.
flavorText.firered-leafgreen: It has no eyes. Instead, it relies on its ultrasonic cries for echo location to flit about in darkness.
flavorText.diamond-pearl: Even though it has no eyes, it can sense obstacles using ultrasonic waves it emits from its mouth.
flavorText.platinum: It checks its surroundings and location using reflections of the ultrasonic waves from its mouth.
flavorText.heartgold-soulsilver: While flying, it constantly emits ultrasonic waves from its mouth to check its surroundings.
flavorText.black-white: It checks its surroundings and location using reflections of the ultrasonic waves from its mouth.
flavorText.black-2-white-2: It does not need eyes, because it emits ultrasonic waves to check its surroundings while it flies.
flavorText.omega-ruby-alpha-sapphire: Zubat remains quietly unmoving in a dark spot during the bright daylight hours. It does so because prolonged exposure to the sun causes its body to become slightly burned.
flavorText.sun-moon: It sleeps in caves during the day. It has no eyes, so to check its surroundings while flying, it emits ultrasonic waves.
flavorText.ultra-sun-ultra-moon: It has no eyeballs, so it can’t see. It checks its surroundings via the ultrasonic waves it emits from its mouth.
flavorText.lets-go-pikachu-eevee: Emits ultrasonic cries while it flies. They act as a sonar used to check for objects in its way.
flavorText.sword-shield: It emits ultrasonic waves from its mouth to check its surroundings. Even in tight caves, Zubat flies around with skill.
flavorText.legends-arceus: Makes its home in gloomy caves. Atrophied eyes have left this Pokémon blind, so it scans its surroundings via sound waves that it emits from its mouth as it flies.

flavorText.red-blue: Once it strikes, it will not stop draining energy from the victim even if it gets too heavy to fly.
flavorText.yellow: It attacks in a stealthy manner, without warning. Its sharp fangs are used to bite and suck blood.
flavorText.gold-silver: However hard its victim's hide may be, it punctures with sharp fangs and gorges itself with blood.
flavorText.crystal: When it plunges its fangs into its prey, it instantly draws and gulps down more than ten ounces of blood.
flavorText.ruby-sapphire: GOLBAT loves to drink the blood of living things. It is particularly active in the pitch black of night. This POKéMON flits around in the night skies, seeking fresh blood.
flavorText.emerald: Its fangs easily puncture even thick animal hide. It loves to feast on the blood of people and POKéMON. It flits about in darkness and strikes from behind.
flavorText.firered-leafgreen: It clamps down on its prey with needle- sharp fangs and drains over 10 ounces of blood in one gulp.
flavorText.diamond-pearl: It loves the blood of humans and Pokémon. It flies around at night in search of neck veins.
flavorText.platinum: Its sharp fangs puncture the toughest of hides and have small holes for greedily sucking blood.
flavorText.heartgold-soulsilver: However hard its victim’s hide may be, it punctures with sharp fangs and gorges itself with blood.
flavorText.black-white: Its sharp fangs puncture the toughest of hides and have small holes for greedily sucking blood.
flavorText.black-2-white-2: Flitting around in the dead of night, it sinks its fangs into its prey and drains a nearly fatal amount of blood.
flavorText.x-y: Once it bites, it will not stop draining energy from the victim even if it gets too heavy to fly.
flavorText.omega-ruby-alpha-sapphire: Golbat loves to drink the blood of living things. It is particularly active in the pitch black of night. This Pokémon flits around in the night skies, seeking fresh blood.
flavorText.sun-moon: Its thick fangs are hollow like straws, making them unexpectedly fragile. These fangs are specialized for sucking blood.
flavorText.ultra-sun-ultra-moon: Every once in a while, you’ll see a Golbat that’s missing some fangs. This happens when hunger drives it to try biting a Steel-type Pokémon.
flavorText.lets-go-pikachu-eevee: It attacks in a stealthy manner, without warning. Its sharp fangs are used to bite and to suck blood.
flavorText.sword-shield: It loves to drink other creatures’ blood. It’s said that if it finds others of its kind going hungry, it sometimes shares the blood it’s gathered.
flavorText.legends-arceus: It sinks its sharp fangs into other creatures and slurps up their blood. A closer look at the fangs reveals that they are hollow and akin to straws.

flavorText.red-blue: During the day, it keeps its face buried in the ground. At night, it wanders around sowing its seeds.
flavorText.yellow: It may be mistaken for a clump of weeds. If you try to yank it out of the ground, it shrieks horribly.
flavorText.gold-silver: Awakened by moon light, it roams actively at night. In the day, it stays quietly underground.
flavorText.crystal: During the day, it stays in the cold underground to avoid the sun. It grows by bath ing in moonlight.
flavorText.ruby-sapphire: During the daytime, ODDISH buries itself in soil to absorb nutrients from the ground using its entire body. The more fertile the soil, the glossier its leaves become.
flavorText.emerald: This POKéMON grows by absorbing moonlight. During the daytime, it buries itself in the ground, leaving only its leaves exposed to avoid detection by its enemies.
flavorText.firered-leafgreen: Its scientific name is “Oddium Wanderus.” At night, it is said to walk nearly 1,000 feet on its two roots.
flavorText.diamond-pearl: It often plants its root feet in the ground during the day and sows seeds as it walks about at night.
flavorText.platinum: It often plants its root feet in the ground during the day and sows seeds as it walks about at night.
flavorText.heartgold-soulsilver: Awakened by moonlight, it roams actively at night. In the day, it stays quietly underground.
flavorText.black-white: It often plants its root feet in the ground during the day and sows seeds as it walks about at night.
flavorText.black-2-white-2: It often plants its root feet in the ground during the day and sows seeds as it walks about at night.
flavorText.x-y: During the day, it stays in the cold underground to avoid the sun. It grows by bathing in moonlight.
flavorText.omega-ruby-alpha-sapphire: During the daytime, Oddish buries itself in soil to absorb nutrients from the ground using its entire body. The more fertile the soil, the glossier its leaves become.
flavorText.lets-go-pikachu-eevee: It may be mistaken for a clump of weeds. If you try to yank it out of the ground, it shrieks horribly.
flavorText.sword-shield: If exposed to moonlight, it starts to move. It roams far and wide at night to scatter its seeds.

flavorText.red-blue: The fluid that oozes from its mouth isn't drool. It is a nectar that is used to attract prey.
flavorText.yellow: Smells incredibly foul! However, around 1 out of 1,000 people enjoy sniffing its nose- bending stink.
flavorText.gold-silver: What appears to be drool is actually sweet honey. It is very sticky and clings stubbornly if touched.
flavorText.crystal: The smell from its drool-like syrup and the pollen on its petals is so bad, it may make opponents faint.
flavorText.ruby-sapphire: GLOOM releases a foul fragrance from the pistil of its flower. When faced with danger, the stench worsens. If this POKéMON is feeling calm and secure, it does not release its usual stinky aroma.
flavorText.emerald: A horribly noxious honey drools from its mouth. One whiff of the honey can result in memory loss. Some fans are said to enjoy this overwhelming stink, however.
flavorText.firered-leafgreen: Its pistils exude an incredibly foul odor. The horrid stench can cause fainting at a distance of 1.25 miles.
flavorText.diamond-pearl: The honey it drools from its mouth smells so atrocious, it can curl noses more than a mile away.
flavorText.platinum: The honey it drools from its mouth smells so atrocious, it can curl noses more than a mile away.
flavorText.heartgold-soulsilver: What appears to be drool is actually sweet honey. It is very sticky and clings stubbornly if touched.
flavorText.black-white: The honey it drools from its mouth smells so atrocious, it can curl noses more than a mile away.

flavorText.lets-go-pikachu-eevee: Smells incredibly foul! However, around one out of a thousand people enjoy sniffing its nose-bending stink.
flavorText.sword-shield: Its pistils exude an incredibly foul odor. The horrid stench can cause fainting at a distance of 1.25 miles.

flavorText.red-blue: The larger its petals, the more toxic pollen it contains. Its big head is heavy and hard to hold up.
flavorText.yellow: Flaps its broad flower petals to scatter its poisonous pollen. The flapping sound is very loud.
flavorText.gold-silver: It has the world's largest petals. With every step, the petals shake out heavy clouds of toxic pollen.
flavorText.crystal: By shaking its big petals, it scat ters toxic pollen into the air, turning the air yellow.
flavorText.ruby-sapphire: VILEPLUME’s toxic pollen triggers atrocious allergy attacks. That’s why it is advisable never to approach any attractive flowers in a jungle, however pretty they may be.
flavorText.emerald: In seasons when it produces more pollen, the air around a VILEPLUME turns yellow with the powder as it walks. The pollen is highly toxic and causes paralysis.
flavorText.firered-leafgreen: Its petals are the largest in the world. It fiendishly scatters allergy-causing pollen from its petals.
flavorText.diamond-pearl: Its petals are the largest in the world. As it walks, it scatters extremely allergenic pollen.
flavorText.platinum: Its petals are the largest in the world. As it walks, it scatters extremely allergenic pollen.
flavorText.heartgold-soulsilver: It has the world’s largest petals. With every step, the petals shake out heavy clouds of toxic pollen.
flavorText.black-white: Its petals are the largest in the world. As it walks, it scatters extremely allergenic pollen.

flavorText.lets-go-pikachu-eevee: Flaps its broad flower petals to scatter its poisonous pollen. The flapping sound is very loud.
flavorText.sword-shield: It has the world’s largest petals. With every step, the petals shake out heavy clouds of toxic pollen.

flavorText.red-blue: Burrows to suck tree roots. The mushrooms on its back grow by draw ing nutrients from the bug host.
flavorText.yellow: Burrows under the ground to gnaw on tree roots. The mushrooms on its back absorb most of the nutrition.
flavorText.gold-silver: It is doused with mushroom spores when it is born. As its body grows, mushrooms sprout from its back.
flavorText.crystal: The tochukaso growing on this POKéMON's back orders it to extract juice from tree trunks.
flavorText.ruby-sapphire: PARAS has parasitic mushrooms growing on its back called tochukaso. They grow large by drawing nutrients from the BUG POKéMON host. They are highly valued as a medicine for extending life.
flavorText.emerald: A PARAS has parasitic tochukaso mushrooms growing on its back. They grow by drawing nutrients from the host. They are valued as a medicine for long life.
flavorText.firered-leafgreen: Growing out of the bug’s back are mushrooms called tochukaso. The mushrooms grow with the bug host.
flavorText.diamond-pearl: Mushrooms named tochukaso grow on its back. They grow along with the host PARAS.
flavorText.platinum: Mushrooms named tochukaso grow on its back. They grow along with the host PARAS.
flavorText.heartgold-soulsilver: It is doused with mushroom spores when it is born. As its body grows, mushrooms sprout from its back.
flavorText.black-white: Mushrooms named tochukaso grow on its back. They grow along with the host Paras.
flavorText.black-2-white-2: Mushrooms named tochukaso grow on its back. They grow along with the host Paras.
flavorText.x-y: Growing out of the bug’s back are mushrooms called tochukaso. The mushrooms grow with the bug host.
flavorText.omega-ruby-alpha-sapphire: Paras has parasitic mushrooms growing on its back called tochukaso. They grow large by drawing nutrients from this Bug Pokémon host. They are highly valued as a medicine for extending life.
flavorText.sun-moon: No matter how much it eats, the mushrooms growing on its back steal away most of the nutrients it consumes.
flavorText.ultra-sun-ultra-moon: Whether it’s due to a lack of moisture or a lack of nutrients, in Alola the mushrooms on Paras don’t grow up quite right.
flavorText.lets-go-pikachu-eevee: Burrows under the ground to gnaw on tree roots. The mushrooms on its back absorb most of the nutrition.
flavorText.legends-arceus: Sometimes seen at the foot of trees in humid forests. The mushrooms on its back—called tochukaso—are not present on infant specimens and instead emerge as Paras matures.

flavorText.gold-silver: It stays mostly in dark, damp places, the preference not of the bug, but of the big mush rooms on its back.
flavorText.red-blue: A host-parasite pair in which the parasite mushroom has taken over the host bug. Prefers damp places.
flavorText.yellow: The bug host is drained of energy by the mushrooms on its back. They appear to do all the thinking.
flavorText.crystal: When nothing's left to extract from the bug, the mushrooms on its back leave spores on the bug's egg.
flavorText.ruby-sapphire: PARASECT is known to infest large trees en masse and drain nutrients from the lower trunk and roots. When an infested tree dies, they move onto another tree all at once.
flavorText.emerald: PARASECT are known to infest the roots of large trees en masse and drain nutrients. When an infested tree dies, they move onto another tree all at once.
flavorText.firered-leafgreen: It scatters toxic spores from the mushroom cap. In China, the spores are used as herbal medicine.
flavorText.diamond-pearl: A mushroom grown larger than the host’s body controls PARASECT. It scatters poisonous spores.
flavorText.platinum: A mushroom grown larger than the host’s body controls PARASECT. It scatters poisonous spores.
flavorText.heartgold-soulsilver: It stays mostly in dark, damp places, the preference not of the bug, but of the big mushroom on its back.
flavorText.black-white: A mushroom grown larger than the host’s body controls Parasect. It scatters poisonous spores.
flavorText.black-2-white-2: A mushroom grown larger than the host’s body controls Parasect. It scatters poisonous spores.
flavorText.x-y: A mushroom grown larger than the host’s body controls Parasect. It scatters poisonous spores.
flavorText.omega-ruby-alpha-sapphire: Parasect is known to infest large trees en masse and drain nutrients from the lower trunk and roots. When an infested tree dies, they move onto another tree all at once.
flavorText.sun-moon: The large mushroom on its back controls it. It often fights over territory with Shiinotic.
flavorText.ultra-sun-ultra-moon: The bug is mostly dead, with the mushroom on its back having become the main body. If the mushroom comes off, the bug stops moving.
flavorText.lets-go-pikachu-eevee: The bug host is drained of energy by the mushroom on its back. The mushroom appears to do all the thinking.
flavorText.legends-arceus: Mushroom-lacking specimens of this Pokémon lie unmoving in the forest, lending credence to the hypothesis that the large mushroom is in control of Parasect's actions.

flavorText.black-2-white-2: Its big eyes are actually clusters of tiny eyes. At night, its kind is drawn by light.
flavorText.red-blue: Lives in the shadows of tall trees where it eats insects. It is attracted by light at night.
flavorText.yellow: Its large eyes act as radars. In a bright place, you can see that they are clusters of many tiny eyes.
flavorText.gold-silver: Its eyes also function as radar units. It catches and eats small bugs that hide in darkness.
flavorText.crystal: The small bugs it eats appear only at night, so it sleeps in a hole in a tree until night falls.
flavorText.ruby-sapphire: VENONAT is said to have evolved with a coat of thin, stiff hair that covers its entire body for protection. It possesses large eyes that never fail to spot even miniscule prey.
flavorText.emerald: Its coat of thin, stiff hair that covers its entire body is said to have evolved for protection. Its large eyes never fail to spot even miniscule prey.
flavorText.firered-leafgreen: Its eyes act as radar, enabling it to be active in darkness. The eyes can also shoot powerful beams.
flavorText.diamond-pearl: Its big eyes are actually clusters of tiny eyes. At night, its kind is drawn by light.
flavorText.platinum: Its big eyes are actually clusters of tiny eyes. At night, its kind is drawn by light.
flavorText.heartgold-soulsilver: Its eyes also function as radar units. It catches and eats small bugs that hide in darkness.
flavorText.black-white: Its big eyes are actually clusters of tiny eyes. At night, its kind is drawn by light.
flavorText.x-y: Its big eyes are actually clusters of tiny eyes. At night, its kind is drawn by light.
flavorText.omega-ruby-alpha-sapphire: Venonat is said to have evolved with a coat of thin, stiff hair that covers its entire body for protection. It possesses large eyes that never fail to spot even minuscule prey.
flavorText.lets-go-pikachu-eevee: Its large eyes act as radar. In a bright place, you can see that they are clusters of many tiny eyes.

flavorText.red-blue: The dust-like scales covering its wings are color coded to indicate the kinds of poison it has.
flavorText.yellow: The powdery scales on its wings are hard to remove. They also contain poison that leaks out on contact.
flavorText.gold-silver: When it attacks, it flaps its large wings violently to scatter its poi sonous powder all around.
flavorText.crystal: The scales it scatters will paralyze anyone who touches them, making that person unable to stand.
flavorText.ruby-sapphire: VENOMOTH is nocturnal - it is a POKéMON that only becomes active at night. Its favorite prey are small insects that gather around streetlights, attracted by the light in the darkness.
flavorText.emerald: VENOMOTH are nocturnal--they only are active at night. Their favorite prey are insects that gather around streetlights, attracted by the light in the darkness.
flavorText.firered-leafgreen: The wings are covered with dustlike scales. Every time it flaps its wings, it looses highly toxic dust.
flavorText.diamond-pearl: It flutters its wings to scatter dustlike scales. The scales leach toxins if they contact skin.
flavorText.platinum: It flutters its wings to scatter dustlike scales. The scales leach toxins if they contact skin.
flavorText.heartgold-soulsilver: When it attacks, it flaps its large wings violently to scatter its poisonous powder all around.
flavorText.black-white: It flutters its wings to scatter dustlike scales. The scales leach toxins if they contact skin.
flavorText.black-2-white-2: It flutters its wings to scatter dustlike scales. The scales leach toxins if they contact skin.
flavorText.x-y: The scales it scatters will paralyze anyone who touches them, making that person unable to stand.
flavorText.omega-ruby-alpha-sapphire: Venomoth is nocturnal—it is a Pokémon that only becomes active at night. Its favorite prey are small insects that gather around streetlights, attracted by the light in the darkness.
flavorText.lets-go-pikachu-eevee: The powdery scales on its wings are hard to remove from skin. They also contain poison that leaks out on contact.

flavorText.red-blue: Lives about one yard underground where it feeds on plant roots. It sometimes appears above ground.
flavorText.yellow: It prefers dark places. It spends most of its time underground, though it may pop up in caves.
flavorText.gold-silver: Its skin is very thin. If it is exposed to light, its blood heats up, causing it to grow weak.
flavorText.crystal: It digs under ground and chews on tree roots, sticking its head out only when the sun isn't bright.
flavorText.ruby-sapphire: DIGLETT are raised in most farms. The reason is simple - wherever this POKéMON burrows, the soil is left perfectly tilled for planting crops. This soil is made ideal for growing delicious vegetables.
flavorText.emerald: DIGLETT are raised in most farms. The reason is simple--wherever they burrow, the soil is left perfectly tilled for growing delicious crops.
flavorText.firered-leafgreen: It burrows through the ground at a shallow depth. It leaves raised earth in its wake, making it easy to spot.
flavorText.diamond-pearl: A Pokémon that lives underground. Because of its dark habitat, it is repelled by bright sunlight.
flavorText.platinum: A Pokémon that lives underground. Because of its dark habitat, it is repelled by bright sunlight.
flavorText.heartgold-soulsilver: Its skin is very thin. If it is exposed to light, its blood heats up, causing it to grow weak.
flavorText.black-white: A Pokémon that lives underground. Because of its dark habitat, it is repelled by bright sunlight.
flavorText.black-2-white-2: A Pokémon that lives underground. Because of its dark habitat, it is repelled by bright sunlight.
flavorText.x-y: Lives about one yard underground where it feeds on plant roots. It sometimes appears aboveground.
flavorText.omega-ruby-alpha-sapphire: Diglett are raised in most farms. The reason is simple— wherever this Pokémon burrows, the soil is left perfectly tilled for planting crops. This soil is made ideal for growing delicious vegetables.
flavorText.sun-moon: It chews on plant roots underground. Farmers whose vegetables are vulnerable find it can be quite a pest.
flavorText.ultra-sun-ultra-moon: It travels through tunnels that it digs underground. It hates sunlight, so it comes out only after the sun goes down.
flavorText.lets-go-pikachu-eevee: It prefers dark places. It spends most of its time underground, though it may pop up in caves.
flavorText.sword-shield: If a Diglett digs through a field, it leaves the soil perfectly tilled and ideal for planting crops.

flavorText.red-blue: A team of DIGLETT triplets. It triggers huge earthquakes by burrowing 60 miles underground.
flavorText.yellow: A team of triplets that can burrow over 60 MPH. Due to this, some people think it's an earthquake.
flavorText.gold-silver: Its three heads bob separately up and down to loosen the soil nearby, making it easier for it to burrow.
flavorText.crystal: These DIGLETT triplets dig over 60 miles below sea level. No one knows what it's like underground.
flavorText.ruby-sapphire: DUGTRIO are actually triplets that emerged from one body. As a result, each triplet thinks exactly like the other two triplets. They work cooperatively to burrow endlessly.
flavorText.emerald: Because the triplets originally split from one body, they think exactly alike. They work cooperatively to burrow endlessly through the ground.
flavorText.firered-leafgreen: In battle, it digs through the ground and strikes the unsuspecting foe from an unexpected direction.
flavorText.diamond-pearl: Its three heads move alternately, driving it through tough soil to depths of over 60 miles.
flavorText.platinum: Its three heads move alternately, driving it through tough soil to depths of over 60 miles.
flavorText.heartgold-soulsilver: Its three heads bob separately up and down to loosen the soil nearby, making it easier for it to burrow.
flavorText.black-white: Its three heads move alternately, driving it through tough soil to depths of over 60 miles.
flavorText.black-2-white-2: Its three heads move alternately, driving it through tough soil to depths of over 60 miles.
flavorText.x-y: In battle, it digs through the ground and strikes the unsuspecting foe from an unexpected direction.
flavorText.omega-ruby-alpha-sapphire: Dugtrio are actually triplets that emerged from one body. As a result, each triplet thinks exactly like the other two triplets. They work cooperatively to burrow endlessly.
flavorText.sun-moon: This set of triplets moves cooperatively. It’s the power of teamwork that enables this Pokémon to dig to a depth of 60 miles.
flavorText.ultra-sun-ultra-moon: While the three of them normally get along splendidly, on rare occasions a huge fight will break out over which head gets to eat first.
flavorText.lets-go-pikachu-eevee: A team of triplets that can burrow to a depth of 60 miles. It’s reported that this triggers an earthquake.
flavorText.sword-shield: A team of Diglett triplets. It triggers huge earthquakes by burrowing 60 miles underground.

flavorText.red-blue: Adores circular objects. Wanders the streets on a nightly basis to look for dropped loose change.
flavorText.yellow: Appears to be more active at night. It loves round and shiny things. It can't stop from picking them up.
flavorText.gold-silver: It is fascinated by round objects. It can't stop playing with them until it tires and falls asleep.
flavorText.crystal: It loves things that sparkle. When it sees a shiny object, the gold coin on its head shines too.
flavorText.ruby-sapphire: MEOWTH withdraws its sharp claws into its paws to slinkily sneak about without making any incriminating footsteps. For some reason, this POKéMON loves shiny coins that glitter with light.
flavorText.emerald: MEOWTH withdraw their sharp claws into their paws to silently sneak about. For some reason, this POKéMON loves shiny coins that glitter with light.
flavorText.firered-leafgreen: All it does is sleep during the daytime. At night, it patrols its territory with its eyes aglow.
flavorText.diamond-pearl: It is nocturnal in nature. If it spots something shiny, its eyes glitter brightly.
flavorText.platinum: It is nocturnal in nature. If it spots something shiny, its eyes glitter brightly.
flavorText.heartgold-soulsilver: It is fascinated by round objects. It can’t stop playing with them until it tires and falls asleep.
flavorText.black-white: It is nocturnal in nature. If it spots something shiny, its eyes glitter brightly.
flavorText.black-2-white-2: It is nocturnal in nature. If it spots something shiny, its eyes glitter brightly.
flavorText.x-y: It is nocturnal in nature. If it spots something shiny, its eyes glitter brightly.
flavorText.omega-ruby-alpha-sapphire: Meowth withdraws its sharp claws into its paws to slinkily sneak about without making any incriminating footsteps. For some reason, this Pokémon loves shiny coins that glitter with light.
flavorText.sun-moon: It lies around all day, becoming active near dusk. At night, it wanders the city in search of loose change.
flavorText.ultra-sun-ultra-moon: When visiting a junkyard, you may catch sight of it having an intense fight with Murkrow over shiny objects.
flavorText.lets-go-pikachu-eevee: Appears to be more active at night. It loves round and shiny things. It can’t stop itself from picking them up.
flavorText.sword-shield: It loves to collect shiny things. If it’s in a good mood, it might even let its Trainer have a look at its hoard of treasures.

flavorText.red-blue: Although its fur has many admirers, it is tough to raise as a pet because of its fickle meanness.
flavorText.yellow: The gem in its forehead glows on its own! It walks with all the grace and elegance of a proud queen.
flavorText.gold-silver: Many adore it for its sophisticated air. However, it will lash out and scratch for little reason.
flavorText.crystal: Behind its lithe, elegant appearance lies a barbaric side. It will tear apart its prey on a mere whim.
flavorText.ruby-sapphire: PERSIAN has six bold whiskers that give it a look of toughness. The whiskers sense air movements to determine what is in the POKéMON’s surrounding vicinity. It becomes docile if grabbed by the whiskers.
flavorText.emerald: A PERSIAN’s six bold whiskers sense air movements to determine what is in its vicinity. It becomes docile if grabbed by the whiskers.
flavorText.firered-leafgreen: Has a vicious temperament. Beware if it raises its tail straight up. It is a signal that it is about to pounce and bite.
flavorText.diamond-pearl: A very haughty Pokémon. Among fans, the size of the jewel in its forehead is a topic of much talk.
flavorText.platinum: A very haughty Pokémon. Among fans, the size of the jewel in its forehead is a topic of much talk.
flavorText.heartgold-soulsilver: Many adore it for its sophisticated air. However, it will lash out and scratch for little reason.
flavorText.black-white: A very haughty Pokémon. Among fans, the size of the jewel in its forehead is a topic of much talk.
flavorText.black-2-white-2: A very haughty Pokémon. Among fans, the size of the jewel in its forehead is a topic of much talk.
flavorText.x-y: Although its fur has many admirers, it is tough to raise as a pet because of its fickle meanness.
flavorText.omega-ruby-alpha-sapphire: Persian has six bold whiskers that give it a look of toughness. The whiskers sense air movements to determine what is in the Pokémon’s surrounding vicinity. It becomes docile if grabbed by the whiskers.
flavorText.sun-moon: It has a violent temperament. It will attack anything that looks it in the eye. Its sharp claws inflict deep wounds.
flavorText.ultra-sun-ultra-moon: Although the jewel on its forehead appears to be a different color than those of Alolan Persian, it’s mostly made of the same material.
flavorText.lets-go-pikachu-eevee: The gem in its forehead glows on its own! It walks with all the grace and elegance of a proud queen.
flavorText.sword-shield: Getting this prideful Pokémon to warm up to you takes a lot of effort, and it will claw at you the moment it gets annoyed.

flavorText.red-blue: While lulling its enemies with its vacant look, this wily POKéMON will use psychokinetic powers.
flavorText.yellow: Always tormented by headaches. It uses psychic powers, but it is not known if it intends to do so.
flavorText.gold-silver: It has mystical powers but doesn't recall that it has used them. That is why it always looks puzzled.
flavorText.crystal: The only time it can use its psy chic power is when its sleeping brain cells happen to wake.
flavorText.ruby-sapphire: PSYDUCK uses a mysterious power. When it does so, this POKéMON generates brain waves that are supposedly only seen in sleepers. This discovery spurred controversy among scholars.
flavorText.emerald: When its headache intensifies, it starts using strange powers. However, it has no recollection of its powers, so it always looks befuddled and bewildered.
flavorText.firered-leafgreen: It is constantly wracked by a headache. When the headache turns intense, it begins using mysterious powers.
flavorText.diamond-pearl: If its usual headache worsens, it starts exhibiting odd powers. It can’t remember doing so, however.
flavorText.platinum: Overwhelmed by enigmatic abilities, it suffers a constant headache. It sometimes uses mysterious powers.
flavorText.heartgold-soulsilver: It has mystical powers but doesn’t recall that it has used them. That is why it always looks puzzled.
flavorText.black-white: Overwhelmed by enigmatic abilities, it suffers a constant headache. It sometimes uses mysterious powers.
flavorText.black-2-white-2: When headaches stimulate its brain cells, which are usually inactive, it can use a mysterious power.
flavorText.x-y: It is constantly wracked by a headache. When the headache turns intense, it begins using mysterious powers.
flavorText.omega-ruby-alpha-sapphire: Psyduck uses a mysterious power. When it does so, this Pokémon generates brain waves that are supposedly only seen in sleepers. This discovery spurred controversy among scholars.
flavorText.sun-moon: As a result of headaches so fierce they cause it to cry, it sometimes uses psychokinesis without meaning to.
flavorText.ultra-sun-ultra-moon: Using psychokinesis gives it a headache, so it normally passes the time spacing out and doing as little as possible.
flavorText.lets-go-pikachu-eevee: Always tormented by headaches. It uses psychic powers, but whether it intends to do so is not known.
flavorText.sword-shield: Psyduck is constantly beset by headaches. If the Pokémon lets its strange power erupt, apparently the pain subsides for a while.
flavorText.legends-arceus: Suffers perpetual headaches. If the agony grows too great, Psyduck's latent power erupts, contrary to Psyduck's intent. Ergo, I am exploring ways to ease the pain.

flavorText.red-blue: Often seen swim ming elegantly by lake shores. It is often mistaken for the Japanese monster, Kappa.
flavorText.yellow: Its slim and long limbs end in broad flippers. They are used for swim ming gracefully in lakes.
flavorText.gold-silver: When it swims at full speed using its long, webbed limbs, its fore head somehow be gins to glow.
flavorText.crystal: It swims grace fully along on the quiet, slow-moving rivers and lakes of which it is so fond.
flavorText.ruby-sapphire: The webbed flippers on its forelegs and hind legs and the streamlined body of GOLDUCK give it frightening speed. This POKéMON is definitely much faster than even the most athletic swimmer.
flavorText.emerald: A GOLDUCK is an adept swimmer. It sometimes joins competitive swimmers in training. It uses psychic powers when its forehead shimmers with light.
flavorText.firered-leafgreen: The forelegs are webbed, helping to make it an adept swimmer. It can be seen swimming elegantly in lakes, etc.
flavorText.diamond-pearl: A Pokémon that lives in lakes. It swims faster than any human swimming champion.
flavorText.platinum: It is seen swimming dynamically and elegantly using its well-developed limbs and flippers.
flavorText.heartgold-soulsilver: When it swims at full speed using its long, webbed limbs, its forehead somehow begins to glow.
flavorText.black-white: It is seen swimming dynamically and elegantly using its well-developed limbs and flippers.
flavorText.black-2-white-2: When its forehead shines mysteriously, Golduck can use the full extent of its power.
flavorText.x-y: It appears by waterways at dusk. It may use telekinetic powers if its forehead glows mysteriously.
flavorText.omega-ruby-alpha-sapphire: The webbed flippers on its forelegs and hind legs and the streamlined body of Golduck give it frightening speed. This Pokémon is definitely much faster than even the most athletic swimmer.
flavorText.sun-moon: It is said that the red part of its forehead grants supernatural powers to those who possess one, so it was over-hunted in the past.
flavorText.ultra-sun-ultra-moon: Even fast-swimming fish Pokémon can be disabled by Golduck. It brings them to a standstill and seizes them.
flavorText.lets-go-pikachu-eevee: Its long, slim limbs end in broad flippers. They are used for swimming gracefully in lakes.
flavorText.sword-shield: This Pokémon lives in gently flowing rivers. It paddles through the water with its long limbs, putting its graceful swimming skills on display.
flavorText.legends-arceus: Its body is strong, and it has webbing on its hands and feet. Golduck can swim easily through rough seas, clawing its way through the high waves.

flavorText.red-blue: Extremely quick to anger. It could be docile one moment then thrashing away the next instant.
flavorText.yellow: An agile POKéMON that lives in trees. It angers easily and will not hesitate to attack anything.
flavorText.gold-silver: It is extremely ill-tempered. Groups of them will attack any handy target for no reason.
flavorText.crystal: It lives in groups in the treetops. If it loses sight of its group, it becomes infuriated by its loneliness.
flavorText.ruby-sapphire: When MANKEY starts shaking and its nasal breathing turns rough, it’s a sure sign that it is becoming angry. However, because it goes into a towering rage almost instantly, it is impossible for anyone to flee its wrath.
flavorText.emerald: When it starts shaking and its nasal breathing turns rough, it’s a sure sign of anger. However, since this happens instantly, there is no time to flee.
flavorText.firered-leafgreen: Light and agile on its feet, and ferocious in temperament. When angered, it flies into an uncontrollable frenzy.
flavorText.diamond-pearl: It lives in treetop colonies. If one becomes enraged, the whole colony rampages for no reason.
flavorText.platinum: It lives in treetop colonies. If one becomes enraged, the whole colony rampages for no reason.
flavorText.heartgold-soulsilver: It is extremely ill-tempered. Groups of them will attack any handy target for no reason.
flavorText.black-white: It lives in treetop colonies. If one becomes enraged, the whole colony rampages for no reason.
flavorText.black-2-white-2: It lives in treetop colonies. If one becomes enraged, the whole colony rampages for no reason.
flavorText.x-y: It’s unsafe to approach if it gets violently enraged for no reason and can’t distinguish friends from foes.
flavorText.omega-ruby-alpha-sapphire: When Mankey starts shaking and its nasal breathing turns rough, it’s a sure sign that it is becoming angry. However, because it goes into a towering rage almost instantly, it is impossible for anyone to flee its wrath.
flavorText.sun-moon: It can spontaneously become enraged. Everyone near it clears out as it rampages, and the resulting loneliness makes it angrier still.
flavorText.ultra-sun-ultra-moon: The smallest of things could cause it to lose its temper. Because it doesn’t hold in its stress, this Pokémon can live a long time.
flavorText.lets-go-pikachu-eevee: An agile Pokémon that lives in trees. It angers easily and will not hesitate to attack anything.

flavorText.red-blue: Always furious and tenacious to boot. It will not abandon chasing its quarry until it is caught.
flavorText.yellow: It stops being angry only when nobody else is around. To view this moment is very difficult.
flavorText.gold-silver: If approached while asleep, it may awaken and angrily give chase in a groggy state of semi-sleep.
flavorText.crystal: It will beat up anyone who makes it mad, even if it has to chase them until the end of the world.
flavorText.ruby-sapphire: When PRIMEAPE becomes furious, its blood circulation is boosted. In turn, its muscles are made even stronger. However, it also becomes much less intelligent at the same time.
flavorText.emerald: When it becomes furious, its blood circulation becomes more robust, and its muscles are made stronger. But it also becomes much less intelligent.
flavorText.firered-leafgreen: It is always outrageously furious. If it gives chase, it will tenaciously track the target no matter how far.
flavorText.diamond-pearl: It grows angry if you see its eyes and gets angrier if you run. If you beat it, it gets even madder.
flavorText.platinum: It grows angry if you see its eyes and gets angrier if you run. If you beat it, it gets even madder.
flavorText.heartgold-soulsilver: If approached while asleep, it may awaken and angrily give chase in a groggy state of semi-sleep.
flavorText.black-white: It grows angry if you see its eyes and gets angrier if you run. If you beat it, it gets even madder.
flavorText.black-2-white-2: It grows angry if you see its eyes and gets angrier if you run. If you beat it, it gets even madder.
flavorText.x-y: It stops being angry only when nobody else is around. To view this moment is very difficult.
flavorText.omega-ruby-alpha-sapphire: When Primeape becomes furious, its blood circulation is boosted. In turn, its muscles are made even stronger. However, it also becomes much less intelligent at the same time.
flavorText.sun-moon: It has been known to become so angry that it dies as a result. Its face looks peaceful in death, however.
flavorText.ultra-sun-ultra-moon: It will never forgive opponents who have angered it. Even after it has beaten them down until they can’t move, it never ever forgives.
flavorText.lets-go-pikachu-eevee: It stops being angry only when nobody else is around. To view this moment is very difficult.

flavorText.red-blue: Very protective of its territory. It will bark and bite to repel intruders from its space.
flavorText.yellow: A POKéMON with a friendly nature. However, it will bark fiercely at anything invading its territory.
flavorText.gold-silver: It has a brave and trustworthy na ture. It fear lessly stands up to bigger and stronger foes.
flavorText.crystal: It controls a big territory. If it detects an unknown smell, it roars loudly to force out the intruder.
flavorText.ruby-sapphire: GROWLITHE has a superb sense of smell. Once it smells anything, this POKéMON won’t forget the scent, no matter what. It uses its advanced olfactory sense to determine the emotions of other living things.
flavorText.emerald: Its superb sense of smell ensures that this POKéMON won’t forget any scent, no matter what. It uses its sense of smell to detect the emotions of others.
flavorText.firered-leafgreen: Very friendly and faithful to people. It will try to repel enemies by barking and biting.
flavorText.diamond-pearl: A Pokémon with a loyal nature. It will remain motionless until it is given an order by its Trainer.
flavorText.platinum: A Pokémon with a loyal nature. It will remain motionless until it is given an order by its Trainer.
flavorText.heartgold-soulsilver: It has a brave and trustworthy nature. It fearlessly stands up to bigger and stronger foes.
flavorText.black-white: A Pokémon with a loyal nature. It will remain motionless until it is given an order by its Trainer.
flavorText.black-2-white-2: Extremely loyal to its Trainer, it will bark at those who approach the Trainer unexpectedly and run them out of town.
flavorText.x-y: Very friendly and faithful to people. It will try to repel enemies by barking and biting.
flavorText.omega-ruby-alpha-sapphire: Growlithe has a superb sense of smell. Once it smells anything, this Pokémon won’t forget the scent, no matter what. It uses its advanced olfactory sense to determine the emotions of other living things.
flavorText.sun-moon: It’s both clever and loyal, but if a stranger tries to invade its territory, it barks threateningly.
flavorText.ultra-sun-ultra-moon: While it’s quite friendly toward humans once it’s grown used to them, in the wild it must be quite fierce to defend its territory from Rockruff.
flavorText.lets-go-pikachu-eevee: A Pokémon with a friendly nature. However, it will bark fiercely at anything invading its territory.
flavorText.sword-shield: It has a brave and trustworthy nature. It fearlessly stands up to bigger and stronger foes.
flavorText.legends-arceus: They patrol their territory in pairs. I believe the igneous rock components in the fur of this species are the result of volcanic activity in its habitat.

flavorText.red-blue: A POKéMON that has been admired since the past for its beauty. It runs agilely as if on wings.
flavorText.yellow: A legendary POKé MON in China. Many people are charmed by its grace and beauty while running.
flavorText.gold-silver: This legendary Chinese POKEMON is considered magnif icent. Many people are enchanted by its grand mane.
flavorText.crystal: An ancient picture scroll shows that people were attracted to its movement as it ran through prairies.
flavorText.ruby-sapphire: ARCANINE is known for its high speed. It is said to be capable of running over 6,200 miles in a single day and night. The fire that blazes wildly within this POKéMON’s body is its source of power.
flavorText.emerald: This fleet-footed POKéMON is said to run over 6,200 miles in a single day and night. The fire that blazes wildly within its body is its source of power.
flavorText.firered-leafgreen: A POKéMON that is described in Chinese legends. It is said to race at an unbelievable speed.
flavorText.diamond-pearl: Its proud and regal appearance has captured the hearts of people since long ago.
flavorText.platinum: Its proud and regal appearance has captured the hearts of people since long ago.
flavorText.heartgold-soulsilver: This legendary Chinese Pokémon is considered magnificent. Many people are enchanted by its grand mane.
flavorText.black-white: Its proud and regal appearance has captured the hearts of people since long ago.
flavorText.black-2-white-2: The sight of it running over 6,200 miles in a single day and night has captivated many people.
flavorText.x-y: A Pokémon that has long been admired for its beauty. It runs agilely as if on wings.
flavorText.omega-ruby-alpha-sapphire: Arcanine is known for its high speed. It is said to be capable of running over 6,200 miles in a single day and night. The fire that blazes wildly within this Pokémon’s body is its source of power.
flavorText.sun-moon: Overflowing with beauty and majesty, this strong Pokémon appears in ancient Eastern folklore.
flavorText.ultra-sun-ultra-moon: Legends tell of its fighting alongside a general and conquering a whole country.
flavorText.lets-go-pikachu-eevee: A legendary Pokémon in the East. Many people are charmed by the grace and beauty of its running.
flavorText.sword-shield: The sight of it running over 6,200 miles in a single day and night has captivated many people.
flavorText.legends-arceus: Snaps at its foes with fangs cloaked in blazing flame. Despite its bulk, it deftly feints every which way, leading opponents on a deceptively merry chase as it all but dances around them.

flavorText.red-blue: Its newly grown legs prevent it from running. It appears to prefer swimming than trying to stand.
flavorText.yellow: The direction of the spiral on the belly differs by area. It is more adept at swimming than walking.
flavorText.gold-silver: Because it is in ept at walking on its newly grown legs, it always swims around in water.
flavorText.crystal: The swirl on its belly is its insides showing through the skin. It looks clearer after it eats.
flavorText.ruby-sapphire: POLIWAG has a very thin skin. It is possible to see the POKéMON’s spiral innards right through the skin. Despite its thinness, however, the skin is also very flexible. Even sharp fangs bounce right off it.
flavorText.emerald: It is possible to see this POKéMON’s spiral innards right through its thin skin. However, the skin is also very flexible. Even sharp fangs bounce right off it.
flavorText.firered-leafgreen: Its slick black skin is thin and damp. A part of its internal organs can be seen through the skin as a spiral pattern.
flavorText.diamond-pearl: Its skin is so thin, its internal organs are visible. It has trouble walking on its newly grown feet.
flavorText.platinum: Its skin is so thin, its internal organs are visible. It has trouble walking on its newly grown feet.
flavorText.heartgold-soulsilver: Because it is inept at walking on its newly grown legs, it always swims around in water.
flavorText.black-white: Its skin is so thin, its internal organs are visible. It has trouble walking on its newly grown feet.
flavorText.black-2-white-2: Its skin is so thin, its internal organs are visible. It has trouble walking on its newly grown feet.
flavorText.x-y: Its slick black skin is thin and damp. A part of its internal organs can be seen through the skin as a spiral pattern.
flavorText.omega-ruby-alpha-sapphire: Poliwag has a very thin skin. It is possible to see the Pokémon’s spiral innards right through the skin. Despite its thinness, however, the skin is also very flexible. Even sharp fangs bounce right off it.
flavorText.sun-moon: The swirl on its belly is its internal organs showing through. If the swirl is tinged white, that means it’s affected by some disease.
flavorText.ultra-sun-ultra-moon: Despite the danger, it wants to come up on land. So it does its best to waddle along, but when an enemy finds it, it rushes back to the water.
flavorText.lets-go-pikachu-eevee: The direction of the spiral on the belly differs by area. It is more adept at swimming than walking.
flavorText.sword-shield: For Poliwag, swimming is easier than walking. The swirl pattern on its belly is actually part of the Pokémon’s innards showing through the skin.

flavorText.red-blue: Capable of living in or out of water. When out of water, it sweats to keep its body slimy.
flavorText.yellow: Under attack, it uses its belly spiral to put the foe to sleep. It then makes its escape.
flavorText.gold-silver: The swirl on its belly subtly un dulates. Staring at it may gradual ly cause drowsi ness.
flavorText.crystal: Though it is skilled at walk ing, it prefers to live underwater where there is less danger.
flavorText.ruby-sapphire: The surface of POLIWHIRL’s body is always wet and slick with an oily fluid. Because of this greasy covering, it can easily slip and slide out of the clutches of any enemy in battle.
flavorText.emerald: Its body surface is always wet and slick with an oily fluid. Because of this greasy covering, it can easily slip and slide out of the clutches of any enemy in battle.
flavorText.firered-leafgreen: Its two legs are well developed. Even though it can live on the ground, it prefers living in water.
flavorText.diamond-pearl: The spiral pattern on its belly subtly undulates. Staring at it gradually causes drowsiness.
flavorText.platinum: The spiral pattern on its belly subtly undulates. Staring at it gradually causes drowsiness.
flavorText.heartgold-soulsilver: The swirl on its belly subtly undulates. Staring at it may gradually cause drowsiness.
flavorText.black-white: The spiral pattern on its belly subtly undulates. Staring at it gradually causes drowsiness.
flavorText.black-2-white-2: The spiral pattern on its belly subtly undulates. Staring at it gradually causes drowsiness.
flavorText.x-y: It can live in or out of water. When out of water, it constantly sweats to keep its body slimy.
flavorText.omega-ruby-alpha-sapphire: The surface of Poliwhirl’s body is always wet and slick with a slimy fluid. Because of this slippery covering, it can easily slip and slide out of the clutches of any enemy in battle.
flavorText.sun-moon: Although it can live on land, it prefers to stay in the water, where it has fewer natural enemies.
flavorText.ultra-sun-ultra-moon: Although it has become capable of living on land, it spends its time in the water, where its prey, fish Pokémon, are plentiful.
flavorText.lets-go-pikachu-eevee: Under attack, it uses its belly spiral to put the foe to sleep. It then makes its escape.
flavorText.sword-shield: Staring at the swirl on its belly causes drowsiness. This trait of Poliwhirl’s has been used in place of lullabies to get children to go to sleep.

flavorText.red-blue: An adept swimmer at both the front crawl and breast stroke. Easily overtakes the best human swimmers.
flavorText.yellow: Swims powerfully using all the muscles in its body. It can even overtake champion swimmers.
flavorText.gold-silver: This strong and skilled swimmer is even capable of crossing the Pacific Ocean just by kicking.
flavorText.crystal: It can use its well-developed arms and legs to run on the surface of the water for a split second.
flavorText.ruby-sapphire: POLIWRATH’s highly developed, brawny muscles never grow fatigued, however much it exercises. It is so tirelessly strong, this POKéMON can swim back and forth across the Pacific Ocean without effort.
flavorText.emerald: Its highly developed muscles never grow fatigued, however much it exercises. This POKéMON can swim back and forth across the Pacific Ocean without effort.
flavorText.firered-leafgreen: An adept swimmer, it knows the front crawl, butterfly, and more. It is faster than the best human swimmers.
flavorText.diamond-pearl: With its extremely tough muscles, it can keep swimming in the Pacific Ocean without resting.
flavorText.platinum: With its extremely tough muscles, it can keep swimming in the Pacific Ocean without resting.
flavorText.heartgold-soulsilver: This strong and skilled swimmer is even capable of crossing the Pacific Ocean just by kicking.
flavorText.black-white: With its extremely tough muscles, it can keep swimming in the Pacific Ocean without resting.
flavorText.black-2-white-2: With its extremely tough muscles, it can keep swimming in the Pacific Ocean without resting.
flavorText.x-y: With its extremely tough muscles, it can keep swimming in the Pacific Ocean without resting.
flavorText.omega-ruby-alpha-sapphire: Poliwrath’s highly developed, brawny muscles never grow fatigued, however much it exercises. It is so tirelessly strong, this Pokémon can swim back and forth across the ocean without effort.
flavorText.sun-moon: Poliwrath in the Alola region are strong swimmers that use the breaststroke. Many children learn to swim by imitating Poliwrath.
flavorText.ultra-sun-ultra-moon: It’s quite a gifted swimmer, even among Water-type Pokémon, but it normally spends its time on land.
flavorText.lets-go-pikachu-eevee: Swims powerfully using all the muscles in its body. It can even overtake world-class swimmers.
flavorText.sword-shield: Its body is solid muscle. When swimming through cold seas, Poliwrath uses its impressive arms to smash through drift ice and plow forward.

flavorText.red-blue: Using its ability to read minds, it will identify impending danger and TELEPORT to safety.
flavorText.yellow: Sleeps 18 hours a day. If it senses danger, it will teleport itself to safety even as it sleeps.
flavorText.gold-silver: It senses impend ing attacks and TELEPORTS away to safety before the actual attacks can strike.
flavorText.crystal: It hypnotizes itself so that it can teleport away when it senses danger, even if it is asleep.
flavorText.ruby-sapphire: ABRA sleeps for eighteen hours a day. However, it can sense the presence of foes even while it is sleeping. In such a situation, this POKéMON immediately teleports to safety.
flavorText.emerald: A POKéMON that sleeps 18 hours a day. Observation revealed that it uses TELEPORT to change its location once every hour.
flavorText.firered-leafgreen: It sleeps for 18 hours a day. It uses a variety of extrasensory powers even while asleep.
flavorText.diamond-pearl: It sleeps for 18 hours a day. Even when awake, it teleports itself while remaining seated.
flavorText.platinum: Using its psychic power is such a strain on its brain that it needs to sleep for 18 hours a day.
flavorText.heartgold-soulsilver: It senses impending attacks and teleports away to safety before the actual attacks can strike.
flavorText.black-white: Using its psychic power is such a strain on its brain that it needs to sleep for 18 hours a day.
flavorText.black-2-white-2: Using its psychic power is such a strain on its brain that it needs to sleep for 18 hours a day.
flavorText.x-y: It sleeps for 18 hours a day. It uses a variety of extrasensory powers even while asleep.
flavorText.omega-ruby-alpha-sapphire: Abra sleeps for eighteen hours a day. However, it can sense the presence of foes even while it is sleeping. In such a situation, this Pokémon immediately teleports to safety.
flavorText.sun-moon: It sleeps 18 hours a day. Even while sleeping, it will teleport itself to treetops and pick and eat berries there.
flavorText.ultra-sun-ultra-moon: It uses various psychic powers even while it’s sleeping, so you can’t tell whether or not it’s awake.
flavorText.lets-go-pikachu-eevee: Sleeps 18 hours a day. If it senses danger, it will teleport itself to safety even as it sleeps.
flavorText.sword-shield: This Pokémon uses its psychic powers while it sleeps. The contents of Abra’s dreams affect the powers that the Pokémon wields.
flavorText.legends-arceus: Spends 18 hours of the day sleeping. Even while asleep, Abra can control its psychic powers—should danger approach, the Pokémon will simply teleport away.

flavorText.red-blue: It emits special alpha waves from its body that induce headaches just by being close by.
flavorText.yellow: Many odd things happen if this POKéMON is close by. For example, it makes clocks run backwards.
flavorText.gold-silver: It possesses strong spiritual power. The more danger it faces, the stronger its psychic power.
flavorText.crystal: When it closes its eyes, twice as many alpha parti cles come out of the surface of its body.
flavorText.ruby-sapphire: KADABRA emits a peculiar alpha wave if it develops a headache. Only those people with a particularly strong psyche can hope to become a TRAINER of this POKéMON.
flavorText.emerald: It is rumored that a boy with psychic abilities suddenly transformed into KADABRA while he was assisting research into extrasensory powers.
flavorText.firered-leafgreen: It happened one morning - a boy with extrasensory powers awoke in bed transformed into KADABRA.
flavorText.diamond-pearl: If one is nearby, an eerie shadow appears on TV screens. Seeing the shadow is said to bring bad luck.
flavorText.platinum: It stares at its silver spoon to focus its mind. It emits more alpha waves while doing so.
flavorText.heartgold-soulsilver: It possesses strong spiritual power. The more danger it faces, the stronger its psychic power.
flavorText.black-white: It stares at its silver spoon to focus its mind. It emits more alpha waves while doing so.
flavorText.black-2-white-2: It stares at its silver spoon to focus its mind. It emits more alpha waves while doing so.
flavorText.x-y: When it uses its psychic power, it emits strong alpha waves that can ruin precision devices.
flavorText.omega-ruby-alpha-sapphire: Kadabra emits a peculiar alpha wave if it develops a headache. Only those people with a particularly strong psyche can hope to become a Trainer of this Pokémon.
flavorText.sun-moon: A theory exists that this Pokémon was a young boy who couldn’t control his psychic powers and ended up transformed into this Pokémon.
flavorText.ultra-sun-ultra-moon: It stares at a silver spoon to amplify its psychic powers before it lets loose. Apparently, gold spoons are no good.
flavorText.lets-go-pikachu-eevee: Many odd things happen if this Pokémon is close by. For example, it makes clocks run backward.
flavorText.sword-shield: Using its psychic power, Kadabra levitates as it sleeps. It uses its springy tail as a pillow.
flavorText.legends-arceus: There are rumors that a child with mystical powers became a Kadabra; however, this remains unverified. I suspect that the spoon Kadabra holds enhances its brain waves.

flavorText.red-blue: Its brain can out perform a super computer. Its intelligence quotient is said to be 5,000.
flavorText.yellow: A POKéMON that can memorize anything. It never forgets what it learns-- that's why this POKéMON is smart.
flavorText.gold-silver: Closing both its eyes heightens all its other senses. This enables it to use its abilities to their extremes.
flavorText.crystal: It has an IQ of 5000. It calcu lates many things in order to gain the edge in every battle.
flavorText.ruby-sapphire: ALAKAZAM’s brain continually grows, making its head far too heavy to support with its neck. This POKéMON holds its head up using its psychokinetic power instead.
flavorText.emerald: While it has strong psychic abilities and high intelligence, an ALAKAZAM’s muscles are very weak. It uses psychic power to move its body.
flavorText.firered-leafgreen: It does not like physical attacks very much. Instead, it freely uses extra sensory powers to defeat foes.
flavorText.diamond-pearl: Its superb memory lets it recall everything it has experienced from birth. Its IQ exceeds 5,000.
flavorText.platinum: The spoons clutched in its hands are said to have been created by its psychic powers.
flavorText.heartgold-soulsilver: Closing both its eyes heightens all its other senses. This enables it to use its abilities to their extremes.
flavorText.black-white: The spoons clutched in its hands are said to have been created by its psychic powers.
flavorText.black-2-white-2: The spoons clutched in its hands are said to have been created by its psychic powers.
flavorText.x-y: Its brain cells multiply continually until it dies. As a result, it remembers everything.
flavorText.omega-ruby-alpha-sapphire: Alakazam’s brain continually grows, making its head far too heavy to support with its neck. This Pokémon holds its head up using its psychokinetic power instead.
flavorText.sun-moon: It is said to have an IQ of approximately 5,000. Its overflowing psychokinetic powers cause headaches to anyone nearby.
flavorText.ultra-sun-ultra-moon: Alakazam uses its psychic powers to make the spoons it carries. Each spoon is an original that there’s only one of in the whole world.
flavorText.lets-go-pikachu-eevee: A Pokémon that can memorize anything. It never forgets what it learns—that’s why this Pokémon is smart.
flavorText.sword-shield: It has an incredibly high level of intelligence. Some say that Alakazam remembers everything that ever happens to it, from birth till death.
flavorText.legends-arceus: The longer Alakazam lives, the larger and heavier its head becomes. Our tests have shown that the strength of its psychic powers correlates positively to the weight of its head.

flavorText.red-blue: Loves to build its muscles. It trains in all styles of martial arts to become even stronger.
flavorText.yellow: Very powerful in spite of its small size. Its mastery of many types of martial arts makes it very tough.
flavorText.gold-silver: Always brimming with power, it passes time by lifting boulders. Doing so makes it even stronger.
flavorText.crystal: It trains by lifting rocks in the mountains. It can even pick up a GRAVELER with ease.
flavorText.ruby-sapphire: MACHOP’s muscles are special - they never get sore no matter how much they are used in exercise. This POKéMON has sufficient power to hurl a hundred adult humans.
flavorText.emerald: It continually undertakes strenuous training to master all forms of martial arts. Its strength lets it easily hoist a sumo wrestler onto its shoulders.
flavorText.firered-leafgreen: Its whole body is composed of muscles. Even though it’s the size of a human child, it can hurl 100 grown-ups.
flavorText.diamond-pearl: It hefts a GRAVELER repeatedly to strengthen its entire body. It uses every type of martial arts.
flavorText.platinum: Though small in stature, it is powerful enough to easily heft and throw a number of GEODUDE at once.
flavorText.heartgold-soulsilver: Always brimming with power, it passes time by lifting boulders. Doing so makes it even stronger.
flavorText.black-white: Though small in stature, it is powerful enough to easily heft and throw a number of Geodude at once.
flavorText.black-2-white-2: Though small in stature, it is powerful enough to easily heft and throw a number of Geodude at once.
flavorText.x-y: It hefts a Graveler repeatedly to strengthen its entire body. It uses every type of martial arts.
flavorText.omega-ruby-alpha-sapphire: Machop’s muscles are special—they never get sore no matter how much they are used in exercise. This Pokémon has sufficient power to hurl a hundred adult humans.
flavorText.sun-moon: It loves working out. As it gazes at its muscles, which continue to swell day by day, it becomes more and more dedicated to its training.
flavorText.ultra-sun-ultra-moon: Once this Pokémon has gained enough confidence and muscle from training with its friends, it challenges Makuhita to a battle.
flavorText.lets-go-pikachu-eevee: Very powerful in spite of its small size. Its mastery of many types of martial arts makes it very tough.
