flavorText.sword-shield: Its whole body is composed of muscles. Even though it’s the size of a human child, it can hurl 100 grown-ups.
flavorText.legends-arceus: Though as small as a child, it has strength enough to easily throw a well-built adult. Striving to become ever stronger, Machop trains by carrying a Graveler on its shoulders.

flavorText.black-2-white-2: It happily carries heavy cargo to toughen up. It willingly does hard work for people.
flavorText.red-blue: Its muscular body is so powerful, it must wear a power save belt to be able to regulate its motions.
flavorText.yellow: The belt around its waist holds back its energy. Without it, this POKéMON would be unstoppable.
flavorText.gold-silver: It always goes at its full power, but this very tough and durable POKéMON never gets tired.
flavorText.crystal: This tough POKéMON always stays in the zone. Its muscles become thicker after every battle.
flavorText.ruby-sapphire: MACHOKE’s thoroughly toned muscles possess the hardness of steel. This POKéMON has so much strength, it can easily hold aloft a sumo wrestler on just one finger.
flavorText.emerald: A belt is worn by a MACHOKE to keep its overwhelming power under control. Because it is so dangerous, no one has ever removed the belt.
flavorText.firered-leafgreen: Its formidable body never gets tired. It helps people by doing work such as the moving of heavy goods.
flavorText.diamond-pearl: MACHOKE’s boundless power is very dangerous, so it wears a belt that suppresses its energy.
flavorText.platinum: It happily carries heavy cargo to toughen up. It willingly does hard work for people.
flavorText.heartgold-soulsilver: It always goes at its full power, but this very tough and durable Pokémon never gets tired.
flavorText.black-white: It happily carries heavy cargo to toughen up. It willingly does hard work for people.
flavorText.x-y: Its muscular body is so powerful, it must wear a power-save belt to be able to regulate its motions.
flavorText.omega-ruby-alpha-sapphire: Machoke’s thoroughly toned muscles possess the hardness of steel. This Pokémon has so much strength, it can easily hold aloft a sumo wrestler on just one finger.
flavorText.sun-moon: As a result of its continual workouts, it has developed tremendous power. It uses that power to help people with their work.
flavorText.ultra-sun-ultra-moon: When it encounters an enemy that’s truly mighty, this Pokémon removes the power-save belt from its waist and unleashes its full power.
flavorText.lets-go-pikachu-eevee: The belt around its waist holds back its energy. Without it, this Pokémon would be unstoppable.
flavorText.sword-shield: Its muscular body is so powerful, it must wear a power-save belt to be able to regulate its motions.
flavorText.legends-arceus: A sturdy creature boasting a robust physique and boundless stamina. Loves training above all else and voluntarily assists with tasks such as construction and clearing land.

flavorText.red-blue: Using its heavy muscles, it throws powerful punches that can send the victim clear over the horizon.
flavorText.yellow: One arm alone can move mountains. Using all four arms, this POKéMON fires off awesome punches.
flavorText.gold-silver: It quickly swings its four arms to rock its opponents with ceaseless punches and chops from all angles.
flavorText.crystal: With four arms that react more quickly than it can think, it can execute many punches at once.
flavorText.ruby-sapphire: MACHAMP has the power to hurl anything aside. However, trying to do any work requiring care and dexterity causes its arms to get tangled. This POKéMON tends to leap into action before it thinks.
flavorText.emerald: It is impossible to defend against punches and chops doled out by its four arms. Its fighting spirit flares up when it faces a tough opponent.
flavorText.firered-leafgreen: Its four ruggedly developed arms can launch a flurry of 1,000 punches in just two seconds.
flavorText.diamond-pearl: It punches with its four arms at blinding speed. It can launch 1,000 punches in two seconds.
flavorText.platinum: Its four muscled arms slam foes with powerful punches and chops at blinding speed.
flavorText.heartgold-soulsilver: It quickly swings its four arms to rock its opponents with ceaseless punches and chops from all angles.
flavorText.black-white: Its four muscled arms slam foes with powerful punches and chops at blinding speed.
flavorText.black-2-white-2: Its four muscled arms slam foes with powerful punches and chops at blinding speed.
flavorText.x-y: Its four ruggedly developed arms can launch a flurry of 1,000 punches in just two seconds.
flavorText.omega-ruby-alpha-sapphire: Machamp has the power to hurl anything aside. However, trying to do any work requiring care and dexterity causes its arms to get tangled. This Pokémon tends to leap into action before it thinks.
flavorText.sun-moon: It unleashes megaton-level punches that send opponents flying clear over the horizon.
flavorText.ultra-sun-ultra-moon: It grasps its opponents with its four arms and twists them up in an intricate hold. People call it “the Machamp special.”
flavorText.lets-go-pikachu-eevee: One arm alone can move mountains. Using all four arms, this Pokémon fires off awesome punches.
flavorText.sword-shield: It quickly swings its four arms to rock its opponents with ceaseless punches and chops from all angles.
flavorText.legends-arceus: In close combat, its four arms afford it offensive and defensive supremacy. In but a blink, this valiant Pokémon can overwhelm its foes with more than 1,000 blows from its fists.

flavorText.red-blue: A carnivorous POKéMON that traps and eats bugs. It uses its root feet to soak up needed moisture.
flavorText.yellow: Prefers hot and humid places. It ensnares tiny insects with its vines and devours them.
flavorText.gold-silver: Even though its body is extremely skinny, it is blindingly fast when catching its prey.
flavorText.crystal: If it notices anything that moves, it immediately flings its vine at the object.
flavorText.ruby-sapphire: BELLSPROUT’s thin and flexible body lets it bend and sway to avoid any attack, however strong it may be. From its mouth, this POKéMON spits a corrosive fluid that melts even iron.
flavorText.emerald: A BELLSPROUT’s thin and flexible body lets it bend and sway to avoid any attack, however strong it may be. From its mouth, it leaks a fluid that melts even iron.
flavorText.firered-leafgreen: Its bud looks like a human face. Because of the bud, it is rumored to be a type of legendary mandrake plant.
flavorText.diamond-pearl: It prefers hot and humid environments. It is quick at capturing prey with its vines.
flavorText.platinum: It prefers hot and humid environments. It is quick at capturing prey with its vines.
flavorText.heartgold-soulsilver: Even though its body is extremely skinny, it is blindingly fast when catching its prey.
flavorText.black-white: It prefers hot and humid environments. It is quick at capturing prey with its vines.
flavorText.black-2-white-2: It prefers hot and humid environments. It is quick at capturing prey with its vines.
flavorText.x-y: Even though its body is extremely skinny, it is blindingly fast when catching its prey.
flavorText.omega-ruby-alpha-sapphire: Bellsprout’s thin and flexible body lets it bend and sway to avoid any attack, however strong it may be. From its mouth, this Pokémon spits a corrosive fluid that melts even iron.
flavorText.lets-go-pikachu-eevee: Prefers hot and humid places. It ensnares tiny bugs with its vines and devours them.

flavorText.black-2-white-2: A Pokémon that appears to be a plant. It captures unwary prey by dousing them with a toxic powder.
flavorText.red-blue: It spits out POISONPOWDER to immobilize the enemy and then finishes it with a spray of ACID.
flavorText.yellow: When hungry, it swallows anything that moves. Its hapless prey is melted inside by strong acids.
flavorText.gold-silver: Even though it is filled with ACID, it does not melt because it also oozes a neutral izing fluid.
flavorText.crystal: When it's hungry, it swings its razor-sharp leaves, slicing up any unlucky object nearby for food.
flavorText.ruby-sapphire: WEEPINBELL has a large hook on its rear end. At night, the POKéMON hooks on to a tree branch and goes to sleep. If it moves around in its sleep, it may wake up to find itself on the ground.
flavorText.emerald: At night, a WEEPINBELL hangs on to a tree branch with its hooked rear and sleeps. If it moves around in its sleep, it may wake up to find itself on the ground.
flavorText.firered-leafgreen: The leafy parts act as cutters for slashing foes. It spits a fluid that dissolves everything.
flavorText.diamond-pearl: A Pokémon that appears to be a plant. It captures unwary prey by dousing them with a toxic powder.
flavorText.platinum: A Pokémon that appears to be a plant. It captures unwary prey by dousing them with a toxic powder.
flavorText.heartgold-soulsilver: Even though it is filled with acid, it does not melt because it also oozes a protective fluid.
flavorText.black-white: A Pokémon that appears to be a plant. It captures unwary prey by dousing them with a toxic powder.
flavorText.x-y: The leafy parts act as cutters for slashing foes. It spits a fluid that dissolves everything.
flavorText.omega-ruby-alpha-sapphire: Weepinbell has a large hook on its rear end. At night, the Pokémon hooks on to a tree branch and goes to sleep. If it moves around in its sleep, it may wake up to find itself on the ground.
flavorText.lets-go-pikachu-eevee: When hungry, it swallows anything that moves. Its hapless prey is dissolved by strong acids.

flavorText.red-blue: Said to live in huge colonies deep in jungles, although no one has ever returned from there.
flavorText.yellow: Lures prey with the sweet aroma of honey. Swallowed whole, the prey is melted in a day, bones and all.
flavorText.gold-silver: ACID that has dis solved many prey becomes sweeter, making it even more effective at attracting prey.
flavorText.crystal: Once ingested into this POKéMON's body, even the hardest object will melt into nothing.
flavorText.ruby-sapphire: VICTREEBEL has a long vine that extends from its head. This vine is waved and flicked about as if it were an animal to attract prey. When an unsuspecting prey draws near, this POKéMON swallows it whole.
flavorText.emerald: The long vine extending from its head is waved about as if it were a living thing to attract prey. When an unsuspecting victim approaches, it is swallowed whole.
flavorText.firered-leafgreen: Lures prey into its mouth with a honeylike aroma. The helpless prey is melted with a dissolving fluid.
flavorText.diamond-pearl: It pools in its mouth a fluid with a honeylike scent, which is really an acid that dissolves anything.
flavorText.platinum: It pools in its mouth a fluid with a honeylike scent, which is really an acid that dissolves anything.
flavorText.heartgold-soulsilver: Acid that has dissolved many prey becomes sweeter, making it even more effective at attracting prey.
flavorText.black-white: It pools in its mouth a fluid with a honeylike scent, which is really an acid that dissolves anything.
flavorText.black-2-white-2: It pools in its mouth a fluid with a honey-like scent, which is really an acid that dissolves anything.
flavorText.x-y: Said to live in huge colonies deep in jungles, although no one has ever returned from there.
flavorText.omega-ruby-alpha-sapphire: Victreebel has a long vine that extends from its head. This vine is waved and flicked about as if it were an animal to attract prey. When an unsuspecting prey draws near, this Pokémon swallows it whole.
flavorText.lets-go-pikachu-eevee: Lures prey with the sweet aroma of honey. Swallowed whole, the prey is dissolved in a day, bones and all.

flavorText.red-blue: Drifts in shallow seas. Anglers who hook them by accident are often punished by its stinging acid.
flavorText.yellow: It can sometimes be found all dry and shriveled up on a beach. Toss it back into the sea to revive it.
flavorText.gold-silver: When the tide goes out, dehydrated TENTACOOL remains can be found washed up on the shore.
flavorText.crystal: As it floats along on the waves, it uses its toxic feelers to stab anything it touches.
flavorText.ruby-sapphire: TENTACOOL’s body is largely composed of water. If it is removed from the sea, it dries up like parchment. If this POKéMON happens to become dehydrated, put it back into the sea.
flavorText.emerald: Its body is almost entirely composed of water. It ensnares its foe with its two long tentacles, then stabs with the poison stingers at their tips.
flavorText.firered-leafgreen: Its eyes are as transparent as crystals. From them, it shoots mysterious beams of light.
flavorText.diamond-pearl: Its body is virtually composed of water. It shoots strange beams from its crystal-like eyes.
flavorText.platinum: Because its body is almost entirely composed of water, it shrivels up if it is washed ashore.
flavorText.heartgold-soulsilver: When the tide goes out, dehydrated TENTACOOL remains can be found washed up on the shore.
flavorText.black-white: Because its body is almost entirely composed of water, it shrivels up if it is washed ashore.
flavorText.black-2-white-2: Because its body is almost entirely composed of water, it shrivels up if it is washed ashore.
flavorText.x-y: Its body is virtually composed of water. It shoots strange beams from its crystal-like eyes.
flavorText.omega-ruby-alpha-sapphire: Tentacool’s body is largely composed of water. If it is removed from the sea, it dries up like parchment. If this Pokémon happens to become dehydrated, put it back into the sea.
flavorText.sun-moon: They can be found lying dehydrated on beaches, but they are often still alive. When soaked in water, they will revive.
flavorText.ultra-sun-ultra-moon: It drifts through the sea searching for prey. Its poisonous tentacles break off sometimes, but after a while, they grow back.
flavorText.lets-go-pikachu-eevee: It can sometimes be found all dry and shriveled up on a beach. Toss it back into the sea to revive it.
flavorText.sword-shield: Tentacool is not a particularly strong swimmer. It drifts across the surface of shallow seas as it searches for prey.
flavorText.legends-arceus: They fire beams from the glassy, magenta orbs that resemble eyes atop their heads, and they drift in shallow seas. During low tide, they can sometimes be found on beaches, desiccated.

flavorText.red-blue: The tentacles are normally kept short. On hunts, they are extended to ensnare and immobilize prey.
flavorText.yellow: Its 80 tentacles can stretch and contract freely. They wrap around prey and weaken it with poison.
flavorText.gold-silver: Its 80 tentacles absorb water and stretch almost endlessly to CON STRICT its prey and enemies.
flavorText.crystal: When its 80 feel ers absorb water, it stretches to become like a net to entangle its prey.
flavorText.ruby-sapphire: TENTACRUEL has large red orbs on its head. The orbs glow before lashing the vicinity with a harsh ultrasonic blast. This POKéMON’s outburst creates rough waves around it.
flavorText.emerald: It lives in complex rock formations on the ocean floor and traps prey using its 80 tentacles. Its red orbs glow when it grows excited or agitated.
flavorText.firered-leafgreen: It has 80 tentacles that move about freely. They can sting, causing poisoning and sharp, stabbing pain.
flavorText.diamond-pearl: With 80 tentacles for ensnaring victims, it prevents escape until the prey is weakened by poison.
flavorText.platinum: It extends its 80 tentacles to form an encircling poisonous net that is difficult to escape.
flavorText.heartgold-soulsilver: Its 80 tentacles absorb water and stretch almost endlessly to constrict its prey and enemies.
flavorText.black-white: It extends its 80 tentacles to form an encircling poisonous net that is difficult to escape.
flavorText.black-2-white-2: It extends its 80 tentacles to form an encircling poisonous net that is difficult to escape.
flavorText.x-y: The tentacles are normally kept short. On hunts, they are extended to ensnare and immobilize prey.
flavorText.omega-ruby-alpha-sapphire: Tentacruel has large red orbs on its head. The orbs glow before lashing the vicinity with a harsh ultrasonic blast. This Pokémon’s outburst creates rough waves around it.
flavorText.sun-moon: Normally, it has 80 poisonous tentacles. The longer one has been alive, the fewer tentacles it will have.
flavorText.ultra-sun-ultra-moon: It fires off ultrasonic waves from its red orbs to weaken its prey, and then it wraps them up in its 80 tentacles.
flavorText.lets-go-pikachu-eevee: Its 80 tentacles can stretch and contract freely. They wrap around prey and weaken it with poison.
flavorText.sword-shield: When the red orbs on Tentacruel’s head glow brightly, watch out. The Pokémon is about to fire off a burst of ultrasonic waves.
flavorText.legends-arceus: It has 80 tentacles, each with a venomous tip. These tentacles are also extendible, lengthening when Tentacruel attempts to catch prey. Use caution.

flavorText.x-y: Found in fields and mountains. Mistaking them for boulders, people often step or trip on them.
flavorText.red-blue: Found in fields and mountains. Mistaking them for boulders, people often step or trip on them.
flavorText.yellow: Commonly found near mountain trails, etc. If you step on one by accident, it gets angry.
flavorText.gold-silver: Most people may not notice, but a closer look should reveal that there are many GEODUDE around.
flavorText.crystal: Proud of their sturdy bodies, they bash against each other in a contest to prove whose is harder.
flavorText.ruby-sapphire: The longer a GEODUDE lives, the more its edges are chipped and worn away, making it more rounded in appearance. However, this POKéMON’s heart will remain hard, craggy, and rough always.
flavorText.emerald: It climbs mountain paths using only the power of its arms. Because they look just like boulders lining paths, hikers may step on them without noticing.
flavorText.firered-leafgreen: Its round form makes it easy to pick up. Some people have used them to hurl at each other in a snowball fight.
flavorText.diamond-pearl: Many live on mountain trails and remain half buried while keeping an eye on climbers.
flavorText.platinum: At rest, it looks just like a rock. Carelessly stepping on it will make it swing its fists angrily.
flavorText.heartgold-soulsilver: Most people may not notice, but a closer look should reveal that there are many GEODUDE around.
flavorText.black-white: At rest, it looks just like a rock. Carelessly stepping on it will make it swing its fists angrily.
flavorText.black-2-white-2: At rest, it looks just like a rock. Carelessly stepping on it will make it swing its fists angrily.
flavorText.omega-ruby-alpha-sapphire: The longer a Geodude lives, the more its edges are chipped and worn away, making it more rounded in appearance. However, this Pokémon’s heart will remain hard, craggy, and rough always.
flavorText.sun-moon: Its round body makes it easy to pick up, but it is hard and heavy. It’s dangerous to play with them as if they were snowballs.
flavorText.ultra-sun-ultra-moon: Geodude that have lived a long life have had all their edges smoothed out until they’re totally round. They also have a calm, quiet disposition.
flavorText.lets-go-pikachu-eevee: Commonly found near mountain trails and the like. If you step on one by accident, it gets angry.
flavorText.legends-arceus: Makes its home in mountainous regions, using its arms to climb along harsh mountain roads. Can be troublesome—carelessly kicking one will cause it to fly into a rage and chase after you.

flavorText.red-blue: Rolls down slopes to move. It rolls over any obstacle without slowing or changing its direction.
flavorText.yellow: Often seen rolling down mountain trails. Obstacles are just things to roll straight over, not avoid.
flavorText.gold-silver: With a free and uncaring nature, it doesn't mind if pieces break off while it rolls down mountains.
flavorText.crystal: It travels by rol ling on mountain paths. If it gains too much speed, it stops by running into huge rocks.
flavorText.ruby-sapphire: GRAVELER grows by feeding on rocks. Apparently, it prefers to eat rocks that are covered in moss. This POKéMON eats its way through a ton of rocks on a daily basis.
flavorText.emerald: They descend from mountains by tumbling down steep slopes. They are so brutal, they smash aside obstructing trees and massive boulders with thunderous tackles.
flavorText.firered-leafgreen: Be careful while hiking on mountain trails. GRAVELER may come rolling down the path without slowing.
flavorText.diamond-pearl: GRAVELER make their homes on sheer cliff faces by gouging out numerous horizontal holes.
flavorText.platinum: It rolls on mountain paths to move. Once it builds momentum, no Pokémon can stop it without difficulty.
flavorText.heartgold-soulsilver: With a free and uncaring nature, it doesn’t mind if pieces break off while it rolls down mountains.
flavorText.black-white: It rolls on mountain paths to move. Once it builds momentum, no Pokémon can stop it without difficulty.
flavorText.black-2-white-2: It rolls on mountain paths to move. Once it builds momentum, no Pokémon can stop it without difficulty.
flavorText.x-y: With a free and uncaring nature, it doesn’t mind if pieces break off while it rolls down mountains.
flavorText.omega-ruby-alpha-sapphire: Graveler grows by feeding on rocks. Apparently, it prefers to eat rocks that are covered in moss. This Pokémon eats its way through a ton of rocks on a daily basis.
flavorText.sun-moon: Mossy rocks are its favorite food. It can devour a ton a day while crunching loudly.
flavorText.ultra-sun-ultra-moon: It climbs up cliffs as it heads toward the peak of a mountain. As soon as it reaches the summit, it rolls back down the way it came.
flavorText.lets-go-pikachu-eevee: Often seen rolling down mountain trails. Obstacles are just things to roll straight over, not avoid.
flavorText.legends-arceus: Dwells in holes dug into sheer walls of stone. It enjoys rolling down slopes as though it were a boulder during a rockfall, so keep an eye upward while traversing mountain roads.

flavorText.red-blue: Its boulder-like body is extremely hard. It can easily withstand dynamite blasts without damage.
flavorText.yellow: Once it sheds its skin, its body turns tender and whitish. Its hide hardens when it's exposed to air.
flavorText.gold-silver: It sheds its skin once a year. The discarded shell immediately hard ens and crumbles away.
flavorText.crystal: Its rock-like body is so durable, even high-powered dynamite blasts fail to scratch its rugged hide.
flavorText.ruby-sapphire: GOLEM live up on mountains. If there is a large earthquake, these POKéMON will come rolling down off the mountains en masse to the foothills below.
flavorText.emerald: It is said to live in volcanic craters on mountain peaks. Once a year, it sheds its hide and grows larger. The shed hide crumbles and returns to the soil.
flavorText.firered-leafgreen: It is enclosed in a hard shell that is as rugged as slabs of rock. It sheds skin once a year to grow larger.
flavorText.diamond-pearl: It sheds its hide once a year. Its boulderlike body is so tough, even dynamite can’t harm it.
flavorText.platinum: Even dynamite can’t harm its hard, boulderlike body. It sheds its hide just once a year.
flavorText.heartgold-soulsilver: It sheds its skin once a year. The discarded shell immediately hardens and crumbles away.
flavorText.black-white: Even dynamite can’t harm its hard, boulderlike body. It sheds its hide just once a year.
flavorText.black-2-white-2: Even dynamite can’t harm its hard, boulder-like body. It sheds its hide just once a year.
flavorText.x-y: It tumbles down mountains, leaving grooves from peak to base. Stay clear of these grooves.
flavorText.omega-ruby-alpha-sapphire: Golem live up on mountains. If there is a large earthquake, these Pokémon will come rolling down off the mountains en masse to the foothills below.
flavorText.sun-moon: Its body can survive dynamite blasts without a single scratch, but it hates rain and humidity.
flavorText.ultra-sun-ultra-moon: When Golem grow old, they stop shedding their shells. Those that have lived a long, long time have shells green with moss.
flavorText.lets-go-pikachu-eevee: Once it sheds its skin, its body turns tender and whitish. Its hide hardens when it’s exposed to air.
flavorText.legends-arceus: The rocklike shell is shed each year. The cast-off shell then crumbles, reverting to a mass of soil, which can be spread across fields to promote crop growth.

flavorText.red-blue: Its hooves are 10 times harder than diamonds. It can trample anything completely flat in little time.
flavorText.yellow: Capable of jumping incredibly high. Its hooves and sturdy legs absorb the impact of a hard landing.
flavorText.gold-silver: It is a weak run ner immediately after birth. It gradually becomes faster by chasing after its parents.
flavorText.crystal: Training by jumping over grass that grows longer every day has made it a world-class jumper.
flavorText.ruby-sapphire: PONYTA is very weak at birth. It can barely stand up. This POKéMON becomes stronger by stumbling and falling to keep up with its parent.
flavorText.emerald: A PONYTA is very weak at birth. It can barely stand up. Its legs become stronger as it stumbles and falls while trying to keep up with its parent.
flavorText.firered-leafgreen: Its body is light, and its legs are incredibly powerful. It can clear Ayers Rock in one leap.
flavorText.diamond-pearl: About an hour after birth, its fiery mane and tail grow out, giving it an impressive appearance.
flavorText.platinum: As a newborn, it can barely stand. However, through galloping, its legs are made tougher and faster.
flavorText.heartgold-soulsilver: It is a weak runner immediately after birth. It gradually becomes faster by chasing after its parents.
flavorText.black-white: As a newborn, it can barely stand. However, through galloping, its legs are made tougher and faster.
flavorText.black-2-white-2: As a newborn, it can barely stand. However, through galloping, its legs are made tougher and faster.
flavorText.x-y: As a newborn, it can barely stand. However, through galloping, its legs are made tougher and faster.
flavorText.omega-ruby-alpha-sapphire: Ponyta is very weak at birth. It can barely stand up. This Pokémon becomes stronger by stumbling and falling to keep up with its parent.
flavorText.lets-go-pikachu-eevee: Capable of jumping incredibly high. Its hooves and sturdy legs absorb the impact of a hard landing.
flavorText.sword-shield: It can’t run properly when it’s newly born. As it races around with others of its kind, its legs grow stronger.
flavorText.legends-arceus: These Pokémon live in herds out in the grassland. Newborn foals lack their fiery manes, which will develop about an hour after birth.

flavorText.red-blue: Very competitive, this POKéMON will chase anything that moves fast in the hopes of racing it.
flavorText.yellow: Just loves to run. If it sees some thing faster than itself, it will give chase at top speed.
flavorText.gold-silver: At full gallop, its four hooves barely touch the ground because it moves so incredi bly fast.
flavorText.crystal: It just loves to gallop. The faster it goes, the long er the swaying flames of its mane will become.
flavorText.ruby-sapphire: RAPIDASH usually can be seen casually cantering in the fields and plains. However, when this POKéMON turns serious, its fiery manes flare and blaze as it gallops its way up to 150 mph.
flavorText.emerald: It usually canters casually in the fields and plains. But once a RAPIDASH turns serious, its fiery manes flare and blaze as it gallops its way up to 150 mph.
flavorText.firered-leafgreen: It can gallop at a top speed of 150 miles per hour. It can race as fast as a bullet train while ablaze.
flavorText.diamond-pearl: It gallops at nearly 150 mph. With its mane blazing ferociously, it races as if it were an arrow.
flavorText.platinum: When at an all-out gallop, its blazing mane sparkles, enhancing its beautiful appearance.
flavorText.heartgold-soulsilver: At full gallop, its four hooves barely touch the ground because it moves so incredibly fast.
flavorText.black-white: When at an all-out gallop, its blazing mane sparkles, enhancing its beautiful appearance.
flavorText.black-2-white-2: When at an all-out gallop, its blazing mane sparkles, enhancing its beautiful appearance.
flavorText.x-y: Very competitive, this Pokémon will chase anything that moves fast in the hopes of racing it.
flavorText.omega-ruby-alpha-sapphire: Rapidash usually can be seen casually cantering in the fields and plains. However, when this Pokémon turns serious, its fiery manes flare and blaze as it gallops its way up to 150 mph.
flavorText.lets-go-pikachu-eevee: Just loves to run. If it sees something faster than itself, it will give chase at top speed.
flavorText.sword-shield: This Pokémon can be seen galloping through fields at speeds of up to 150 mph, its fiery mane fluttering in the wind.
flavorText.legends-arceus: Fiery mane aglow, Rapidash darts like an arrow across the land. This prodigiously swift creature can traverse the vast region of Hisui in a day and a half.

flavorText.crystal: It is always so absent-minded that it won't react, even if its flavorful tail is bitten.
flavorText.red-blue: Incredibly slow and dopey. It takes 5 seconds for it to feel pain when under attack.
flavorText.yellow: Incredibly slow and sluggish. It is quite content to loll about without worrying about the time.
flavorText.gold-silver: It lazes vacantly near water. If something bites its tail, it won't even notice for a whole day.
flavorText.ruby-sapphire: SLOWPOKE uses its tail to catch prey by dipping it in water at the side of a river. However, this POKéMON often forgets what it’s doing and often spends entire days just loafing at water’s edge.
flavorText.emerald: It catches prey by dipping its tail in water at the side of a river. But it often forgets what it is doing and spends entire days just loafing at water’s edge.
flavorText.firered-leafgreen: It is always vacantly lost in thought, but no one knows what it is thinking about. It is good at fishing with its tail.
flavorText.diamond-pearl: Although slow, it is skilled at fishing with its tail. It does not feel pain if its tail is bitten.
flavorText.platinum: Although slow, it is skilled at fishing with its tail. It does not feel pain if its tail is bitten.
flavorText.heartgold-soulsilver: It lazes vacantly near water. If something bites its tail, it won’t even notice for a whole day.
flavorText.black-white: Although slow, it is skilled at fishing with its tail. It does not feel pain if its tail is bitten.
flavorText.black-2-white-2: Although slow, it is skilled at fishing with its tail. It does not feel pain if its tail is bitten.
flavorText.x-y: It is always vacantly lost in thought, but no one knows what it is thinking about. It is good at fishing with its tail.
flavorText.omega-ruby-alpha-sapphire: Slowpoke uses its tail to catch prey by dipping it in water at the side of a river. However, this Pokémon often forgets what it’s doing and often spends entire days just loafing at water’s edge.
flavorText.sun-moon: Its long tail often breaks off. It doesn’t really feel any pain, though, and the tail grows back, so Slowpoke isn’t particularly bothered.
flavorText.ultra-sun-ultra-moon: There are some places where Slowpoke is worshiped because of a long-standing belief that whenever Slowpoke yawns, it rains.
flavorText.lets-go-pikachu-eevee: Incredibly slow and sluggish. It is quite content to loll about without worrying about the time.
flavorText.sword-shield: Slow-witted and oblivious, this Pokémon won’t feel any pain if its tail gets eaten. It won’t notice when its tail grows back, either.

flavorText.red-blue: The SHELLDER that is latched onto SLOWPOKE's tail is said to feed on the host's left over scraps.
flavorText.yellow: Lives lazily by the sea. If the SHELLDER on its tail comes off, it becomes a SLOWPOKE again.
flavorText.gold-silver: If the tail-biting SHELLDER is thrown off in a harsh battle, it reverts to being an ordi nary SLOWPOKE.
flavorText.crystal: An attached SHELLDER won't let go because of the tasty flavor that oozes out of its tail.
flavorText.ruby-sapphire: SLOWBRO’s tail has a SHELLDER firmly attached with a bite. As a result, the tail can’t be used for fishing anymore. This causes SLOWBRO to grudgingly swim and catch prey instead.
flavorText.emerald: Its tail has a SHELLDER firmly attached with a bite. As a result, the tail can’t be used for fishing anymore. This forces it to reluctantly swim and catch prey.
flavorText.firered-leafgreen: When a SLOWPOKE went hunting in the sea, its tail was bitten by a SHELLDER. That made it evolve into SLOWBRO.
flavorText.diamond-pearl: Though usually dim witted, it seems to become inspired if the SHELLDER on its tail bites down.
flavorText.platinum: Though usually dim witted, it seems to become inspired if the SHELLDER on its tail bites down.
flavorText.heartgold-soulsilver: If the tail-biting SHELLDER is thrown off in a harsh battle, it reverts to being an ordinary SLOWPOKE.
flavorText.black-white: Though usually dim witted, it seems to become inspired if the Shellder on its tail bites down.
flavorText.black-2-white-2: Though usually dim witted, it seems to become inspired if the Shellder on its tail bites down.
flavorText.x-y: An attached Shellder won’t let go because of the tasty flavor that oozes out of its tail.
flavorText.ultra-sun-ultra-moon: Spacing out is basically all it does. It turns back into Slowpoke if its tail, along with Shellder, breaks off.
flavorText.omega-ruby-alpha-sapphire: Slowbro’s tail has a Shellder firmly attached with a bite. As a result, the tail can’t be used for fishing anymore. This causes Slowbro to grudgingly swim and catch prey instead.
flavorText.sun-moon: It spaces out while gazing at the sea. With Shellder’s poison flowing through its body, it becomes even spacier.
flavorText.lets-go-pikachu-eevee: Lives lazily by the sea. If the Shellder on its tail comes off, it becomes a Slowpoke again.
flavorText.sword-shield: Slowpoke became Slowbro when a Shellder bit on to its tail. Sweet flavors seeping from the tail make the Shellder feel as if its life is a dream.

flavorText.red-blue: Uses anti-gravity to stay suspended. Appears without warning and uses THUNDER WAVE and similar moves.
flavorText.yellow: It is born with the ability to defy gravity. It floats in air on powerful electro magnetic waves.
flavorText.gold-silver: It is attracted by electromagnetic waves. It may approach trainers if they are using their POKéGEAR.
flavorText.crystal: The electricity emitted by the units on each side of its body cause it to become a strong magnet.
flavorText.ruby-sapphire: MAGNEMITE attaches itself to power lines to feed on electricity. If your house has a power outage, check your circuit breakers. You may find a large number of this POKéMON clinging to the breaker box.
flavorText.emerald: The units at its sides are extremely powerful magnets. They generate enough magnetism to draw in iron objects from over 300 feet away.
flavorText.firered-leafgreen: It moves while constantly hovering. It discharges THUNDER WAVE and so on from the units at its sides.
flavorText.diamond-pearl: The units at its sides generate electromagnetic waves that keep it airborne. It feeds on electricity.
flavorText.platinum: The faster the units at its sides rotate, the greater the magnetic force they generate.
flavorText.heartgold-soulsilver: It is attracted by electromagnetic waves. It may approach Trainers if they are using their Pokégear.
flavorText.black-white: The faster the units at its sides rotate, the greater the magnetic force they generate.
flavorText.black-2-white-2: The electromagnetic waves emitted by the units at the sides of its head expel antigravity, which allows it to float.
flavorText.x-y: The units at the sides of its body generate antigravity energy to keep it aloft in the air.
flavorText.omega-ruby-alpha-sapphire: Magnemite attaches itself to power lines to feed on electricity. If your house has a power outage, check your circuit breakers. You may find a large number of this Pokémon clinging to the breaker box.
flavorText.sun-moon: They gather in places where electricity is available. They can be found clinging to the steel towers used to support power lines.
flavorText.ultra-sun-ultra-moon: It’s frequently the cause of power outages, which is why some power plants send out electrical signals that it can’t stand.
flavorText.lets-go-pikachu-eevee: It is hatched with the ability to defy gravity. It floats while emitting powerful electromagnetic waves.
flavorText.sword-shield: At times, Magnemite runs out of electricity and ends up on the ground. If you give batteries to a grounded Magnemite, it’ll start moving again.
flavorText.legends-arceus: A bizarre Pokémon with but a single eye embedded in an iron sphere. I suspect this creature levitates due to the magnetism it emits from its arms, which resemble horseshoe-shaped magnets.

flavorText.red-blue: Formed by several MAGNEMITEs linked together. They frequently appear when sunspots flare up.
flavorText.yellow: Generates strange radio signals. It raises the tem perature by 3.6F degrees within 3,300 feet.
flavorText.gold-silver: Three MAGNEMITE are linked by a strong magnetic force. Earaches will occur if you get too close.
flavorText.crystal: When many MAGNETON gather together, the resulting magnetic storm disrupts radio waves.
flavorText.ruby-sapphire: MAGNETON emits a powerful magnetic force that is fatal to mechanical devices. As a result, large cities sound sirens to warn citizens of large-scale outbreaks of this POKéMON.
flavorText.emerald: It is actually three MAGNEMITE linked by magnetism. It generates powerful radio waves that raise temperatures by 3.6 degrees F within a 3,300-foot radius.
flavorText.firered-leafgreen: A linked cluster formed of several MAGNEMITE. It discharges powerful magnetic waves at high voltage.
flavorText.diamond-pearl: It is actually three MAGNEMITE linked by magnetism. A group can set off a magnetic storm.
flavorText.platinum: Many mysteriously appear when more sunspots dot the sun. They stop TV sets from displaying properly.
flavorText.heartgold-soulsilver: Three MAGNEMITE are linked by a strong magnetic force. Earaches will occur if you get too close.
flavorText.black-white: Many mysteriously appear when more sunspots dot the sun. They stop TV sets from displaying properly.
flavorText.black-2-white-2: The stronger electromagnetic waves from the three linked Magnemite are enough to dry out surrounding moisture.
flavorText.x-y: A linked cluster formed of several Magnemite. It discharges powerful magnetic waves at high voltage.
flavorText.omega-ruby-alpha-sapphire: Magneton emits a powerful magnetic force that is fatal to mechanical devices. As a result, large cities sound sirens to warn citizens of large-scale outbreaks of this Pokémon.
flavorText.sun-moon: When three Magnemite link together, their brains also become one. They do not become three times more intelligent.
flavorText.ultra-sun-ultra-moon: Delicate equipment can malfunction in areas inhabited by Magneton, which send out mysterious electrical signals.
flavorText.lets-go-pikachu-eevee: Generates strange radio signals. It raises the temperature by 3.6 degrees Fahrenheit within 3,300 feet.
flavorText.sword-shield: This Pokémon is three Magnemite that have linked together. Magneton sends out powerful radio waves to study its surroundings.
flavorText.legends-arceus: Three Magnemite gathered to evolve into this Pokémon. The source of much vexation on my part, as its powerful magnetism destroys my research equipment.

flavorText.red-blue: The sprig of green onions it holds is its weapon. It is used much like a metal sword.
flavorText.yellow: Lives where reedy plants grow. They are rarely seen, so it's thought their numbers are decreasing.
flavorText.gold-silver: If anyone tries to disturb where the essential plant sticks grow, it uses its own stick to thwart them.
flavorText.crystal: In order to pre vent their extinction, more people have made an effort to breed these POKéMON.
flavorText.ruby-sapphire: FARFETCH’D is always seen with a stick from a plant of some sort. Apparently, there are good sticks and bad sticks. This POKéMON has been known to fight with others over sticks.
flavorText.emerald: It is always seen with a stick from a plant. Apparently, there are good sticks and bad sticks. This POKéMON occasionally fights with others over choice sticks.
flavorText.firered-leafgreen: It always walks about with a plant stalk clamped in its beak. The stalk is used for building its nest.
flavorText.diamond-pearl: It can’t live without the stalk it holds. That’s why it defends the stalk from attackers with its life.
flavorText.platinum: It can’t live without the stalk it holds. That’s why it defends the stalk from attackers with its life.
flavorText.heartgold-soulsilver: If anyone tries to disturb where the essential plant stalks grow, it uses its own stalk to thwart them.
flavorText.black-white: It can’t live without the stalk it holds. That’s why it defends the stalk from attackers with its life.
flavorText.black-2-white-2: It can’t live without the stalk it holds. That’s why it defends the stalk from attackers with its life.
flavorText.x-y: The plant stalk it holds is its weapon. The stalk is used like a sword to cut all sorts of things.
flavorText.omega-ruby-alpha-sapphire: Farfetch’d is always seen with a stalk from a plant of some sort. Apparently, there are good stalks and bad stalks. This Pokémon has been known to fight with others over stalks.
flavorText.lets-go-pikachu-eevee: They live where reedy plants grow. Farfetch’d are rarely seen, so it’s thought their numbers are decreasing.
flavorText.sword-shield: The stalk this Pokémon carries in its wings serves as a sword to cut down opponents. In a dire situation, the stalk can also serve as food.

flavorText.red-blue: A bird that makes up for its poor flying with its fast foot speed. Leaves giant footprints.
flavorText.yellow: Its short wings make flying dif ficult. Instead, this POKéMON runs at high speed on developed legs.
flavorText.gold-silver: By alternately raising and lower ing its two heads, it balances itself to be more stable while running.
flavorText.crystal: It lives on a grassy plain where it can see a long way. If it sees an enemy, it runs away at 60 mph.
flavorText.ruby-sapphire: DODUO’s two heads never sleep at the same time. Its two heads take turns sleeping, so one head can always keep watch for enemies while the other one sleeps.
flavorText.emerald: Even while eating or sleeping, one of the heads remains always vigilant for any sign of danger. When threatened, it flees at over 60 miles per hour.
flavorText.firered-leafgreen: A two-headed POKéMON that was discovered as a sudden mutation. It runs at a pace of over 60 miles per hour.
flavorText.diamond-pearl: The brains in its two heads appear to communicate emotions to each other with a telepathic power.
flavorText.platinum: The brains in its two heads appear to communicate emotions to each other with a telepathic power.
flavorText.heartgold-soulsilver: By alternately raising and lowering its two heads, it balances itself to be more stable while running.
flavorText.black-white: The brains in its two heads appear to communicate emotions to each other with a telepathic power.
flavorText.black-2-white-2: The brains in its two heads appear to communicate emotions to each other with a telepathic power.
flavorText.x-y: A two-headed Pokémon that was discovered as a sudden mutation. It runs at a pace of over 60 miles per hour.
flavorText.omega-ruby-alpha-sapphire: Doduo’s two heads never sleep at the same time. Its two heads take turns sleeping, so one head can always keep watch for enemies while the other one sleeps.
flavorText.lets-go-pikachu-eevee: Its short wings make flying difficult. Instead, this Pokémon runs at high speed on developed legs.

flavorText.red-blue: Uses its three brains to execute complex plans. While two heads sleep, one head stays awake.
flavorText.yellow: One of DODUO's 2 heads splits to form a unique species. It runs close to 40 MPH in prairies.
flavorText.gold-silver: It collects data and plans three times as wisely, but it may think too much and be come immobilized.
flavorText.crystal: An enemy that takes its eyes off any of the three heads--even for a second--will get pecked severely.
flavorText.ruby-sapphire: Watch out if DODRIO’s three heads are looking in three separate directions. It’s a sure sign that it is on its guard. Don’t go near this POKéMON if it’s being wary - it may decide to peck you.
flavorText.emerald: A peculiar POKéMON species with three heads. It vigorously races across grassy plains even in arid seasons with little rainfall.
flavorText.firered-leafgreen: An odd species that is rarely found. The three heads respectively represent joy, sadness, and anger.
flavorText.diamond-pearl: When DODUO evolves into this odd breed, one of its heads splits into two. It runs at nearly 40 mph.
flavorText.platinum: When DODUO evolves into this odd breed, one of its heads splits into two. It runs at nearly 40 mph.
flavorText.heartgold-soulsilver: It collects data and plans three times as wisely, but it may think too much and fall into a state of immobility.
flavorText.black-white: When Doduo evolves into this odd breed, one of its heads splits into two. It runs at nearly 40 mph.
flavorText.black-2-white-2: When Doduo evolves into this odd breed, one of its heads splits into two. It runs at nearly 40 mph.
flavorText.x-y: An enemy that takes its eyes off any of the three heads--even for a second--will get pecked severely.
flavorText.omega-ruby-alpha-sapphire: Watch out if Dodrio’s three heads are looking in three separate directions. It’s a sure sign that it is on its guard. Don’t go near this Pokémon if it’s being wary—it may decide to peck you.
flavorText.lets-go-pikachu-eevee: One of Doduo’s two heads splits to form a unique species. It runs close to 40 mph in prairies.

flavorText.red-blue: The protruding horn on its head is very hard. It is used for bashing through thick ice.
flavorText.yellow: Loves freezing cold conditions. Relishes swimming in a frigid cli mate of around 14F degrees.
flavorText.gold-silver: Although it can't walk well on land, it is a graceful swimmer. It espe cially loves being in frigid seas.
flavorText.crystal: The light blue fur that covers it keeps it protected against the cold. It loves iceberg- filled oceans.
flavorText.ruby-sapphire: SEEL hunts for prey in the frigid sea underneath sheets of ice. When it needs to breathe, it punches a hole through the ice with the sharply protruding section of its head.
flavorText.emerald: SEEL hunt for prey in frigid, ice-covered seas. When it needs to breathe, it punches a hole through the ice with the sharply protruding section of its head.
flavorText.firered-leafgreen: Covered with light blue fur, its hide is thick and tough. It is active in bitter cold of minus 40 degrees Fahrenheit.
flavorText.diamond-pearl: A Pokémon that lives on icebergs. It swims in the sea using the point on its head to break up ice.
flavorText.platinum: A Pokémon that lives on icebergs. It swims in the sea using the point on its head to break up ice.
flavorText.heartgold-soulsilver: Although it can’t walk well on land, it is a graceful swimmer. It especially loves being in frigid seas.
flavorText.black-white: A Pokémon that lives on icebergs. It swims in the sea using the point on its head to break up ice.
flavorText.black-2-white-2: The colder it gets, the better it feels. It joyfully swims around oceans so cold that they are filled with floating ice.
flavorText.x-y: A Pokémon that lives on icebergs. It swims in the sea using the point on its head to break up ice.
flavorText.omega-ruby-alpha-sapphire: Seel hunts for prey in the frigid sea underneath sheets of ice. When it needs to breathe, it punches a hole through the ice with the sharply protruding section of its head.
flavorText.ultra-sun-ultra-moon: It has always been supposed that Seel live only in cold seas. Their having shown up in Alola is a mystery.
flavorText.lets-go-pikachu-eevee: Loves freezing-cold conditions. Relishes swimming in a frigid climate of around 14 degrees Fahrenheit.

flavorText.red-blue: Stores thermal energy in its body. Swims at a steady 8 knots even in intensely cold waters.
flavorText.yellow: Its entire body is a snowy-white. Unharmed by even intense cold, it swims powerfully in icy waters.
flavorText.gold-silver: Its streamlined body has little drag in water. The colder the temperature, the friskier it gets.
flavorText.crystal: It sleeps under shallow ocean waters during the day, then looks for food at night when it's cold.
flavorText.ruby-sapphire: DEWGONG loves to snooze on bitterly cold ice. The sight of this POKéMON sleeping on a glacier was mistakenly thought to be a mermaid by a mariner long ago.
flavorText.emerald: It loves to snooze on bitterly cold ice. The sight of this POKéMON sleeping on a glacier was mistakenly thought to be a mermaid by a mariner long ago.
flavorText.firered-leafgreen: Its body is covered with a pure white fur. The colder the weather, the more active it becomes.
flavorText.diamond-pearl: In snow, the pure white coat covering its body obscures it from predators.
flavorText.platinum: In snow, the pure white coat covering its body obscures it from predators.
flavorText.heartgold-soulsilver: Its streamlined body has little drag in water. The colder the temperature, the friskier it gets.
flavorText.black-white: In snow, the pure white coat covering its body obscures it from predators.
flavorText.black-2-white-2: Its streamlined body has low resistance, and it swims around cold oceans at a speed of eight knots.
flavorText.x-y: Its body is covered with a pure white fur. The colder the weather, the more active it becomes.
flavorText.omega-ruby-alpha-sapphire: Dewgong loves to snooze on bitterly cold ice. The sight of this Pokémon sleeping on a glacier was mistakenly thought to be a mermaid by a mariner long ago.
flavorText.ultra-sun-ultra-moon: It swims through the ocean at a speed of eight knots, searching for Pokémon that will become its prey. It’s especially fond of Wishiwashi.
flavorText.lets-go-pikachu-eevee: Its entire body is a snowy white. Unharmed by even intense cold, it swims powerfully in icy waters.

flavorText.red-blue: Appears in filthy areas. Thrives by sucking up polluted sludge that is pumped out of factories.
flavorText.yellow: Made of hardened sludge. It smells too putrid to touch. Even weeds won't grow in its path.
flavorText.gold-silver: As it moves, it loses bits of its body from which new GRIMER emerge. This worsens the stench around it.
flavorText.crystal: When two of these POKéMON's bodies are combined together, new poisons are created.
flavorText.ruby-sapphire: GRIMER’s sludgy and rubbery body can be forced through any opening, however small it may be. This POKéMON enters sewer pipes to drink filthy wastewater.
flavorText.emerald: Born from polluted sludge in the sea, GRIMER’s favorite food is anything filthy. They feed on wastewater pumped out from factories.
flavorText.firered-leafgreen: Sludge exposed to X rays from the moon transformed into GRIMER. It loves feeding on filthy things.
flavorText.diamond-pearl: It was born when sludge in a dirty stream was exposed to the moon’s X-rays. It appears among filth.
flavorText.platinum: It was born when sludge in a dirty stream was exposed to the moon’s X-rays. It appears among filth.
flavorText.heartgold-soulsilver: As it moves, it loses bits of its body, from which new GRIMER emerge. This worsens the stench around it.
flavorText.black-white: It was born when sludge in a dirty stream was exposed to the moon’s X-rays. It appears among filth.
flavorText.black-2-white-2: Born from sludge, these Pokémon now gather in polluted places and increase the bacteria in their bodies.
flavorText.x-y: Sludge exposed to X-rays from the moon transformed into Grimer. It loves feeding on filthy things.
flavorText.omega-ruby-alpha-sapphire: Grimer’s sludgy and rubbery body can be forced through any opening, however small it may be. This Pokémon enters sewer pipes to drink filthy wastewater.
flavorText.sun-moon: Its main source of food is the slimy industrial waste of factories. This Pokémon’s numbers have been decreasing in recent years.
flavorText.ultra-sun-ultra-moon: It was born from sludge on the ocean floor. In a sterile environment, the germs within its body can’t multiply, and it dies.
flavorText.lets-go-pikachu-eevee: Made of congealed sludge. It smells too putrid to touch. Even weeds won’t grow in its path.

flavorText.red-blue: Thickly covered with a filthy, vile sludge. It is so toxic, even its footprints contain poison.
flavorText.yellow: Smells so awful, it can cause fainting. Through degeneration, it lost its sense of smell.
flavorText.gold-silver: They love to gath er in smelly areas where sludge ac cumulates, making the stench around them worse.
flavorText.crystal: As it moves, a very strong poison leaks from it, making the ground there barren for three years.
flavorText.ruby-sapphire: From MUK’s body seeps a foul fluid that gives off a nose-bendingly horrible stench. Just one drop of this POKéMON’s body fluid can turn a pool stagnant and rancid.
flavorText.emerald: It prefers warm and humid habitats. In the summertime, the toxic substances in its body intensify, making MUK reek like putrid kitchen garbage.
flavorText.firered-leafgreen: It is usually undetectable because it blends in with the ground. Touching it can cause terrible poisoning.
flavorText.diamond-pearl: A toxic fluid seeps from its body. The fluid instantly kills plants and trees on contact.
flavorText.platinum: A toxic fluid seeps from its body. The fluid instantly kills plants and trees on contact.
flavorText.heartgold-soulsilver: They love to gather in smelly areas where sludge accumulates, making the stench around them worse.
flavorText.black-white: A toxic fluid seeps from its body. The fluid instantly kills plants and trees on contact.
flavorText.black-2-white-2: It’s so stinky! Muk’s body contains toxic elements, and any plant will wilt when it passes by.
flavorText.x-y: They love to gather in smelly areas where sludge accumulates, making the stench around them worse.
flavorText.omega-ruby-alpha-sapphire: From Muk’s body seeps a foul fluid that gives off a nose-bendingly horrible stench. Just one drop of this Pokémon’s body fluid can turn a pool stagnant and rancid.
flavorText.sun-moon: The stench it gives off will make your nose scrunch up. Still, there are Muk fans who think that’s a good thing.
flavorText.ultra-sun-ultra-moon: Their food sources have decreased, and their numbers have declined sharply. Sludge ponds are being built to prevent their extinction.
flavorText.lets-go-pikachu-eevee: Smells so awful, it can cause fainting. Through degeneration of its nose, it lost its sense of smell.

flavorText.red-blue: Its hard shell repels any kind of attack. It is vulnerable only when its shell is open.
flavorText.yellow: The shell can withstand any attack. However, when it is open, the tender body is exposed.
flavorText.gold-silver: It swims facing backward by open ing and closing its two-piece shell. It is surprisingly fast.
flavorText.crystal: Clamping on to an opponent reveals its vulnerable parts, so it uses this move only as a last resort.
flavorText.ruby-sapphire: At night, this POKéMON uses its broad tongue to burrow a hole in the seafloor sand and then sleep in it. While it is sleeping, SHELLDER closes its shell, but leaves its tongue hanging out.
flavorText.emerald: At night, it burrows a hole in the seafloor with its broad tongue to make a place to sleep. While asleep, it closes its shell, but leaves its tongue hanging out.
flavorText.firered-leafgreen: It is encased in a shell that is harder than diamond. Inside, however, it is surprisingly tender.
flavorText.diamond-pearl: It swims backward by opening and closing its two shells. Its large tongue is always kept hanging out.
flavorText.platinum: It swims backward by opening and closing its two shells. Its large tongue is always kept hanging out.
flavorText.heartgold-soulsilver: It swims facing backward by opening and closing its two-piece shell. It is surprisingly fast.
flavorText.black-white: It swims backward by opening and closing its two shells. Its large tongue is always kept hanging out.
flavorText.black-2-white-2: It swims backward by opening and closing its two shells. Its large tongue is always kept hanging out.
flavorText.x-y: Its hard shell repels any kind of attack. It is vulnerable only when its shell is open.
flavorText.omega-ruby-alpha-sapphire: At night, this Pokémon uses its broad tongue to burrow a hole in the seafloor sand and then sleep in it. While it is sleeping, Shellder closes its shell, but leaves its tongue hanging out.
flavorText.sun-moon: The hardness of its shell surpasses the hardness of a diamond. In days gone by, people used the shells to make shields.
flavorText.ultra-sun-ultra-moon: The sand that accumulates inside its shell eventually becomes a pearl. But the pearl gets in the way, so it spits it out and discards it.
flavorText.lets-go-pikachu-eevee: The shell can withstand any attack. However, when it is open, the tender body is exposed.
flavorText.sword-shield: It swims facing backward by opening and closing its two-piece shell. It is surprisingly fast.

flavorText.red-blue: When attacked, it launches its horns in quick volleys. Its innards have never been seen.
flavorText.yellow: For protection, it uses its harder- than-diamonds shell. It also shoots spikes from the shell.
flavorText.gold-silver: Once it slams its shell shut, it is impossible to open, even by those with superi or strength.
flavorText.crystal: Even a missile can't break the spikes it uses to stab opponents. They're even hard er than its shell.
flavorText.ruby-sapphire: CLOYSTER is capable of swimming in the sea. It does so by swallowing water, then jetting it out toward the rear. This POKéMON shoots spikes from its shell using the same system.
flavorText.emerald: It swims in the sea by swallowing water, then jetting it out toward the rear. The CLOYSTER shoots spikes from its shell using the same system.
flavorText.firered-leafgreen: Its shell is extremely hard. It cannot be shattered, even with a bomb. The shell opens only when it is attacking.
flavorText.diamond-pearl: It fights by keeping its shell tightly shut for protection and by shooting spikes to repel foes.
flavorText.platinum: It fights by keeping its shell tightly shut for protection and by shooting spikes to repel foes.
flavorText.heartgold-soulsilver: Once it slams its shell shut, it is impossible to open, even by those with superior strength.
flavorText.black-white: It fights by keeping its shell tightly shut for protection and by shooting spikes to repel foes.
flavorText.black-2-white-2: It fights by keeping its shell tightly shut for protection and by shooting spikes to repel foes.
flavorText.x-y: Cloyster that live in seas with harsh tidal currents grow large, sharp spikes on their shells.
flavorText.omega-ruby-alpha-sapphire: Cloyster is capable of swimming in the sea. It does so by swallowing water, then jetting it out toward the rear. This Pokémon shoots spikes from its shell using the same system.
flavorText.sun-moon: Its hard shell cannot be shattered—not even by a bomb. The contents of the shell remain unknown.
flavorText.ultra-sun-ultra-moon: If areas of Cloyster’s very hard shell get damaged, those areas swell, gradually growing into large sharp spikes.
flavorText.lets-go-pikachu-eevee: For protection, it uses its harder-than-diamond shell. It also shoots spikes from the shell.
flavorText.sword-shield: Its shell is extremely hard. It cannot be shattered, even with a bomb. The shell opens only when it is attacking.

flavorText.red-blue: Almost invisible, this gaseous POKéMON cloaks the target and puts it to sleep without notice.
flavorText.yellow: Said to appear in decrepit, deserted buildings. It has no real shape as it appears to be made of a gas.
flavorText.gold-silver: With its gas-like body, it can sneak into any place it desires. However, it can be blown away by wind.
flavorText.crystal: It wraps its op ponent in its gas- like body, slowly weakening its prey by poisoning it through the skin.
flavorText.ruby-sapphire: GASTLY is largely composed of gaseous matter. When exposed to a strong wind, the gaseous body quickly dwindles away. Groups of this POKéMON cluster under the eaves of houses to escape the ravages of wind.
flavorText.emerald: When exposed to a strong wind, a GASTLY’s gaseous body quickly dwindles away. They cluster under the eaves of houses to escape the ravages of wind.
flavorText.firered-leafgreen: A being that exists as a thin gas. It can topple an Indian elephant by enveloping the prey in two seconds.
flavorText.diamond-pearl: This Pokémon’s body is 95% made up of gases, which are blown away by strong gusts of wind.
flavorText.platinum: Born from gases, anyone would faint if engulfed by its gaseous body, which contains poison.
flavorText.heartgold-soulsilver: With its gas-like body, it can sneak into any place it desires. However, it can be blown away by wind.
flavorText.black-white: Born from gases, anyone would faint if engulfed by its gaseous body, which contains poison.
flavorText.black-2-white-2: Born from gases, anyone would faint if engulfed by its gaseous body, which contains poison.
flavorText.x-y: Its body is made of gas. Despite lacking substance, it can envelop an opponent of any size and cause suffocation.
flavorText.omega-ruby-alpha-sapphire: Gastly is largely composed of gaseous matter. When exposed to a strong wind, the gaseous body quickly dwindles away. Groups of this Pokémon cluster under the eaves of houses to escape the ravages of wind.
flavorText.sun-moon: Should a strange light be seen flickering in an abandoned building, Gastly is lurking there.
flavorText.ultra-sun-ultra-moon: It’s said that gas emanating from a graveyard was possessed by the grievances of the deceased and thus became a Pokémon.
flavorText.lets-go-pikachu-eevee: Said to appear in decrepit, deserted buildings. It has no real shape, as it appears to be made of a gas.
flavorText.sword-shield: Born from gases, anyone would faint if engulfed by its gaseous body, which contains poison.
flavorText.legends-arceus: Gaseous and completely impalpable. Also highly dangerous— inhaling part of its poisonous body will cause one to faint instantly.

flavorText.red-blue: Because of its ability to slip through block walls, it is said to be from an other dimension.
flavorText.yellow: By licking, it saps the victim's life. It causes shaking that won't stop until the victim's demise.
flavorText.gold-silver: In total darkness, where nothing is visible, HAUNTER lurks, silently stalking its next victim.
flavorText.crystal: It hides in the dark, planning to take the life of the next living thing that wanders close by.
flavorText.ruby-sapphire: HAUNTER is a dangerous POKéMON. If one beckons you while floating in darkness, you must never approach it. This POKéMON will try to lick you with its tongue and steal your life away.
flavorText.emerald: If a HAUNTER beckons you while it is floating in darkness, don’t approach it. This POKéMON will try to lick you with its tongue and steal your life away.
flavorText.firered-leafgreen: If you get the feeling of being watched in darkness when nobody is around, HAUNTER is there.
flavorText.diamond-pearl: It can slip through any obstacle. It lurks inside walls to keep an eye on its foes.
flavorText.platinum: It likes to lurk in the dark and tap shoulders with a gaseous hand. Its touch causes endless shuddering.
flavorText.heartgold-soulsilver: In total darkness, where nothing is visible, HAUNTER lurks, silently stalking its next victim.
flavorText.black-white: It likes to lurk in the dark and tap shoulders with a gaseous hand. Its touch causes endless shuddering.
flavorText.black-2-white-2: It likes to lurk in the dark and tap shoulders with a gaseous hand. Its touch causes endless shuddering.
flavorText.x-y: If you get the feeling of being watched in darkness when nobody is around, Haunter is there.
flavorText.omega-ruby-alpha-sapphire: Haunter is a dangerous Pokémon. If one beckons you while floating in darkness, you must never approach it. This Pokémon will try to lick you with its tongue and steal your life away.
flavorText.sun-moon: It strikes at humans from total darkness. Those licked by its cold tongue grow weaker with each passing day until they die.
flavorText.ultra-sun-ultra-moon: On moonless nights, Haunter searches for someone to curse, so it’s best not to go out walking around.
flavorText.lets-go-pikachu-eevee: By licking, it saps the victim’s life. It causes shaking that won’t stop until the victim’s demise.
flavorText.sword-shield: Its tongue is made of gas. If licked, its victim starts shaking constantly until death eventually comes.
flavorText.legends-arceus: This frightful, malevolent spirit can glide through walls, appearing wherever it likes. According to rumor, victims of a Haunter's lick will wither to death day by day.

flavorText.red-blue: Under a full moon, this POKéMON likes to mimic the shadows of people and laugh at their fright.
flavorText.yellow: A GENGAR is close by if you feel a sudden chill. It may be trying to lay a curse on you.
flavorText.gold-silver: It steals heat from its surround ings. If you feel a sudden chill, it is certain that a GENGAR appeared.
flavorText.crystal: Hiding in people's shadows at night, it absorbs their heat. The chill it causes makes the victims shake.
flavorText.ruby-sapphire: Sometimes, on a dark night, your shadow thrown by a streetlight will suddenly and startlingly overtake you. It is actually a GENGAR running past you, pretending to be your shadow.
flavorText.emerald: Deep in the night, your shadow cast by a streetlight may suddenly overtake you. It is actually a GENGAR running past you, pretending to be your shadow.
flavorText.firered-leafgreen: It is said to emerge from darkness to steal the lives of those who become lost in mountains.
flavorText.diamond-pearl: It hides in shadows. It is said that if GENGAR is hiding, it cools the area by nearly 10 degrees F.
flavorText.platinum: The leer that floats in darkness belongs to a GENGAR delighting in casting curses on people.
flavorText.heartgold-soulsilver: It steals heat from its surroundings. If you feel a sudden chill, it is certain that a GENGAR appeared.
flavorText.black-white: The leer that floats in darkness belongs to a Gengar delighting in casting curses on people.
flavorText.black-2-white-2: The leer that floats in darkness belongs to a Gengar delighting in casting curses on people.
flavorText.x-y: It hides in shadows. It is said that if Gengar is hiding, it cools the area by nearly 10 degrees Fahrenheit.
flavorText.omega-ruby-alpha-sapphire: Sometimes, on a dark night, your shadow thrown by a streetlight will suddenly and startlingly overtake you. It is actually a Gengar running past you, pretending to be your shadow.
flavorText.sun-moon: Should you feel yourself attacked by a sudden chill, it is evidence of an approaching Gengar. There is no escaping it. Give up.
flavorText.ultra-sun-ultra-moon: You can hear tales told all over the world about how Gengar will pay a visit to children who are naughty.
flavorText.lets-go-pikachu-eevee: A Gengar is close by if you feel a sudden chill. It may be trying to lay a curse on you.
flavorText.sword-shield: On the night of a full moon, if shadows move on their own and laugh, it must be Gengar’s doing.
flavorText.legends-arceus: Possesses potential victims' shadows in an effort to steal away the victims' lives. If your shadow begins to laugh, you must take hold of a protective charm posthaste!

flavorText.black-white: It burrows through the ground at a speed of 50 mph while feeding on large boulders.
flavorText.black-2-white-2: Opening its large mouth, it ingests massive amounts of soil and creates long tunnels.
flavorText.red-blue: As it grows, the stone portions of its body harden to become similar to a diamond, but colored black.
flavorText.yellow: Burrows at high speed in search of food. The tunnels it leaves are used as homes by DIGLETTs.
flavorText.gold-silver: It twists and squirms through the ground. The thunderous roar of its tunneling echoes a long way.
flavorText.crystal: As it digs through the ground, it absorbs many hard objects. This is what makes its body so solid.
flavorText.ruby-sapphire: ONIX has a magnet in its brain. It acts as a compass so that this POKéMON does not lose direction while it is tunneling. As it grows older, its body becomes increasingly rounder and smoother.
flavorText.emerald: There is a magnet in its brain that prevents an ONIX from losing direction while tunneling. As it grows older, its body becomes steadily rounder and smoother.
flavorText.firered-leafgreen: It usually lives underground. It searches for food while boring its way through the ground at 50 miles per hour.
flavorText.diamond-pearl: When it travels underground, it causes rumbling and tremors. It can move at 50 mph.
flavorText.platinum: It burrows through the ground at a speed of 50 mph while feeding on large boulders.
flavorText.heartgold-soulsilver: It twists and squirms through the ground. The thunderous roar of its tunneling echoes a long way.
flavorText.x-y: Burrows at high speed in search of food. The tunnels it leaves are used as homes by Diglett.
flavorText.omega-ruby-alpha-sapphire: Onix has a magnet in its brain. It acts as a compass so that this Pokémon does not lose direction while it is tunneling. As it grows older, its body becomes increasingly rounder and smoother.
flavorText.lets-go-pikachu-eevee: Burrows at high speed in search of food. The tunnels it leaves are used as homes by Diglett.
flavorText.sword-shield: As it digs through the ground, it absorbs many hard objects. This is what makes its body so solid.
flavorText.legends-arceus: This chain of immense stones resembles a giant serpent. Tremors shake the earth above as it burrows deep beneath the ground, feeding on boulders as it goes.

flavorText.red-blue: Puts enemies to sleep then eats their dreams. Occasionally gets sick from eating bad dreams.
flavorText.yellow: If you sleep by it all the time, it will sometimes show you dreams it has eaten in the past.
flavorText.gold-silver: If you think that you had a good dream, but you can't remember it, a DROWZEE has probably eaten it.
flavorText.crystal: When it twitches its nose, it can tell where someone is sleeping and what that person is dreaming about.
flavorText.ruby-sapphire: If your nose becomes itchy while you are sleeping, it’s a sure sign that one of these POKéMON is standing above your pillow and trying to eat your dream through your nostrils.
flavorText.emerald: If your nose becomes itchy while you are sleeping, it’s a sure sign that a DROWZEE is standing above your pillow and trying to eat your dream through your nostrils.
flavorText.firered-leafgreen: A descendent of the legendary animal baku, which is said to eat dreams. It is skilled at hypnotism.
flavorText.diamond-pearl: It can tell what people are dreaming by sniffing with its big nose. It loves fun dreams.
flavorText.platinum: It can tell what people are dreaming by sniffing with its big nose. It loves fun dreams.
flavorText.heartgold-soulsilver: If you think that you had a good dream but you can’t remember it, a DROWZEE has probably eaten it.
flavorText.black-white: It can tell what people are dreaming by sniffing with its big nose. It loves fun dreams.
flavorText.black-2-white-2: It can tell what people are dreaming by sniffing with its big nose. It loves fun dreams.
flavorText.x-y: Puts enemies to sleep, then eats their dreams. Occasionally gets sick from eating only bad dreams.
flavorText.omega-ruby-alpha-sapphire: If your nose becomes itchy while you are sleeping, it’s a sure sign that one of these Pokémon is standing above your pillow and trying to eat your dream through your nostrils.
flavorText.sun-moon: A Pokémon that nourishes itself by eating dreams, it is thought to share common ancestry with Munna and Musharna.
flavorText.ultra-sun-ultra-moon: It can be spotted near recreational facilities, intending to eat the pleasant dreams of children who enjoyed themselves there that day.
flavorText.lets-go-pikachu-eevee: If you sleep by it all the time, it will sometimes show you dreams it had eaten in the past.

flavorText.red-blue: When it locks eyes with an enemy, it will use a mix of PSI moves such as HYPNOSIS and CONFUSION.
flavorText.yellow: Avoid eye contact if you come across one. It will try to put you to sleep by using its pendulum.
flavorText.gold-silver: When it is very hungry, it puts humans it meets to sleep, then it feasts on their dreams.
flavorText.crystal: The longer it swings its pendulum, the longer the effects of its hypnosis last.
flavorText.ruby-sapphire: HYPNO holds a pendulum in its hand. The arcing movement and glitter of the pendulum lull the foe into a deep state of hypnosis. While this POKéMON searches for prey, it polishes the pendulum.
flavorText.emerald: The arcing movement and glitter of the pendulum in a HYPNO’s hand lull the foe into deep hypnosis. While searching for prey, it polishes the pendulum.
flavorText.firered-leafgreen: It carries a pendulum-like device. There once was an incident in which it took away a child it hypnotized.
flavorText.diamond-pearl: Seeing its swinging pendulum can induce sleep in three seconds, even in someone who just woke up.
flavorText.platinum: Seeing its swinging pendulum can induce sleep in three seconds, even in someone who just woke up.
flavorText.heartgold-soulsilver: When it is very hungry, it puts humans it meets to sleep, then it feasts on their dreams.
flavorText.black-white: Seeing its swinging pendulum can induce sleep in three seconds, even in someone who just woke up.
flavorText.black-2-white-2: Seeing its swinging pendulum can induce sleep in three seconds, even in someone who just woke up.
flavorText.x-y: It carries a pendulum-like device. There once was an incident in which it took away a child it hypnotized.
flavorText.omega-ruby-alpha-sapphire: Hypno holds a pendulum in its hand. The arcing movement and glitter of the pendulum lull the foe into a deep state of hypnosis. While this Pokémon searches for prey, it polishes the pendulum.
flavorText.sun-moon: While it is an extremely dangerous Pokémon, people who are in need of a good, sound sleep call it their savior.
flavorText.ultra-sun-ultra-moon: In Alola, Komala is Hypno’s main target. It rarely harms people.
flavorText.lets-go-pikachu-eevee: Avoid eye contact if you come across one. It will try to put you to sleep by using its pendulum.

flavorText.red-blue: Its pincers are not only powerful weapons, they are used for balance when walking sideways.
flavorText.yellow: Its pincers are superb weapons. They sometimes break off during battle, but they grow back fast.
flavorText.gold-silver: If it senses dan ger approaching, it cloaks itself with bubbles from its mouth so it will look bigger.
flavorText.crystal: If it is unable to find food, it will absorb nutrients by swallowing a mouthful of sand.
flavorText.ruby-sapphire: KRABBY live on beaches, burrowed inside holes dug into the sand. On sandy beaches with little in the way of food, these POKéMON can be seen squabbling with each other over territory.
flavorText.emerald: KRABBY live in holes dug into beaches. On sandy shores with little in the way of food, they can be seen squabbling with each other over territory.
flavorText.firered-leafgreen: It can be found near the sea. The large pincers grow back if they are torn out of their sockets.
flavorText.diamond-pearl: It lives in burrows dug on sandy beaches. Its pincers fully grow back if they are broken in battle.
flavorText.platinum: It lives in burrows dug on sandy beaches. Its pincers fully grow back if they are broken in battle.
flavorText.heartgold-soulsilver: If it senses danger approaching, it cloaks itself with bubbles from its mouth so it will look bigger.
flavorText.black-white: It lives in burrows dug on sandy beaches. Its pincers fully grow back if they are broken in battle.
flavorText.black-2-white-2: It lives in burrows dug on sandy beaches. Its pincers fully grow back if they are broken in battle.
flavorText.x-y: If it senses danger approaching, it cloaks itself with bubbles from its mouth so it will look bigger.
flavorText.omega-ruby-alpha-sapphire: Krabby live on beaches, burrowed inside holes dug into the sand. On sandy beaches with little in the way of food, these Pokémon can be seen squabbling with each other over territory.
flavorText.lets-go-pikachu-eevee: Its pincers are superb weapons. They sometimes break off during battle, but they grow back fast.
flavorText.sword-shield: It can be found near the sea. The large pincers grow back if they are torn out of their sockets.

flavorText.red-blue: The large pincer has 10000 hp of crushing power. However, its huge size makes it unwieldy to use.
flavorText.yellow: One claw grew massively and as hard as steel. It has 10,000-HP strength. However, it is too heavy.
flavorText.gold-silver: It can hardly lift its massive, overgrown pincer. The pincer's size makes it difficult to aim properly.
flavorText.crystal: Its oversized claw is very powerful, but when it's not in battle, the claw just gets in the way.
flavorText.ruby-sapphire: KINGLER has an enormous, oversized claw. It waves this huge claw in the air to communicate with others. However, because the claw is so heavy, the POKéMON quickly tires.
flavorText.emerald: It waves its huge, oversized claw in the air to communicate with others. But since the claw is so heavy, this POKéMON quickly tires.
flavorText.firered-leafgreen: Its large and hard pincer has 10,000- horsepower strength. However, being so big, it is unwieldy to move.
flavorText.diamond-pearl: The larger pincer has 10,000- horsepower strength. However, it is so heavy, it is difficult to aim.
flavorText.platinum: The larger pincer has 10,000- horsepower strength. However, it is so heavy, it is difficult to aim.
flavorText.heartgold-soulsilver: It can hardly lift its massive, overgrown pincer. The pincer’s size makes it difficult to aim properly.
flavorText.black-white: The larger pincer has 10,000- horsepower strength. However, it is so heavy, it is difficult to aim.
flavorText.black-2-white-2: The larger pincer has 10,000- horsepower strength. However, it is so heavy, it is difficult to aim.
flavorText.x-y: Its large and hard pincer has 10,000-horsepower strength. However, being so big, it is unwieldy to move.
flavorText.omega-ruby-alpha-sapphire: Kingler has an enormous, oversized claw. It waves this huge claw in the air to communicate with others. However, because the claw is so heavy, the Pokémon quickly tires.
flavorText.lets-go-pikachu-eevee: One claw grew massively and is as hard as steel. It has 10,000-horsepower strength. However, it is too heavy.
flavorText.sword-shield: Its large and hard pincer has 10,000-horsepower strength. However, being so big, it is unwieldy to move.

flavorText.red-blue: Usually found in power plants. Easily mistaken for a POKé BALL, they have zapped many people.
flavorText.yellow: It is said to camouflage itself as a POKé BALL. It will self-destruct with very little stimulus.
