flavorText.gold-silver: It rolls to move. If the ground is uneven, a sudden jolt from hitting a bump can cause it to explode.
flavorText.crystal: During the study of this POKéMON, it was discovered that its compo nents are not found in nature.
flavorText.ruby-sapphire: VOLTORB was first sighted at a company that manufactures POKé BALLS. The link between that sighting and the fact that this POKéMON looks very similar to a POKé BALL remains a mystery.
flavorText.emerald: It bears an uncanny and unexplained resemblance to a POKé BALL. Because it explodes at the slightest shock, even veteran TRAINERS treat it with caution.
flavorText.firered-leafgreen: A life-form whose identity is unknown. It is said to SCREECH or suddenly SELFDESTRUCT.
flavorText.diamond-pearl: It looks just like a Poké Ball. It is dangerous because it may electrocute or explode on touch.
flavorText.platinum: It looks just like a Poké Ball. It is dangerous because it may electrocute or explode on touch.
flavorText.heartgold-soulsilver: It rolls to move. If the ground is uneven, a sudden jolt from hitting a bump can cause it to explode.
flavorText.black-white: It looks just like a Poké Ball. It is dangerous because it may electrocute or explode on touch.
flavorText.black-2-white-2: It looks just like a Poké Ball. It is dangerous because it may electrocute or explode on contact.
flavorText.x-y: It was discovered when Poké Balls were introduced. It is said that there is some connection.
flavorText.omega-ruby-alpha-sapphire: Voltorb was first sighted at a company that manufactures Poké Balls. The link between that sighting and the fact that this Pokémon looks very similar to a Poké Ball remains a mystery.
flavorText.lets-go-pikachu-eevee: It is said to camouflage itself as a Poké Ball. It will self-destruct with very little stimulus.
flavorText.legends-arceus: An enigmatic Pokémon that happens to bear a resemblance to a Poké Ball. When excited, it discharges the electric current it has stored in its belly, then lets out a great, uproarious laugh.

flavorText.red-blue: It stores electric energy under very high pressure. It often explodes with little or no provocation.
flavorText.yellow: Stores electrical energy inside its body. Even the slightest shock could trigger a huge explosion.
flavorText.gold-silver: It is dangerous. If it has too much electricity and has nothing to do, it amuses itself by exploding.
flavorText.crystal: The more energy it charges up, the faster it gets. But this also makes it more likely to explode.
flavorText.ruby-sapphire: ELECTRODE eats electricity in the atmosphere. On days when lightning strikes, you can see this POKéMON exploding all over the place from eating too much electricity.
flavorText.emerald: They appear in great numbers at electric power plants. Because they feed on electricity, they cause massive and chaotic blackouts in nearby cities.
flavorText.firered-leafgreen: It explodes in response to even minor stimuli. It is feared, with the nickname of “The Bomb Ball.”
flavorText.diamond-pearl: It is known to drift on winds if it is bloated to bursting with stored electricity.
flavorText.platinum: It is known to drift on winds if it is bloated to bursting with stored electricity.
flavorText.heartgold-soulsilver: It is dangerous. If it has too much electricity and has nothing to do, it amuses itself by exploding.
flavorText.black-white: It is known to drift on winds if it is bloated to bursting with stored electricity.
flavorText.black-2-white-2: It is known to drift on winds if it is bloated to bursting with stored electricity.
flavorText.x-y: It explodes in response to even minor stimuli. It is feared, with the nickname of “The Bomb Ball.”
flavorText.omega-ruby-alpha-sapphire: Electrode eats electricity in the atmosphere. On days when lightning strikes, you can see this Pokémon exploding all over the place from eating too much electricity.
flavorText.lets-go-pikachu-eevee: Stores electrical energy inside its body. Even the slightest shock could trigger a huge explosion.
flavorText.legends-arceus: The tissue on the surface of its body is curiously similar in composition to an Apricorn. When irritated, this Pokémon lets loose an electric current equal to 20 lightning bolts.

flavorText.gold-silver: Using telepathy only they can receive, they always form a cluster of six EXEGGCUTE.
flavorText.red-blue: Often mistaken for eggs. When disturbed, they quickly gather and attack in swarms.
flavorText.yellow: The heads attract each other and spin around. There must be 6 heads for it to maintain balance.
flavorText.crystal: If even one is separated from the group, the energy bond between the six will make them rejoin instantly.
flavorText.ruby-sapphire: This POKéMON consists of six eggs that form a closely knit cluster. The six eggs attract each other and spin around. When cracks increasingly appear on the eggs, EXEGGCUTE is close to evolution.
flavorText.emerald: It consists of six eggs that care for each other. The eggs attract each other and spin around. When cracks increasingly appear, it is close to evolution.
flavorText.firered-leafgreen: Even though it appears to be eggs of some sort, it was discovered to be a life- form more like plant seeds.
flavorText.diamond-pearl: Its six eggs converse using telepathy. They can quickly gather if they become separated.
flavorText.platinum: Its six eggs converse using telepathy. They can quickly gather if they become separated.
flavorText.heartgold-soulsilver: Their shells are very durable. Even if they crack, they can survive without spilling their contents.
flavorText.black-white: Its six eggs converse using telepathy. They can quickly gather if they become separated.
flavorText.black-2-white-2: Its six eggs converse using telepathy. They can quickly gather if they become separated.
flavorText.x-y: Its six eggs converse using telepathy. They can quickly gather if they become separated.
flavorText.omega-ruby-alpha-sapphire: This Pokémon consists of six eggs that form a closely knit cluster. The six eggs attract each other and spin around. When cracks increasingly appear on the eggs, Exeggcute is close to evolution.
flavorText.sun-moon: Its six eggs use telepathy to communicate among themselves. It is believed to carry plant genes and the genes of other species.
flavorText.ultra-sun-ultra-moon: Six of them form a single Pokémon. Should one of the six be lost, the next morning there will once more be six.
flavorText.lets-go-pikachu-eevee: The heads attract each other and spin around. There must be six heads for it to maintain balance.
flavorText.sword-shield: Though it may look like it’s just a bunch of eggs, it’s a proper Pokémon. Exeggcute communicates with others of its kind via telepathy, apparently.

flavorText.red-blue: Legend has it that on rare occasions, one of its heads will drop off and continue on as an EXEGGCUTE.
flavorText.yellow: Its cries are very noisy. This is because each of the 3 heads thinks about whatever it likes.
flavorText.gold-silver: Its three heads think independent ly. However, they are friendly and never appear to squabble.
flavorText.crystal: Living in a good environment makes it grow lots of heads. A head that drops off becomes an EXEGGCUTE.
flavorText.ruby-sapphire: EXEGGUTOR originally came from the tropics. Its heads steadily grow larger from exposure to strong sunlight. It is said that when the heads fall off, they group together to form EXEGGCUTE.
flavorText.emerald: Originally from the tropics, EXEGGUTOR’s heads grow larger from exposure to strong sunlight. It is said that when the heads fall, they group to form an EXEGGCUTE.
flavorText.firered-leafgreen: It is called “The Walking Tropical Rainforest.” Each of the nuts has a face and a will of its own.
flavorText.diamond-pearl: It is called “The Walking Jungle.” If a head grows too big, it falls off and becomes an EXEGGCUTE.
flavorText.platinum: It is called “The Walking Jungle.” If a head grows too big, it falls off and becomes an EXEGGCUTE.
flavorText.heartgold-soulsilver: Its three heads think independently. However, they are friendly and never appear to squabble.
flavorText.black-white: It is called “The Walking Jungle.” If a head grows too big, it falls off and becomes an Exeggcute.
flavorText.black-2-white-2: It is called “The Walking Jungle.” If a head grows too big, it falls off and becomes an Exeggcute.
flavorText.x-y: Its three heads think independently. However, they are friendly and never appear to squabble.
flavorText.ultra-sun-ultra-moon: It engages its enemies using psychic powers. Each of its three heads fires off psychokinetic energy, tripling its power.
flavorText.omega-ruby-alpha-sapphire: Exeggutor originally came from the tropics. Its heads steadily grow larger from exposure to strong sunlight. It is said that when the heads fall off, they group together to form Exeggcute.
flavorText.sun-moon: Each of its heads has its own will. They use telepathy to discuss their plans before coming to a joint decision.
flavorText.lets-go-pikachu-eevee: Its cries are very noisy. This is because each of the three heads thinks about whatever it likes.
flavorText.sword-shield: Each of Exeggutor’s three heads is thinking different thoughts. The three don’t seem to be very interested in one another.

flavorText.red-blue: Because it never removes its skull helmet, no one has ever seen this POKéMON's real face.
flavorText.yellow: Wears the skull of its deceased mother. Its cries echo inside the skull and come out as a sad melody.
flavorText.gold-silver: If it is sad or lonely, the skull it wears shakes, and emits a plain tive and mournful sound.
flavorText.crystal: It lost its mother after its birth. It wears its mother's skull, never revealing its true face.
flavorText.ruby-sapphire: CUBONE pines for the mother it will never see again. Seeing a likeness of its mother in the full moon, it cries. The stains on the skull the POKéMON wears are made by the tears it sheds.
flavorText.emerald: It pines for the mother it will never see again. Seeing a likeness of its mother in the full moon, it cries. The stains on the skull it wears are from its tears.
flavorText.firered-leafgreen: It wears the skull of its dead mother on its head. When it becomes lonesome, it is said to cry loudly.
flavorText.diamond-pearl: When it thinks of its dead mother, it cries. Its crying makes the skull it wears rattle hollowly.
flavorText.platinum: When it thinks of its dead mother, it cries. Its crying makes the skull it wears rattle hollowly.
flavorText.heartgold-soulsilver: If it is sad or lonely, the skull it wears shakes and emits a plaintive and mournful sound.
flavorText.black-white: When it thinks of its dead mother, it cries. Its crying makes the skull it wears rattle hollowly.
flavorText.black-2-white-2: When it thinks of its dead mother, it cries. Its crying makes the skull it wears rattle hollowly.
flavorText.x-y: It wears the skull of its dead mother on its head. When it becomes lonesome, it is said to cry loudly.
flavorText.omega-ruby-alpha-sapphire: Cubone pines for the mother it will never see again. Seeing a likeness of its mother in the full moon, it cries. The stains on the skull the Pokémon wears are made by the tears it sheds.
flavorText.sun-moon: When it thinks of its deceased mother, it weeps loudly. Mandibuzz that hear its cries will attack it from the air.
flavorText.ultra-sun-ultra-moon: At night, it weeps loudly for its dead mother, but those cries only attract its natural enemy—Mandibuzz.
flavorText.lets-go-pikachu-eevee: Wears the skull of its deceased mother. Its cries echo inside the skull and come out as a sad melody.
flavorText.sword-shield: When the memory of its departed mother brings it to tears, its cries echo mournfully within the skull it wears on its head.

flavorText.red-blue: The bone it holds is its key weapon. It throws the bone skillfully like a boomerang to KO targets.
flavorText.yellow: Small and weak, this POKéMON is adept with its bone club. It has grown more vicious over the ages.
flavorText.gold-silver: It has been seen pounding boulders with the bone it carries in order to tap out mes sages to others.
flavorText.crystal: Somewhere in the world is a ceme tery just for MAROWAK. It gets its bones from those graves.
flavorText.ruby-sapphire: MAROWAK is the evolved form of a CUBONE that has overcome its sadness at the loss of its mother and grown tough. This POKéMON’s tempered and hardened spirit is not easily broken.
flavorText.emerald: A MAROWAK is the evolved form of a CUBONE that has grown tough by overcoming the grief of losing its mother. Its tempered and hardened spirit is not easily broken.
flavorText.firered-leafgreen: It is small and was originally very weak. Its temperament turned ferocious when it began using bones.
flavorText.diamond-pearl: From its birth, this savage Pokémon constantly holds bones. It is skilled in using them as weapons.
flavorText.platinum: From its birth, this savage Pokémon constantly holds bones. It is skilled in using them as weapons.
flavorText.heartgold-soulsilver: It has been seen pounding boulders with the bone it carries in order to tap out messages to others.
flavorText.black-white: From its birth, this savage Pokémon constantly holds bones. It is skilled in using them as weapons.
flavorText.black-2-white-2: From its birth, this savage Pokémon constantly holds bones. It is skilled in using them as weapons.
flavorText.x-y: It is small and was originally very weak. Its temperament turned ferocious when it began using bones.
flavorText.omega-ruby-alpha-sapphire: Marowak is the evolved form of a Cubone that has overcome its sadness at the loss of its mother and grown tough. This Pokémon’s tempered and hardened spirit is not easily broken.
flavorText.sun-moon: Originally, it was weak and timid. After evolution, its temperament becomes violent, and it begins to wield bones as weapons.
flavorText.ultra-sun-ultra-moon: It throws bones at Mandibuzz to knock it down. It’s thought that Marowak is trying to avenge its parent.
flavorText.lets-go-pikachu-eevee: Small and weak, this Pokémon is adept with its bone club. It has grown more vicious over the ages.
flavorText.sword-shield: This Pokémon overcame its sorrow to evolve a sturdy new body. Marowak faces its opponents bravely, using a bone as a weapon.

flavorText.red-blue: When in a hurry, its legs lengthen progressively. It runs smoothly with extra long, loping strides.
flavorText.yellow: When kicking, the sole of its foot turns as hard as a diamond on im pact and destroys its enemy.
flavorText.gold-silver: This amazing POKé MON has an awesome sense of balance. It can kick in succession from any position.
flavorText.crystal: It is also called the Kick Master. It uses its elastic legs to execute every known kick.
flavorText.ruby-sapphire: HITMONLEE’s legs freely contract and stretch. Using these springlike legs, it bowls over foes with devastating kicks. After battle, it rubs down its legs and loosens the muscles to overcome fatigue.
flavorText.emerald: Its legs freely stretch and contract. Using these springlike limbs, it bowls over foes with devastating kicks. After battle, it rubs down its tired legs.
flavorText.firered-leafgreen: The legs freely contract and stretch. The stretchy legs allow it to hit a distant foe with a rising kick.
flavorText.diamond-pearl: Its legs can stretch double. First-time foes are startled by its extensible reach.
flavorText.platinum: Its legs can stretch double. First-time foes are startled by its extensible reach.
flavorText.heartgold-soulsilver: This amazing Pokémon has an awesome sense of balance. It can kick in succession from any position.
flavorText.black-white: Its legs can stretch double. First-time foes are startled by its extensible reach.
flavorText.black-2-white-2: Its legs can stretch double. First-time foes are startled by its extensible reach.
flavorText.x-y: The legs freely contract and stretch. The stretchy legs allow it to hit a distant foe with a rising kick.
flavorText.omega-ruby-alpha-sapphire: Hitmonlee’s legs freely contract and stretch. Using these springlike legs, it bowls over foes with devastating kicks. After battle, it rubs down its legs and loosens the muscles to overcome fatigue.
flavorText.lets-go-pikachu-eevee: When kicking, the sole of its foot turns as hard as a diamond on impact and destroys its enemy.
flavorText.sword-shield: This amazing Pokémon has an awesome sense of balance. It can kick in succession from any position.

flavorText.diamond-pearl: The arm-twisting punches it throws pulverize even concrete. It rests after three minutes of fighting.
flavorText.red-blue: While apparently doing nothing, it fires punches in lightning fast volleys that are impossible to see.
flavorText.yellow: Punches in cork screw fashion. It can punch its way through a concrete wall in the same way as a drill.
flavorText.gold-silver: Its punches slice the air. However, it seems to need a short break after fighting for three minutes.
flavorText.crystal: To increase the strength of all its punch moves, it spins its arms just before making contact.
flavorText.ruby-sapphire: HITMONCHAN is said to possess the spirit of a boxer who had been working towards a world championship. This POKéMON has an indomitable spirit and will never give up in the face of adversity.
flavorText.emerald: A HITMONCHAN is said to possess the spirit of a boxer who aimed to become the world champion. Having an indomitable spirit means that it will never give up.
flavorText.firered-leafgreen: The spirit of a pro boxer has infused this POKéMON. It throws punches that are faster than a bullet train.
flavorText.platinum: The arm-twisting punches it throws pulverize even concrete. It rests after three minutes of fighting.
flavorText.heartgold-soulsilver: Its punches slice the air. However, it seems to need a short break after fighting for three minutes.
flavorText.black-white: The arm-twisting punches it throws pulverize even concrete. It rests after three minutes of fighting.
flavorText.black-2-white-2: The arm-twisting punches it throws pulverize even concrete. It rests after three minutes of fighting.
flavorText.x-y: The arm-twisting punches it throws pulverize even concrete. It rests after three minutes of fighting.
flavorText.omega-ruby-alpha-sapphire: Hitmonchan is said to possess the spirit of a boxer who had been working toward a world championship. This Pokémon has an indomitable spirit and will never give up in the face of adversity.
flavorText.lets-go-pikachu-eevee: Punches in corkscrew fashion. It can punch its way through a concrete wall like a drill.
flavorText.sword-shield: Its punches slice the air. They are launched at such high speed, even a slight graze could cause a burn.

flavorText.red-blue: Its tongue can be extended like a chameleon's. It leaves a tingling sensation when it licks enemies.
flavorText.yellow: Its tongue spans almost 7 feet and moves more freely than its forelegs. Its licks can cause paralysis.
flavorText.gold-silver: Its tongue has well-developed nerves that run to the very tip, so it can be deft ly manipulated.
flavorText.crystal: It has a tongue that is over 6’6’’ long. It uses this long tongue to lick its body clean.
flavorText.ruby-sapphire: Whenever LICKITUNG comes across something new, it will unfailingly give it a lick. It does so because it memorizes things by texture and by taste. It is somewhat put off by sour things.
flavorText.emerald: Whenever it sees something unfamiliar, it always licks the object because it memorizes things by texture and taste. It is somewhat put off by sour things.
flavorText.firered-leafgreen: Its tongue is twice the length of its body. It can be moved like an arm for grabbing food and attacking.
flavorText.diamond-pearl: Instead of hands, it uses its tongue, which is twice its height. Its sticky saliva grips anything.
flavorText.platinum: When it extends its over-six-foot- long tongue, its tail quivers. There is a possibility they are connected.
flavorText.heartgold-soulsilver: Its tongue has well-developed nerves that run to the very tip, so it can be deftly manipulated.
flavorText.black-white: When it extends its over-six-foot- long tongue, its tail quivers. There is a possibility they are connected.
flavorText.black-2-white-2: Being licked by its long, saliva-covered tongue leaves a tingling sensation. Extending its tongue retracts its tail.
flavorText.x-y: Its long tongue, slathered with a gooey saliva, sticks to anything, so it is very useful.
flavorText.omega-ruby-alpha-sapphire: Whenever Lickitung comes across something new, it will unfailingly give it a lick. It does so because it memorizes things by texture and by taste. It is somewhat put off by sour things.
flavorText.ultra-sun-ultra-moon: It checks out whatever’s around it by licking everything. If you don’t clean off a spot where it’s licked you, you’ll break out in a rash!
flavorText.lets-go-pikachu-eevee: Its tongue spans almost seven feet and moves more freely than its forelegs. Its licks can cause paralysis.
flavorText.sword-shield: If this Pokémon’s sticky saliva gets on you and you don’t clean it off, an intense itch will set in. The itch won’t go away, either.
flavorText.legends-arceus: Wields its long tongue deftly, as though it were an arm. The Pokémon's viscous saliva, once it has been collected and boiled down, yields a strong and highly useful adhesive.

flavorText.red-blue: Because it stores several kinds of toxic gases in its body, it is prone to exploding without warning.
flavorText.yellow: In hot places, its internal gases could expand and explode without any warning. Be very careful!
flavorText.gold-silver: Its thin, filmy body is filled with gases that cause constant sniffles, coughs and teary eyes.
flavorText.crystal: If one gets close enough to it when it expels poison ous gas, the gas swirling inside it can be seen.
flavorText.ruby-sapphire: If KOFFING becomes agitated, it raises the toxicity of its internal gases and jets them out from all over its body. This POKéMON may also overinflate its round body, then explode.
flavorText.emerald: Getting up close to a KOFFING will give you a chance to observe, through its thin skin, the toxic gases swirling inside. It blows up at the slightest stimulation.
flavorText.firered-leafgreen: Its thin, balloon-like body is inflated by horribly toxic gases. It reeks when it is nearby.
flavorText.diamond-pearl: Lighter-than-air gases in its body keep it aloft. The gases not only smell, they are also explosive.
flavorText.platinum: Lighter-than-air gases in its body keep it aloft. The gases not only smell, they are also explosive.
flavorText.heartgold-soulsilver: Its thin, filmy body is filled with gases that cause constant sniffles, coughs and teary eyes.
flavorText.black-white: Lighter-than-air gases in its body keep it aloft. The gases not only smell, they are also explosive.
flavorText.black-2-white-2: Toxic gas is held within its thin, balloon-shaped body, so it can cause massive explosions.
flavorText.x-y: Its thin, balloon-like body is inflated by horribly toxic gases. It reeks when it is nearby.
flavorText.omega-ruby-alpha-sapphire: If Koffing becomes agitated, it raises the toxicity of its internal gases and jets them out from all over its body. This Pokémon may also overinflate its round body, then explode.
flavorText.lets-go-pikachu-eevee: In hot places, its internal gases could expand and explode without any warning. Be very careful!
flavorText.sword-shield: Its body is full of poisonous gas. It floats into garbage dumps, seeking out the fumes of raw, rotting trash.

flavorText.red-blue: Where two kinds of poison gases meet, 2 KOFFINGs can fuse into a WEEZING over many years.
flavorText.yellow: It lives and grows by absorbing dust, germs and poison gases that are contained in toxic waste and garbage.
flavorText.gold-silver: If one of the twin KOFFING inflates, the other one deflates. It con stantly mixes its poisonous gases.
flavorText.crystal: When it inhales poisonous gases from garbage, its body expands, and its insides smell much worse.
flavorText.ruby-sapphire: WEEZING loves the gases given off by rotted kitchen garbage. This POKéMON will find a dirty, unkempt house and make it its home. At night, when the people in the house are asleep, it will go through the trash.
flavorText.emerald: By diluting its toxic gases with a special process, the highest grade of perfume can be extracted. To WEEZING, gases emanating from garbage are the ultimate feast.
flavorText.firered-leafgreen: Very rarely, a sudden mutation can result in two small KOFFING twins becoming conjoined as a WEEZING.
flavorText.diamond-pearl: It grows by feeding on gases released by garbage. Though very rare, triplets have been found.
flavorText.platinum: It grows by feeding on gases released by garbage. Though very rare, triplets have been found.
flavorText.heartgold-soulsilver: If one of the twin KOFFING inflates, the other one deflates. It constantly mixes its poisonous gases.
flavorText.black-white: It grows by feeding on gases released by garbage. Though very rare, triplets have been found.
flavorText.black-2-white-2: Inhaling toxic fumes from trash and mixing them inside its body lets it spread an even fouler stench.
flavorText.x-y: If one of the twin Koffing inflates, the other one deflates. It constantly mixes its poisonous gases.
flavorText.omega-ruby-alpha-sapphire: Weezing loves the gases given off by rotted kitchen garbage. This Pokémon will find a dirty, unkempt house and make it its home. At night, when the people in the house are asleep, it will go through the trash.
flavorText.lets-go-pikachu-eevee: This Pokémon lives and grows by absorbing poison gas, dust, and germs that exist inside garbage.
flavorText.sword-shield: It mixes gases between its two bodies. It’s said that these Pokémon were seen all over the Galar region back in the day.

flavorText.red-blue: Its massive bones are 1000 times harder than human bones. It can easily knock a trailer flying.
flavorText.yellow: A POKéMON with a one-track mind. Once it charges, it won't stop running until it falls asleep.
flavorText.gold-silver: It is inept at turning because of its four short legs. It can only charge and run in one direction.
flavorText.crystal: It can remember only one thing at a time. Once it starts rushing, it forgets why it started.
flavorText.ruby-sapphire: RHYHORN runs in a straight line, smashing everything in its path. It is not bothered even if it rushes headlong into a block of steel. This POKéMON may feel some pain from the collision the next day, however.
flavorText.emerald: Once it starts running, it doesn’t stop. Its tiny brain makes it so stupid that it can’t remember why it started running in the first place.
flavorText.firered-leafgreen: Strong, but not too bright, this POKéMON can shatter even a skyscraper with its charging TACKLES.
flavorText.diamond-pearl: Its body is clad in a thick hide, and its tackles topple buildings. Unfortunately, it is not smart.
flavorText.platinum: Its powerful tackles can destroy anything. However, it is too slow witted to help people work.
flavorText.heartgold-soulsilver: It is inept at turning because of its four short legs. It can only charge and run in one direction.
flavorText.black-white: Its powerful tackles can destroy anything. However, it is too slow witted to help people work.
flavorText.black-2-white-2: Its powerful tackles can destroy anything. However, it is too slow witted to help people work.
flavorText.x-y: Strong, but not too bright, this Pokémon can shatter even a skyscraper with its charging Tackles.
flavorText.omega-ruby-alpha-sapphire: Rhyhorn runs in a straight line, smashing everything in its path. It is not bothered even if it rushes headlong into a block of steel. This Pokémon may feel some pain from the collision the next day, however.
flavorText.lets-go-pikachu-eevee: A Pokémon with a one-track mind. Once it charges, it won’t stop running until it falls asleep.
flavorText.sword-shield: Strong, but not too bright, this Pokémon can shatter even a skyscraper with its charging tackles.
flavorText.legends-arceus: Ludicrously strong—when it butts heads with a mountain, it is the mountain that shatters. But its short legs struggle with turns, and it is incapable of stopping unless it collides with something.

flavorText.red-blue: Protected by an armor-like hide, it is capable of living in molten lava of 3,600 degrees.
flavorText.yellow: Walks on its hind legs. Shows signs of intelligence. Its armor-like hide even repels molten lava.
flavorText.gold-silver: Its rugged hide protects it from even the heat of lava. However, the hide also makes it insensitive.
flavorText.crystal: By lightly spin ning its drill- like horn, it can easily shatter even a diamond in the rough.
flavorText.ruby-sapphire: RHYDON’s horn can crush even uncut diamonds. One sweeping blow of its tail can topple a building. This POKéMON’s hide is extremely tough. Even direct cannon hits don’t leave a scratch.
flavorText.emerald: Its horn, which rotates like a drill, destroys tall buildings with one strike. It stands on its hind legs, and its brain is well developed.
flavorText.firered-leafgreen: It begins walking on its hind legs after evolution. It can punch holes through boulders with its horn.
flavorText.diamond-pearl: Its brain developed after it stood up on its hind legs. Its drill horn bores tunnels through solid rock.
flavorText.platinum: Standing on its hind legs freed its forelegs and made it smarter. It is very forgetful, however.
flavorText.heartgold-soulsilver: Its rugged hide protects it from even the heat of lava. However, the hide also makes it insensitive.
flavorText.black-white: Standing on its hind legs freed its forelegs and made it smarter. It is very forgetful, however.
flavorText.black-2-white-2: Standing on its hind legs freed its forelegs and made it smarter. It is very forgetful, however.
flavorText.x-y: Protected by an armor-like hide, it is capable of living in molten lava of 3,600 degrees Fahrenheit.
flavorText.omega-ruby-alpha-sapphire: Rhydon’s horn can crush even uncut diamonds. One sweeping blow of its tail can topple a building. This Pokémon’s hide is extremely tough. Even direct cannon hits don’t leave a scratch.
flavorText.lets-go-pikachu-eevee: Its brain developed when it began walking on its hind legs. Its armor-like hide even repels molten lava.
flavorText.sword-shield: It begins walking on its hind legs after evolution. It can punch holes through boulders with its horn.
flavorText.legends-arceus: Rapidly rotates its horn to bore through bedrock. It swaggers around volcanic regions, protected from the lava's heat by its tough, armorlike hide.

flavorText.red-blue: A rare and elusive POKéMON that is said to bring happiness to those who manage to get it.
flavorText.yellow: A gentle and kind hearted POKéMON that shares its nutritious eggs if it sees an injured POKéMON.
flavorText.gold-silver: It walks carefully to prevent its egg from breaking. However, it is extremely fast at running away.
flavorText.crystal: People try to catch it for its extremely nutritious eggs, but it rarely can be found.
flavorText.ruby-sapphire: CHANSEY lays nutritionally excellent eggs on an everyday basis. The eggs are so delicious, they are easily and eagerly devoured by even those people who have lost their appetite.
flavorText.emerald: CHANSEY lay nutritionally excellent eggs every day. The eggs are so delicious, they are eagerly devoured by even those people who have lost their appetite.
flavorText.firered-leafgreen: It lays several eggs a day. The eggs are apparently rich in nutrients and extremely delicious.
flavorText.diamond-pearl: It is said to deliver happiness. Being compassionate, it shares its eggs with injured people.
flavorText.platinum: A kindly Pokémon that lays highly nutritious eggs and shares them with injured Pokémon or people.
flavorText.heartgold-soulsilver: It walks carefully to prevent its egg from breaking. However, it is extremely fast at running away.
flavorText.black-white: A kindly Pokémon that lays highly nutritious eggs and shares them with injured Pokémon or people.
flavorText.black-2-white-2: A kindly Pokémon that lays highly nutritious eggs and shares them with injured Pokémon or people.
flavorText.x-y: It is said to deliver happiness. Being compassionate, it shares its eggs with injured people.
flavorText.omega-ruby-alpha-sapphire: Chansey lays nutritionally excellent eggs on an everyday basis. The eggs are so delicious, they are easily and eagerly devoured by even those people who have lost their appetite.
flavorText.sun-moon: The eggs laid by Chansey are rich in nutrients and a favorite food of many Pokémon.
flavorText.ultra-sun-ultra-moon: It seems that other Pokémon’s efforts to take its delicious, nutritious egg away from it caused Chansey to get faster at fleeing.
flavorText.lets-go-pikachu-eevee: A gentle and kindhearted Pokémon that shares its nutritious eggs if it sees an injured Pokémon.
flavorText.sword-shield: The egg Chansey carries is not only delicious but also packed with nutrition. It’s used as a high-class cooking ingredient.
flavorText.legends-arceus: This purehearted Pokémon shares its eggs with the injured.

flavorText.red-blue: The whole body is swathed with wide vines that are similar to sea weed. Its vines shake as it walks.
flavorText.yellow: Its identity is obscured by masses of thick, blue vines. The vines are said to never stop growing.
flavorText.gold-silver: The vines that cloak its entire body are always jiggling. They effectively un nerve its foes.
flavorText.crystal: During battle, it constantly moves the vines that cover its body in order to annoy its opponent.
flavorText.ruby-sapphire: TANGELA’s vines snap off easily if they are grabbed. This happens without pain, allowing it to make a quick getaway. The lost vines are replaced by newly grown vines the very next day.
flavorText.emerald: Its vines snap off easily and painlessly if they are grabbed, allowing it to make a quick getaway. The lost vines are replaced by new growth the very next day.
flavorText.firered-leafgreen: Blue plant vines cloak the POKéMON’s identity in a tangled mass. It entangles anything that gets close.
flavorText.diamond-pearl: It is shrouded by blue vines. No one has seen the face hidden behind this growth of vines.
flavorText.platinum: The blue vines shrouding its body are covered in a growth of fine hair. It is known to be ticklish.
flavorText.heartgold-soulsilver: The vines that cloak its entire body are always jiggling. They effectively unnerve its foes.
flavorText.black-white: The blue vines shrouding its body are covered in a growth of fine hair. It is known to be ticklish.
flavorText.black-2-white-2: Many writhing vines cover it, so its true identity remains unknown. The blue vines grow its whole life long.
flavorText.x-y: Many writhing vines cover it, so its true identity remains unknown. The blue vines grow its whole life long.
flavorText.omega-ruby-alpha-sapphire: Tangela’s vines snap off easily if they are grabbed. This happens without pain, allowing it to make a quick getaway. The lost vines are replaced by newly grown vines the very next day.
flavorText.lets-go-pikachu-eevee: Its identity is obscured by masses of thick blue vines. The vines are said to never stop growing.
flavorText.sword-shield: Hidden beneath a tangle of vines that grows nonstop even if the vines are torn off, this Pokémon’s true appearance remains a mystery.
flavorText.legends-arceus: It is cloaked entirely in blue vines, preventing any glimpse of its true identity. The vines impart a refreshing sensation when chewed—they're useful as a spice.

flavorText.red-blue: The infant rarely ventures out of its mother's protective pouch until it is 3 years old.
flavorText.yellow: Raises its young in its belly pouch. Won't run from any fight to keep its young protected.
flavorText.gold-silver: If it is safe, the young gets out of the belly pouch to play. The adult keeps a close eye on the youngster.
flavorText.crystal: To avoid crushing the baby it carries in its pouch, it always sleeps standing up.
flavorText.ruby-sapphire: If you come across a young KANGASKHAN playing by itself, you must never disturb it or attempt to catch it. The baby POKéMON’s parent is sure to be in the area, and it will become violently enraged at you.
flavorText.emerald: If you come across a young KANGASKHAN playing by itself, never try to catch it. The baby’s parent is sure to be in the area, and it will become violently enraged.
flavorText.firered-leafgreen: The female raises its offspring in a pouch on its belly. It is skilled at attacking using COMET PUNCH.
flavorText.diamond-pearl: It raises its offspring in its belly pouch. It lets the baby out to play only when it feels safe.
flavorText.platinum: It raises its offspring in its belly pouch. It lets the baby out to play only when it feels safe.
flavorText.heartgold-soulsilver: If it is safe, the young gets out of the belly pouch to play. The adult keeps a close eye on the youngster.
flavorText.black-white: It raises its offspring in its belly pouch. It lets the baby out to play only when it feels safe.
flavorText.black-2-white-2: It raises its offspring in its belly pouch. It lets the baby out to play only when it feels safe.
flavorText.x-y: It raises its offspring in its belly pouch. It lets the baby out to play only when it feels safe.
flavorText.omega-ruby-alpha-sapphire: If you come across a young Kangaskhan playing by itself, you must never disturb it or attempt to catch it. The baby Pokémon’s parent is sure to be in the area, and it will become violently enraged at you.
flavorText.sun-moon: Kangaskhan’s maternal love is so deep that it will brave death to protect its offspring.
flavorText.ultra-sun-ultra-moon: Kangaskhan protects its child by keeping it in its pouch. It has zero forgiveness for those who harm its child and will beat them down.
flavorText.lets-go-pikachu-eevee: Raises its young in its belly pouch. Won’t run from any fight to keep its young protected.
flavorText.sword-shield: Although it’s carrying its baby in a pouch on its belly, Kangaskhan is swift on its feet. It intimidates its opponents with quick jabs.

flavorText.red-blue: Known to shoot down flying bugs with precision blasts of ink from the surface of the water.
flavorText.yellow: If it senses any danger, it will vigorously spray water or a special type of ink from its mouth.
flavorText.gold-silver: If attacked by a larger enemy, it quickly swims to safety by adeptly controlling its dorsal fin.
flavorText.crystal: When they're in a safe location, they can be seen playfully tangling their tails together.
flavorText.ruby-sapphire: HORSEA eats small insects and moss off of rocks. If the ocean current turns fast, this POKéMON anchors itself by wrapping its tail around rocks or coral to prevent being washed away.
flavorText.emerald: By cleverly flicking the fins on its back side to side, it moves in any direction while facing forward. It spits ink to escape if it senses danger.
flavorText.firered-leafgreen: It maintains balance using its tail, which is wound up like a coil. It may spray ink from its mouth.
flavorText.diamond-pearl: It makes its nest in the shade of corals. If it senses danger, it spits murky ink and flees.
flavorText.platinum: It makes its nest in the shade of corals. If it senses danger, it spits murky ink and flees.
flavorText.heartgold-soulsilver: If attacked by a larger enemy, it quickly swims to safety by adeptly controlling its well-developed dorsal fin.
flavorText.black-white: It makes its nest in the shade of corals. If it senses danger, it spits murky ink and flees.
flavorText.black-2-white-2: It makes its nest in the shade of corals. If it senses danger, it spits murky ink and flees.
flavorText.x-y: Known to shoot down flying bugs with precision blasts of ink from the surface of the water.
flavorText.omega-ruby-alpha-sapphire: Horsea eats small insects and moss off of rocks. If the ocean current turns fast, this Pokémon anchors itself by wrapping its tail around rocks or coral to prevent being washed away.
flavorText.lets-go-pikachu-eevee: If it senses any danger, it will vigorously spray water or a special type of ink from its mouth.
flavorText.sword-shield: Horsea makes its home in oceans with gentle currents. If this Pokémon is under attack, it spits out pitch-black ink and escapes.

flavorText.red-blue: Capable of swim ming backwards by rapidly flapping its wing-like pectoral fins and stout tail.
flavorText.yellow: Touching the back fin causes numb ness. It hooks its tail to coral to stay in place while sleeping.
flavorText.gold-silver: An examination of its cells revealed the presence of a gene not found in HORSEA. It became a hot topic.
flavorText.crystal: The male raises the young. If it is approached, it uses its toxic spikes to fend off the intruder.
flavorText.ruby-sapphire: SEADRA sleeps after wriggling itself between the branches of coral. Those trying to harvest coral are occasionally stung by this POKéMON’s poison barbs if they fail to notice it.
flavorText.emerald: The poisonous barbs all over its body are highly valued as ingredients for making traditional herbal medicine. It shows no mercy to anything approaching its nest.
flavorText.firered-leafgreen: Its body bristles with sharp spikes. Carelessly trying to touch it could cause fainting from the spikes.
flavorText.diamond-pearl: Its spines provide protection. Its fins and bones are prized as traditional medicine ingredients.
flavorText.platinum: Its spines provide protection. Its fins and bones are prized as traditional medicine ingredients.
flavorText.heartgold-soulsilver: An examination of its cells revealed the presence of a gene not found in HORSEA. It became a hot topic.
flavorText.black-white: Its spines provide protection. Its fins and bones are prized as traditional medicine ingredients.
flavorText.black-2-white-2: Its spines provide protection. Its fins and bones are prized as traditional-medicine ingredients.
flavorText.x-y: Its body bristles with sharp spikes. Carelessly trying to touch it could cause fainting from the spikes.
flavorText.omega-ruby-alpha-sapphire: Seadra sleeps after wriggling itself between the branches of coral. Those trying to harvest coral are occasionally stung by this Pokémon’s poison barbs if they fail to notice it.
flavorText.lets-go-pikachu-eevee: Touching the back fin causes numbness. It hooks its tail to coral to stay in place while sleeping.
flavorText.sword-shield: It’s the males that raise the offspring. While Seadra are raising young, the spines on their backs secrete thicker and stronger poison.

flavorText.red-blue: Its tail fin billows like an elegant ballroom dress, giving it the nickname of the Water Queen.
flavorText.yellow: When it is time for them to lay eggs, they can be seen swimming up rivers and falls in large groups.
flavorText.gold-silver: Its dorsal, pecto ral and tail fins wave elegantly in water. That is why it is known as the water dancer.
flavorText.crystal: During spawning season, they swim gracefully in the water, searching for their perfect mate.
flavorText.ruby-sapphire: GOLDEEN is a very beautiful POKéMON with fins that billow elegantly in water. However, don’t let your guard down around this POKéMON - it could ram you powerfully with its horn.
flavorText.emerald: In the springtime, schools of GOLDEEN can be seen swimming up falls and rivers. It metes out staggering damage with its single horn.
flavorText.firered-leafgreen: Its dorsal and pectoral fins are strongly developed like muscles. It can swim at a speed of five knots.
flavorText.diamond-pearl: It swims elegantly by flittering its tail fin as if it were a dress. It has the look of a queen.
flavorText.platinum: Though it appears very elegant when swimming with fins unfurled, it can jab powerfully with its horn.
flavorText.heartgold-soulsilver: Its dorsal, pectoral and tail fins wave elegantly in water. That is why it is known as the water dancer.
flavorText.black-white: Though it appears very elegant when swimming with fins unfurled, it can jab powerfully with its horn.
flavorText.black-2-white-2: Though it appears very elegant when swimming with fins unfurled, it can jab powerfully with its horn.
flavorText.x-y: It swims at a steady 5 knots. If it senses danger, it will strike back with its sharp horn.
flavorText.omega-ruby-alpha-sapphire: Goldeen is a very beautiful Pokémon with fins that billow elegantly in water. However, don’t let your guard down around this Pokémon—it could ram you powerfully with its horn.
flavorText.sun-moon: When the weather grows warm, they form groups and swim upriver. This sight serves as a poetic reminder that spring has arrived.
flavorText.ultra-sun-ultra-moon: Although known for their splendid tail fins, Goldeen apparently compete among themselves to see whose horn is thickest and sharpest.
flavorText.lets-go-pikachu-eevee: When it is time for them to lay eggs, they can be seen swimming up rivers and falls in large groups.
flavorText.sword-shield: Its dorsal, pectoral, and tail fins wave elegantly in water. That is why it is known as the Water Dancer.

flavorText.black-2-white-2: In autumn, its body becomes more fatty in preparing to propose to a mate. It takes on beautiful colors.
flavorText.red-blue: In the autumn spawning season, they can be seen swimming power fully up rivers and creeks.
flavorText.yellow: It is the male's job to make a nest by carving out boulders in a stream using the horn on its head.
flavorText.gold-silver: During spawning season, SEAKING gather from all over, coloring the rivers a brilliant red.
flavorText.crystal: When autumn comes, the males patrol the area around their nests in order to protect their offspring.
flavorText.ruby-sapphire: In the autumn, SEAKING males can be seen performing courtship dances in riverbeds to woo females. During this season, this POKéMON’s body coloration is at its most beautiful.
flavorText.emerald: It punches holes in boulders on stream beds. This is a clever innovation that prevents its eggs from being attacked or washed away by the current.
flavorText.firered-leafgreen: The horn on its head is sharp like a drill. It bores a hole in a boulder to make its nest.
flavorText.diamond-pearl: It makes its nest by hollowing out boulders in streams with its horn. It defends its eggs with its life.
flavorText.platinum: In autumn, its body becomes more fatty in preparing to propose to a mate. It takes on beautiful colors.
flavorText.heartgold-soulsilver: During spawning season, SEAKING gather from all over, causing rivers to appear a brilliant red.
flavorText.black-white: In autumn, its body becomes more fatty in preparing to propose to a mate. It takes on beautiful colors.
flavorText.x-y: In the autumn spawning season, they can be seen swimming powerfully up rivers and creeks.
flavorText.omega-ruby-alpha-sapphire: In the autumn, Seaking males can be seen performing courtship dances in riverbeds to woo females. During this season, this Pokémon’s body coloration is at its most beautiful.
flavorText.sun-moon: When the weather grows cold, its whole body flushes a deep red. This sight serves as a poetic reminder that autumn has arrived.
flavorText.ultra-sun-ultra-moon: Its horn spins like a drill to steadily hollow out rocks—even harder ones. The coloration of the male is more vivid.
flavorText.lets-go-pikachu-eevee: It is the male’s job to make a nest by carving out boulders in a stream using the horn on its head.
flavorText.sword-shield: In autumn, its body becomes more fatty in preparing to propose to a mate. It takes on beautiful colors.

flavorText.red-blue: An enigmatic POKéMON that can effortlessly regenerate any appendage it loses in battle.
flavorText.yellow: As long as the center section is unharmed, it can grow back fully even if it is chopped to bits.
flavorText.gold-silver: At night, the cen ter of its body slowly flickers with the same rhythm as a human heartbeat.
flavorText.crystal: When the stars twinkle at night, it floats up from the sea floor, and its body's center core flickers.
flavorText.ruby-sapphire: STARYU’s center section has an organ called the core that shines bright red. If you go to a beach toward the end of summer, the glowing cores of these POKéMON look like the stars in the sky.
flavorText.emerald: It gathers with others in the night and makes its red core glow on and off with the twinkling stars. It can regenerate limbs if they are severed from its body.
flavorText.firered-leafgreen: It appears in large numbers by seashores. At night, its central core flashes with a red light.
flavorText.diamond-pearl: If its body is torn, it can grow back if the red core remains. The core flashes at midnight.
flavorText.platinum: If its body is torn, it can grow back if the red core remains. The core flashes at midnight.
flavorText.heartgold-soulsilver: At night, the middle of its body slowly flickers with the same rhythm as a human heartbeat.
flavorText.black-white: If its body is torn, it can grow back if the red core remains. The core flashes at midnight.
flavorText.black-2-white-2: As long as its red core remains, it can regenerate its body instantly, even if it’s torn apart.
flavorText.x-y: Even if its body is torn, it can regenerate as long as the glowing central core remains intact.
flavorText.omega-ruby-alpha-sapphire: Staryu’s center section has an organ called the core that shines bright red. If you go to a beach toward the end of summer, the glowing cores of these Pokémon look like the stars in the sky.
flavorText.sun-moon: Large numbers of these Pokémon make their home at the seaside. At night, a strange red glow radiates from the center of their bodies.
flavorText.ultra-sun-ultra-moon: In many places, there are folktales of stardust falling into the ocean and becoming Staryu.
flavorText.lets-go-pikachu-eevee: As long as the center section is unharmed, this Pokémon can grow back fully even if it is chopped to bits.
flavorText.sword-shield: If you visit a beach at the end of summer, you’ll be able to see groups of Staryu lighting up in a steady rhythm.

flavorText.red-blue: Its central core glows with the seven colors of the rainbow. Some people value the core as a gem.
flavorText.yellow: The center section is named the core. People think it is communicating when it glows in 7 colors.
flavorText.gold-silver: The center section of its body is called the core. It glows in a dif ferent color each time it is seen.
flavorText.crystal: It is said that it uses the seven- colored core of its body to send electric waves into outer space.
flavorText.ruby-sapphire: STARMIE’s center section - the core - glows brightly in seven colors. Because of its luminous nature, this POKéMON has been given the nickname “the gem of the sea.”
flavorText.emerald: People in ancient times imagined that STARMIE were transformed from the reflections of stars that twinkled on gentle waves at night.
flavorText.firered-leafgreen: This POKéMON has a geometric body. Because of its body, the locals suspect that it is an alien creature.
flavorText.diamond-pearl: At the center of its body is a red core, which sends mysterious radio signals into the night sky.
flavorText.platinum: At the center of its body is a red core, which sends mysterious radio signals into the night sky.
flavorText.heartgold-soulsilver: The middle section of its body is called the core. It glows in a different color each time it is seen.
flavorText.black-white: At the center of its body is a red core, which sends mysterious radio signals into the night sky.
flavorText.black-2-white-2: Its core shines in many colors and sends radio signals into space to communicate with something.
flavorText.x-y: Its central core glows with the seven colors of the rainbow. Some people value the core as a gem.
flavorText.omega-ruby-alpha-sapphire: Starmie’s center section—the core—glows brightly in seven colors. Because of its luminous nature, this Pokémon has been given the nickname “the gem of the sea.”
flavorText.sun-moon: Its shining core is thought to receive and transmit enigmatic signals. It has been known to cause headaches in those who approach it.
flavorText.ultra-sun-ultra-moon: Its sparkling core is called “the gem of the sea.” This core can be made into high-priced accessories that are traded in secret.
flavorText.lets-go-pikachu-eevee: The center section is named the core. People think it is communicating when it glows in seven colors.
flavorText.sword-shield: This Pokémon has an organ known as its core. The organ glows in seven colors when Starmie is unleashing its potent psychic powers.

flavorText.red-blue: If interrupted while it is miming, it will slap around the offender with its broad hands.
flavorText.yellow: Always practices its pantomime act. It makes enemies believe something exists that really doesn't.
flavorText.gold-silver: A skilled mime from birth, it gains the ability to create invisi ble objects as it matures.
flavorText.crystal: It uses the mysterious power it has in its fingers to solidify air into an invisible wall.
flavorText.ruby-sapphire: MR. MIME is a master of pantomime. Its gestures and motions convince watchers that something unseeable actually exists. Once it is believed, it will exist as if it were a real thing.
flavorText.emerald: A MR. MIME is a master of pantomime. It can convince others that something unseeable actually exists. Once believed, the imaginary object does become real.
flavorText.firered-leafgreen: It is adept at conning people. It is said to be able to create walls out of thin air by miming.
flavorText.diamond-pearl: It is a pantomime expert that can create invisible but solid walls using miming gestures.
flavorText.platinum: It shapes an invisible wall in midair by minutely vibrating its fingertips to stop molecules in the air.
flavorText.heartgold-soulsilver: A skilled mime from birth, it gains the ability to create invisible objects as it matures.
flavorText.black-white: It shapes an invisible wall in midair by minutely vibrating its fingertips to stop molecules in the air.
flavorText.black-2-white-2: It shapes an invisible wall in midair by minutely vibrating its fingertips to stop molecules in the air.
flavorText.x-y: Emanations from its fingertips solidify the air into invisible walls that repel even harsh attacks.
flavorText.omega-ruby-alpha-sapphire: Mr. Mime is a master of pantomime. Its gestures and motions convince watchers that something unseeable actually exists. Once the watchers are convinced, the unseeable thing exists as if it were real.
flavorText.ultra-sun-ultra-moon: Its pantomime skills are wonderful. You may become enraptured while watching it, but next thing you know, Mr. Mime has made a real wall.
flavorText.lets-go-pikachu-eevee: Always practicing its pantomime act. It makes enemies believe something exists that really doesn’t.
flavorText.sword-shield: The broadness of its hands may be no coincidence—many scientists believe its palms became enlarged specifically for pantomiming.
flavorText.legends-arceus: The behavior of this clown-like Pokémon reminds one of pantomime. It creates invisible walls using a force emitted from its fingertips.

flavorText.red-blue: With ninja-like agility and speed, it can create the illusion that there is more than one.
flavorText.yellow: Leaps out of tall grass and slices prey with its scythes. The move ment looks like that of a ninja.
flavorText.gold-silver: It slashes through grass with its sharp scythes, moving too fast for the human eye to track.
flavorText.crystal: It's very proud of its speed. It moves so fast that its opponent does not even know what knocked it down.
flavorText.ruby-sapphire: SCYTHER is blindingly fast. Its blazing speed enhances the effectiveness of the twin scythes on its forearms. This POKéMON’s scythes are so effective, they can slice through thick logs in one wicked stroke.
flavorText.emerald: Its blindingly fast speed adds to the sharpness of its twin forearm scythes. The scythes can slice through thick logs in one wicked stroke.
flavorText.firered-leafgreen: It tears and shreds prey with its wickedly sharp scythes. It very rarely spreads its wings to fly.
flavorText.diamond-pearl: It is nearly impossible to parry its attacking scythes. Its movements are like a ninja’s.
flavorText.platinum: The sharp scythes on its forearms become increasingly sharp by cutting through hard objects.
flavorText.heartgold-soulsilver: It slashes through grass with its sharp scythes, moving too fast for the human eye to track.
flavorText.black-white: The sharp scythes on its forearms become increasingly sharp by cutting through hard objects.
flavorText.black-2-white-2: The sharp scythes on its forearms become increasingly sharp by cutting through hard objects.
flavorText.x-y: It tears and shreds prey with its wickedly sharp scythes. It very rarely spreads its wings to fly.
flavorText.omega-ruby-alpha-sapphire: Scyther is blindingly fast. Its blazing speed enhances the effectiveness of the twin scythes on its forearms. This Pokémon’s scythes are so effective, they can slice through thick logs in one wicked stroke.
flavorText.sun-moon: It confuses its prey with its quick, ninja-like movements. Then, in an instant, it cleaves them with its scythes.
flavorText.ultra-sun-ultra-moon: Its two sharp scythes are more than just weapons. It uses them with dexterity to dress its prey before eating.
flavorText.lets-go-pikachu-eevee: Leaps out of tall grass and slices prey with its scythes. The movement looks like that of a ninja.
flavorText.sword-shield: As Scyther fights more and more battles, its scythes become sharper and sharper. With a single slice, Scyther can fell a massive tree.
flavorText.legends-arceus: The large, wickedly sharp scythes on its forearms are truly fearsome weapons. Prey's attempts to flee are unfailingly thwarted by this Pokémon's nimble motions.

flavorText.red-blue: It seductively wiggles its hips as it walks. It can cause people to dance in unison with it.
flavorText.yellow: Appears to move to a rhythm of its own, as if it were dancing. It wiggles its hips as it walks.
flavorText.gold-silver: It rocks its body rhythmically. It appears to alter the rhythm depend ing on how it is feeling.
flavorText.crystal: It has several different cry pat terns, each of which seems to have its own meaning.
flavorText.ruby-sapphire: JYNX walks rhythmically, swaying and shaking its hips as if it were dancing. Its motions are so bouncingly alluring, people seeing it are compelled to shake their hips without giving any thought to what they are doing.
flavorText.emerald: A JYNX sashays rhythmically as if it were dancing. Its motions are so bouncingly alluring, people seeing it are compelled to shake their hips without noticing.
flavorText.firered-leafgreen: It speaks using a language that sounds human. Research is under way to determine what is being said.
flavorText.diamond-pearl: Its cries sound like human speech. However, it is impossible to tell what it is trying to say.
flavorText.platinum: Its cries sound like human speech. However, it is impossible to tell what it is trying to say.
flavorText.heartgold-soulsilver: It rocks its body rhythmically. It appears to alter the rhythm depending on how it is feeling.
flavorText.black-white: Its cries sound like human speech. However, it is impossible to tell what it is trying to say.
flavorText.black-2-white-2: Its cries sound like human speech. However, it is impossible to tell what it is trying to say.
flavorText.x-y: It wiggles its hips as it walks. It can cause people to dance in unison with it.
flavorText.omega-ruby-alpha-sapphire: Jynx walks rhythmically, swaying and shaking its hips as if it were dancing. Its motions are so bouncingly alluring, people seeing it are compelled to shake their hips without giving any thought to what they are doing.
flavorText.ultra-sun-ultra-moon: It sways its hips to a rhythm all its own. The precise movements of Jynx living in Alola are truly wonderful.
flavorText.lets-go-pikachu-eevee: Appears to move to a rhythm of its own, as if it were dancing. It wiggles its hips as it walks.
flavorText.sword-shield: In certain parts of Galar, Jynx was once feared and worshiped as the Queen of Ice.

flavorText.red-blue: Normally found near power plants, they can wander away and cause major blackouts in cities.
flavorText.yellow: If a major power outage occurs, it is certain that this POKéMON has eaten electricity at a power plant.
flavorText.gold-silver: Electricity runs across the surface of its body. In darkness, its en tire body glows a whitish-blue.
flavorText.crystal: When two ELECTABUZZ touch, they control the electric currents to communicate their feelings.
flavorText.ruby-sapphire: When a storm arrives, gangs of this POKéMON compete with each other to scale heights that are likely to be stricken by lightning bolts. Some towns use ELECTABUZZ in place of lightning rods.
flavorText.emerald: When a storm approaches, it competes with others to scale heights that are likely to be stricken by lightning. Some towns use ELECTABUZZ in place of lightning rods.
flavorText.firered-leafgreen: It loves to feed on strong electricity. It occasionally appears around large power plants and so on.
flavorText.diamond-pearl: Half of all blackouts occur when this Pokémon appears at power plants and eats electricity.
flavorText.platinum: It windmills its arms to slightly boost its punches. Foes have been known to escape in the meantime.
flavorText.heartgold-soulsilver: Electricity runs across the surface of its body. In darkness, its entire body glows a whitish-blue.
flavorText.black-white: It windmills its arms to slightly boost its punches. Foes have been known to escape in the meantime.
flavorText.black-2-white-2: Research is progressing on storing lightning in Electabuzz so this energy can be used at any time.
flavorText.x-y: Electricity runs across the surface of its body. In darkness, its entire body glows a whitish blue.
flavorText.omega-ruby-alpha-sapphire: When a storm arrives, gangs of this Pokémon compete with each other to scale heights that are likely to be stricken by lightning bolts. Some towns use Electabuzz in place of lightning rods.
flavorText.sun-moon: Half of all sudden blackouts are caused by Electabuzz gathering at electric power plants and gobbling up electricity.
flavorText.ultra-sun-ultra-moon: Electricity permeates its body. It swings its arms round and round to charge up electricity before unleashing a punch.
flavorText.lets-go-pikachu-eevee: If a major power outage occurs, it is certain that this Pokémon has eaten electricity at a power plant.
flavorText.sword-shield: Many power plants keep Ground-type Pokémon around as a defense against Electabuzz that come seeking electricity.
flavorText.legends-arceus: Feeds on electrical energy. During sudden showers beneath looming thunderclouds, one can observe Electabuzz scaling tall trees, where the Pokémon will then wait for lightning to strike.

flavorText.red-blue: Its body always burns with an orange glow that enables it to hide perfectly among flames.
flavorText.yellow: Born in an active volcano. Its body is always cloaked in flames, so it looks like a big ball of fire.
flavorText.gold-silver: It dislikes cold places, so it blows scorching flames to make the environment suit able for itself.
flavorText.crystal: It moves more frequently in hot areas. It can heal itself by dipping its wound into lava.
flavorText.ruby-sapphire: In battle, MAGMAR blows out intensely hot flames from all over its body to intimidate its opponent. This POKéMON’s fiery bursts create heat waves that ignite grass and trees in its surroundings.
flavorText.emerald: In battle, it blows out intense flames from all over its body to intimidate its foe. These fiery bursts create heat waves that ignite grass and trees in the area.
flavorText.firered-leafgreen: Found near the mouth of a volcano. This fire-breather’s body temperature is nearly 2,200 degrees Fahrenheit.
flavorText.diamond-pearl: Born in the spout of a volcano, its body is covered by flames that shimmer like the sun.
flavorText.platinum: When it breathes deeply, heat waves form around its body, making it hard to see clearly.
flavorText.heartgold-soulsilver: It dislikes cold places, so it blows scorching flames to make the environment suitable for itself.
flavorText.black-white: When it breathes deeply, heat waves form around its body, making it hard to see clearly.
flavorText.black-2-white-2: The scorching fire exhaled by Magmar forms heat waves around its body, making it hard to see the Pokémon clearly.
flavorText.x-y: Found near the mouth of a volcano. This fire-breather’s body temperature is nearly 2,200 degrees Fahrenheit.
flavorText.omega-ruby-alpha-sapphire: In battle, Magmar blows out intensely hot flames from all over its body to intimidate its opponent. This Pokémon’s fiery bursts create heat waves that ignite grass and trees in its surroundings.
flavorText.sun-moon: When it’s tired, it leaps into the mouth of a volcano and soaks its body in magma to ease its weariness. Its body burns at 2,192 degrees F.
flavorText.ultra-sun-ultra-moon: Its entire body is burning. When it breathes, the temperature rises. When it sneezes, flames shoot out!
flavorText.lets-go-pikachu-eevee: Born in an active volcano. Its body is always cloaked in flames, so it looks like a big ball of fire.
flavorText.sword-shield: Magmar dispatches its prey with fire. But it regrets this habit once it realizes that it has burned its intended prey to a charred crisp.
flavorText.legends-arceus: Legend has it that this Pokémon was born from the crater of a volcano. When wounded, it bathes in lava to heal its body, much as one would soak in a hot spring.

flavorText.red-blue: If it fails to crush the victim in its pincers, it will swing it around and toss it hard.
flavorText.yellow: Grips its prey in its pincers and squeezes hard! It can't move if it's cold, so it lives in warm places.
flavorText.gold-silver: With its horns, it digs burrows to sleep in at night. In the morning, damp soil clings to its body.
flavorText.crystal: When the tempera ture drops at night, it sleeps on treetops or among roots where it is well hidden.
flavorText.ruby-sapphire: PINSIR is astoundingly strong. It can grip a foe weighing twice its weight in its horns and easily lift it. This POKéMON’s movements turn sluggish in cold places.
flavorText.emerald: Their pincers are strong enough to shatter thick logs. Because they dislike cold, PINSIR burrow and sleep under the ground on chilly nights.
flavorText.firered-leafgreen: Its two long pincer horns are powerful. Once they grip an enemy, they won’t release until the foe is torn.
flavorText.diamond-pearl: It grips prey with its pincers until the prey is torn in half. What it can’t tear, it tosses far.
flavorText.platinum: It grips prey with its pincers until the prey is torn in half. What it can’t tear, it tosses far.
flavorText.heartgold-soulsilver: With its pincer horns, it digs burrows to sleep in at night. In the morning, damp soil clings to its body.
flavorText.black-white: It grips prey with its pincers until the prey is torn in half. What it can’t tear, it tosses far.
flavorText.black-2-white-2: It grips prey with its powerful pincers and will not let go until the prey is torn in half.
flavorText.x-y: It grips prey with its pincers until the prey is torn in half. What it can’t tear, it tosses far.
flavorText.omega-ruby-alpha-sapphire: Pinsir is astoundingly strong. It can grip a foe weighing twice its weight in its horns and easily lift it. This Pokémon’s movements turn sluggish in cold places.
flavorText.sun-moon: It grips its prey in its pincers and splits them apart. Although it is a powerful Pokémon, it can’t deal with the cold.
flavorText.ultra-sun-ultra-moon: It gets into territorial disputes with Vikavolt. For some reason, it apparently gets along well with Heracross in Alola.
flavorText.lets-go-pikachu-eevee: Grips its prey in its pincers and squeezes hard! It can’t move if it’s cold out, so it lives in warm places.
flavorText.sword-shield: These Pokémon judge one another based on pincers. Thicker, more impressive pincers make for more popularity with the opposite gender.

flavorText.red-blue: When it targets an enemy, it charges furiously while whipping its body with its long tails.
flavorText.yellow: A rowdy POKéMON with a lot of stamina. Once running, it won't stop until it hits something.
flavorText.gold-silver: They fight each other by locking horns. The herd's protector takes pride in its bat tle-scarred horns.
flavorText.crystal: These violent POKéMON fight with other mem bers of their herd in order to prove their strength.
flavorText.ruby-sapphire: This POKéMON is not satisfied unless it is rampaging at all times. If there is no opponent for TAUROS to battle, it will charge at thick trees and knock them down to calm itself.
flavorText.emerald: It is not satisfied unless it is rampaging at all times. If there is no opponent for TAUROS to battle, it will charge at thick trees and knock them down to calm itself.
flavorText.firered-leafgreen: When it is about to TACKLE, it whips its body repeatedly with its three long tails.
flavorText.diamond-pearl: Once it takes aim at its foe, it makes a headlong charge. It is famous for its violent nature.
flavorText.platinum: Once it takes aim at its foe, it makes a headlong charge. It is famous for its violent nature.
flavorText.heartgold-soulsilver: They fight each other by locking horns. The herd’s protector takes pride in its battle-scarred horns.
flavorText.black-white: Once it takes aim at its foe, it makes a headlong charge. It is famous for its violent nature.
flavorText.black-2-white-2: Once it takes aim at its foe, it makes a headlong charge. It is famous for its violent nature.
flavorText.x-y: After heightening its will to fight by whipping itself with its three tails, it charges at full speed.
flavorText.omega-ruby-alpha-sapphire: This Pokémon is not satisfied unless it is rampaging at all times. If there is no opponent for Tauros to battle, it will charge at thick trees and knock them down to calm itself.
flavorText.sun-moon: Historically, people in areas all over the world have ridden Tauros, but the practice is said to have started in Alola.
flavorText.ultra-sun-ultra-moon: They live in groups. The one with the longest, thickest, and most-scarred horns is the boss of the herd.
flavorText.lets-go-pikachu-eevee: A rowdy Pokémon with a lot of stamina. Once running, it won’t stop until it hits something.
flavorText.sword-shield: When Tauros begins whipping itself with its tails, it’s a warning that the Pokémon is about to charge with astounding speed.

flavorText.red-blue: In the distant past, it was somewhat stronger than the horribly weak descendants that exist today.
flavorText.yellow: Famous for being very unreliable. It can be found swimming in seas, lakes, rivers and shallow puddles.
flavorText.gold-silver: An underpowered, pathetic POKéMON. It may jump high on rare occasions, but never more than seven feet.
flavorText.crystal: This weak and pathetic POKéMON gets easily pushed along rivers when there are strong currents.
flavorText.ruby-sapphire: MAGIKARP is a pathetic excuse for a POKéMON that is only capable of flopping and splashing. This behavior prompted scientists to undertake research into it.
flavorText.emerald: Its swimming muscles are weak, so it is easily washed away by currents. In places where water pools, you can see many MAGIKARP deposited there by the flow.
flavorText.firered-leafgreen: It is virtually worthless in terms of both power and speed. It is the most weak and pathetic POKéMON in the world.
flavorText.diamond-pearl: It is said to be the world’s weakest Pokémon. No one knows why it has managed to survive.
flavorText.platinum: A MAGIKARP living for many years can leap a mountain using Splash. The move remains useless, though.
flavorText.heartgold-soulsilver: An underpowered, pathetic Pokémon. It may jump high on rare occasions, but usually not more than seven feet.
flavorText.black-white: A Magikarp living for many years can leap a mountain using Splash. The move remains useless, though.
flavorText.black-2-white-2: A Magikarp living for many years can leap a mountain using Splash. The move remains useless, though.
flavorText.x-y: It is virtually worthless in terms of both power and speed. It is the most weak and pathetic Pokémon in the world.
flavorText.omega-ruby-alpha-sapphire: Magikarp is a pathetic excuse for a Pokémon that is only capable of flopping and splashing. This behavior prompted scientists to undertake research into it.
flavorText.sun-moon: Although weak and helpless, this Pokémon is incredibly fertile. They exist in such multitudes, you’ll soon grow tired of seeing them.
flavorText.ultra-sun-ultra-moon: In the distant past, they were fairly strong, but they have become gradually weaker over time.
flavorText.lets-go-pikachu-eevee: Famous for being very unreliable. It can be found swimming in seas, lakes, rivers, and shallow puddles.
flavorText.sword-shield: It is virtually worthless in terms of both power and speed. It is the most weak and pathetic Pokémon in the world.
flavorText.legends-arceus: A feeble, pitiful imbecile of a Pokémon that is nonetheless very hardy. Unperturbed by turbid water, it can be found living in all sorts of places.

flavorText.red-blue: Rarely seen in the wild. Huge and vicious, it is capable of destroying entire cities in a rage.
flavorText.yellow: Brutally vicious and enormously destructive. Known for totally destroying cities in ancient times.
flavorText.gold-silver: They say that during past wars, GYARADOS would appear and leave blazing ruins in its wake.
flavorText.crystal: It appears when ever there is world conflict, burning down any place it travels through.
flavorText.ruby-sapphire: When MAGIKARP evolves into GYARADOS, its brain cells undergo a structural transformation. It is said that this transformation is to blame for this POKéMON’s wildly violent nature.
flavorText.emerald: It is an extremely vicious and violent POKéMON. When humans begin to fight, it will appear and burn everything to the ground with intensely hot flames.
flavorText.firered-leafgreen: It has an extremely aggressive nature. The HYPER BEAM it shoots from its mouth totally incinerates all targets.
flavorText.diamond-pearl: Once it appears, its rage never settles until it has razed the fields and mountains around it.
flavorText.platinum: Once it begins to rampage, a GYARADOS will burn everything down, even in a harsh storm.
flavorText.heartgold-soulsilver: They say that during past strife, GYARADOS would appear and leave blazing ruins in its wake.
flavorText.black-white: Once it begins to rampage, a Gyarados will burn everything down, even in a harsh storm.
flavorText.black-2-white-2: Once it begins to rampage, a Gyarados will burn everything down, even in a harsh storm.
flavorText.x-y: In ancient literature, there is a record of a Gyarados that razed a village when violence flared.
flavorText.omega-ruby-alpha-sapphire: When Magikarp evolves into Gyarados, its brain cells undergo a structural transformation. It is said that this transformation is to blame for this Pokémon’s wildly violent nature.
flavorText.sun-moon: A tale is told of a town that angered Gyarados. Before the sun rose the next day, flames utterly consumed the town, leaving not a trace behind.
flavorText.ultra-sun-ultra-moon: It fires hyper beams in all directions, burning the surrounding area to ash. There are some regions where it’s called “the deity of destruction.”
flavorText.lets-go-pikachu-eevee: Brutally vicious and enormously destructive. Known for totally destroying cities in ancient times.
flavorText.sword-shield: It has an extremely aggressive nature. The Hyper Beam it shoots from its mouth totally incinerates all targets.
flavorText.legends-arceus: I suspect this Pokémon to be the true identity of a dragon written of in ancient texts, which claimed that it razed an entire village with white-hot beams from its maw.

flavorText.red-blue: A POKéMON that has been over hunted almost to extinction. It can ferry people across the water.
flavorText.yellow: A gentle soul that can read the minds of people. It can ferry people across the sea on its back.
flavorText.gold-silver: They have gentle hearts. Because they rarely fight, many have been caught. Their num ber has dwindled.
flavorText.crystal: This gentle POKéMON loves to give people rides and provides a ve ry comfortable way to get around.
flavorText.ruby-sapphire: People have driven LAPRAS almost to the point of extinction. In the evenings, this POKéMON is said to sing plaintively as it seeks what few others of its kind still remain.
flavorText.emerald: People have driven LAPRAS almost to the point of extinction. In the evenings, it is said to sing plaintively as it seeks what few others of its kind still remain.
flavorText.firered-leafgreen: Its high intelligence enables it to understand human speech. It likes to ferry people on its back.
flavorText.diamond-pearl: It loves crossing the sea with people and Pokémon on its back. It understands human speech.
flavorText.platinum: It loves crossing the sea with people and Pokémon on its back. It understands human speech.
flavorText.heartgold-soulsilver: They have gentle hearts. Because they rarely fight, many have been caught. Their number has dwindled.
flavorText.black-white: It loves crossing the sea with people and Pokémon on its back. It understands human speech.
flavorText.black-2-white-2: Able to understand human speech and very intelligent, it loves to swim in the sea with people on its back.
flavorText.x-y: They have gentle hearts. Because they rarely fight, many have been caught. Their number has dwindled.
flavorText.omega-ruby-alpha-sapphire: People have driven Lapras almost to the point of extinction. In the evenings, this Pokémon is said to sing plaintively as it seeks what few others of its kind still remain.
flavorText.sun-moon: Its high intelligence enables it to comprehend human speech. When it’s in a good mood, it sings in its beautiful voice.
flavorText.ultra-sun-ultra-moon: It likes swimming around with people on its back. In the Alola region, it’s an important means of transportation over water.
flavorText.lets-go-pikachu-eevee: A gentle soul that can understand human speech. It can ferry people across the sea on its back.
flavorText.sword-shield: A smart and kindhearted Pokémon, it glides across the surface of the sea while its beautiful song echoes around it.

flavorText.lets-go-pikachu-eevee: When it spots an enemy, its body transfigures into an almost-perfect copy of its opponent.
flavorText.red-blue: Capable of copying an enemy's genetic code to instantly transform itself into a duplicate of the enemy.
flavorText.yellow: When it spots an enemy, its body transfigures into an almost perfect copy of its oppo nent.
flavorText.gold-silver: It can transform into anything. When it sleeps, it changes into a stone to avoid being attacked.
flavorText.crystal: When it encount ers another DITTO, it will move faster than normal to duplicate that opponent exactly.
flavorText.ruby-sapphire: DITTO rearranges its cell structure to transform itself into other shapes. However, if it tries to transform itself into something by relying on its memory, this POKéMON manages to get details wrong.
flavorText.emerald: A DITTO rearranges its cell structure to transform itself. However, if it tries to change based on its memory, it will get details wrong.
flavorText.firered-leafgreen: It can freely recombine its own cellular structure to transform into other life- forms.
