flavorText.diamond-pearl: It has the ability to reconstitute its entire cellular structure to transform into whatever it sees.
flavorText.platinum: It has the ability to reconstitute its entire cellular structure to transform into whatever it sees.
flavorText.heartgold-soulsilver: It can transform into anything. When it sleeps, it changes into a stone to avoid being attacked.
flavorText.black-white: It has the ability to reconstitute its entire cellular structure to transform into whatever it sees.
flavorText.black-2-white-2: It can reconstitute its entire cellular structure to change into what it sees, but it returns to normal when it relaxes.
flavorText.x-y: It has the ability to reconstitute its entire cellular structure to transform into whatever it sees.
flavorText.omega-ruby-alpha-sapphire: Ditto rearranges its cell structure to transform itself into other shapes. However, if it tries to transform itself into something by relying on its memory, this Pokémon manages to get details wrong.
flavorText.sun-moon: It can reorganize its cells to make itself into a duplicate of anything it sees. The quality of the duplicate depends on the individual.
flavorText.ultra-sun-ultra-moon: While it can transform into anything, each Ditto apparently has its own strengths and weaknesses when it comes to transformations.
flavorText.sword-shield: It can reconstitute its entire cellular structure to change into what it sees, but it returns to normal when it relaxes.

flavorText.red-blue: Its genetic code is irregular. It may mutate if it is exposed to radiation from element STONEs.
flavorText.yellow: Its genetic code is unstable, so it could evolve in a variety of ways. There are only a few alive.
flavorText.gold-silver: It has the ability to alter the com position of its body to suit its surrounding envi ronment.
flavorText.crystal: Its ability to evolve into many forms allows it to adapt smoothly and perfectly to any environment.
flavorText.ruby-sapphire: EEVEE has an unstable genetic makeup that suddenly mutates due to the environment in which it lives. Radiation from various STONES causes this POKéMON to evolve.
flavorText.emerald: An EEVEE has an unstable genetic makeup that suddenly mutates due to its environment. Radiation from various STONES causes this POKéMON to evolve.
flavorText.firered-leafgreen: An extremely rare POKéMON that may evolve in a number of different ways depending on stimuli.
flavorText.diamond-pearl: A rare Pokémon that adapts to harsh environments by taking on different evolutionary forms.
flavorText.platinum: Because its genetic makeup is irregular, it quickly changes its form due to a variety of causes.
flavorText.heartgold-soulsilver: It has the ability to alter the composition of its body to suit its surrounding environment.
flavorText.black-white: Because its genetic makeup is irregular, it quickly changes its form due to a variety of causes.
flavorText.black-2-white-2: Thanks to its unstable genetic makeup, this special Pokémon conceals many different possible evolutions.
flavorText.x-y: A rare Pokémon that adapts to harsh environments by taking on different evolutionary forms.
flavorText.omega-ruby-alpha-sapphire: Eevee has an unstable genetic makeup that suddenly mutates due to the environment in which it lives. Radiation from various stones causes this Pokémon to evolve.
flavorText.sun-moon: Possessing an unbalanced and unstable genetic makeup, it conceals many possible evolutions.
flavorText.ultra-sun-ultra-moon: The question of why only Eevee has such unstable genes has still not been solved.
flavorText.lets-go-pikachu-eevee: It can evolve into a variety of forms. Eevee’s genes are the key to solving the mysteries of Pokémon evolution.
flavorText.sword-shield: It has the ability to alter the composition of its body to suit its surrounding environment.
flavorText.legends-arceus: Harbors the potential to evolve into manifold forms. Within Eevee lies the key to the mysteries of Pokémon evolution—I'm certain of it.

flavorText.red-blue: Lives close to water. Its long tail is ridged with a fin which is often mistaken for a mermaid's.
flavorText.yellow: Its cell structure is similar to water molecules. It will melt away and become invis ible in water.
flavorText.gold-silver: When VAPOREON's fins begin to vi brate, it is a sign that rain will come within a few hours.
flavorText.crystal: As it uses the fins on the tip of its tail to swim, it blends with the water perfectly.
flavorText.ruby-sapphire: VAPOREON underwent a spontaneous mutation and grew fins and gills that allow it to live underwater. This POKéMON has the ability to freely control water.
flavorText.emerald: VAPOREON underwent a spontaneous mutation and grew fins and gills that allow them to live underwater. They have the ability to freely control water.
flavorText.firered-leafgreen: Its body’s cellular structure is similar to the molecular composition of water. It can melt invisibly in water.
flavorText.diamond-pearl: It has evolved to be suitable for an aquatic life. It can invisibly melt away into water.
flavorText.platinum: Its cell composition is similar to water molecules. As a result, it can melt away into water.
flavorText.heartgold-soulsilver: When VAPOREON’s fins begin to vibrate, it is a sign that rain will come within a few hours.
flavorText.black-white: Its cell composition is similar to water molecules. As a result, it can melt away into water.
flavorText.black-2-white-2: Its cell composition is similar to water molecules. As a result, it can’t be seen when it melts away into water.
flavorText.x-y: It prefers beautiful shores. With cells similar to water molecules, it could melt in water.
flavorText.omega-ruby-alpha-sapphire: Vaporeon underwent a spontaneous mutation and grew fins and gills that allow it to live underwater. This Pokémon has the ability to freely control water.
flavorText.sun-moon: Its cells are composed of units much like water molecules. It lives close to water and is often mistaken for a mermaid.
flavorText.ultra-sun-ultra-moon: Clean, clear waters are its usual habitat. When it’s about to be attacked by an invading enemy, it dives into the water to hide.
flavorText.lets-go-pikachu-eevee: Its cell structure is similar to water molecules. It melts into the water and becomes invisible.
flavorText.sword-shield: When Vaporeon’s fins begin to vibrate, it is a sign that rain will come within a few hours.
flavorText.legends-arceus: Tests show that its cells closely resemble water molecules, which perhaps explains its ability to conceal its form while submerged. I believe the origins of mermaid folklore lie with this Pokémon.

flavorText.red-blue: It accumulates negative ions in the atmosphere to blast out 10000- volt lightning bolts.
flavorText.yellow: A sensitive POKé MON that easily becomes sad or angry. Every time its mood changes, it charges power.
flavorText.gold-silver: It concentrates the weak electric charges emitted by its cells and launches wicked lightning bolts.
flavorText.crystal: The negatively charged ions generated in its fur create a constant sparking noise.
flavorText.ruby-sapphire: JOLTEON’s cells generate a low level of electricity. This power is amplified by the static electricity of its fur, enabling the POKéMON to drop thunderbolts. The bristling fur is made of electrically charged needles.
flavorText.emerald: Its cells generate weak power that is amplified by its fur’s static electricity to drop thunderbolts. The bristling fur is made of electrically charged needles.
flavorText.firered-leafgreen: If it is angered or startled, the fur all over its body bristles like sharp needles that pierce foes.
flavorText.diamond-pearl: It controls 10,000-volt power and can raise all the fur on its body as if it were sharp needles.
flavorText.platinum: If agitated, it uses electricity to straighten out its fur and launch it in small bunches.
flavorText.heartgold-soulsilver: It concentrates the weak electric charges emitted by its cells and launches wicked lightning bolts.
flavorText.black-white: If agitated, it uses electricity to straighten out its fur and launch it in small bunches.
flavorText.black-2-white-2: By storing electricity in its body, it can shoot its bristlelike fur like a barrage of missiles.
flavorText.x-y: Every hair on its body starts to stand sharply on end if it becomes charged with electricity.
flavorText.omega-ruby-alpha-sapphire: Jolteon’s cells generate a low level of electricity. This power is amplified by the static electricity of its fur, enabling the Pokémon to drop thunderbolts. The bristling fur is made of electrically charged needles.
flavorText.sun-moon: They send out electrical charges of about 10,000 volts. Because they are high-strung, it can be difficult to grow close to them.
flavorText.ultra-sun-ultra-moon: Its lungs contain an organ that creates electricity. The crackling sound of electricity can be heard when it exhales.
flavorText.lets-go-pikachu-eevee: A sensitive Pokémon that easily becomes sad or angry. Every time its mood changes, it charges power.
flavorText.sword-shield: If it is angered or startled, the fur all over its body bristles like sharp needles that pierce foes.
flavorText.legends-arceus: Bristles its fur into sharp, needlelike points when enraged. One can hear electricity crackle in its breath when it exhales.

flavorText.red-blue: When storing thermal energy in its body, its temperature could soar to over 1600 degrees.
flavorText.yellow: It has a flame chamber inside its body. It inhales, then blows out fire that is over 3,000F degrees.
flavorText.gold-silver: It stores some of the air it inhales in its internal flame pouch, which heats it to over 3,000 degrees.
flavorText.crystal: Once it has stored up enough heat, this POKéMON's body temperature can reach up to 1700 degrees.
flavorText.ruby-sapphire: FLAREON’s fluffy fur has a functional purpose - it releases heat into the air so that its body does not get excessively hot. This POKéMON’s body temperature can rise to a maximum of 1,650 degrees F.
flavorText.emerald: FLAREON’s fluffy fur releases heat into the air so that its body does not get excessively hot. Its body temperature can rise to a maximum of 1,650 degrees F.
flavorText.firered-leafgreen: It has a flame bag inside its body. After inhaling deeply, it blows out flames of nearly 3,100 degrees Fahrenheit.
flavorText.diamond-pearl: It has a flame sac in its body. Its body temperature tops 1,650 degrees Fahrenheit before battle.
flavorText.platinum: Inhaled air is heated in the flame sac in its body to an intense fire over 3,000 degrees Fahrenheit.
flavorText.heartgold-soulsilver: It stores some of the air it inhales in its internal flame pouch, which heats it to over 3,000 degrees Fahrenheit.
flavorText.black-white: Inhaled air is heated in the flame sac in its body to an intense fire over 3,000 degrees Fahrenheit.
flavorText.black-2-white-2: Inhaled air is carried to its flame sac, heated, and exhaled as fire that reaches over 3,000 degrees F.
flavorText.x-y: It has a flame sac in its body. Its body temperature tops 1,650 degrees Fahrenheit before battle.
flavorText.omega-ruby-alpha-sapphire: Flareon’s fluffy fur has a functional purpose—it releases heat into the air so that its body does not get excessively hot. This Pokémon’s body temperature can rise to a maximum of 1,650 degrees Fahrenheit.
flavorText.sun-moon: When it catches prey or finds berries, it breathes fire on them until they’re well done, and then it gobbles them up.
flavorText.ultra-sun-ultra-moon: If it inhales deeply, that’s a sign it’s about to attack. Prepare to be hit by flames of over 3,000 degrees Fahrenheit!
flavorText.lets-go-pikachu-eevee: It has a flame chamber inside its body. It inhales, then breathes out fire that is over 3,000 degrees Fahrenheit.
flavorText.sword-shield: Once it has stored up enough heat, this Pokémon’s body temperature can reach up to 1,700 degrees Fahrenheit.
flavorText.legends-arceus: Flames burn within a saclike organ inside this Pokémon. When Flareon inhales, these flames grow in intensity, reaching a mighty 3,000 degrees Fahrenheit.

flavorText.red-blue: A POKéMON that consists entirely of programming code. Capable of moving freely in cyberspace.
flavorText.yellow: The only POKéMON people anticipate can fly into space. None has managed the feat yet, however.
flavorText.gold-silver: It is a manmade POKéMON. Since it doesn't breathe, people are eager to try it in any environment.
flavorText.crystal: An artificial POKéMON created due to extensive research, it can perform only what is in its program.
flavorText.ruby-sapphire: PORYGON is capable of reverting itself entirely back to program data and entering cyberspace. This POKéMON is copy-protected so it cannot be duplicated by copying.
flavorText.emerald: It is capable of reverting itself entirely back to program data in order to enter cyberspace. A PORYGON is copy- protected so it cannot be duplicated.
flavorText.firered-leafgreen: Using the most advanced technologies, scientists finally succeeded in making the first artificial POKéMON.
flavorText.diamond-pearl: The world’s first artificially created Pokémon. It can travel through electronic space.
flavorText.platinum: A man-made Pokémon created using advanced scientific means. It can move freely in cyberspace.
flavorText.heartgold-soulsilver: It is a manmade Pokémon. Since it doesn’t breathe, people are eager to try it in any environment.
flavorText.black-white: A man-made Pokémon created using advanced scientific means. It can move freely in cyberspace.
flavorText.black-2-white-2: A man-made Pokémon created using advanced scientific means. It can move freely in cyberspace.
flavorText.x-y: A man-made Pokémon that came about as a result of research. It is programmed with only basic motions.
flavorText.omega-ruby-alpha-sapphire: Porygon is capable of reverting itself entirely back to program data and entering cyberspace. This Pokémon is copy protected so it cannot be duplicated by copying.
flavorText.sun-moon: Roughly 20 years ago, it was artificially created, utilizing the latest technology of the time.
flavorText.ultra-sun-ultra-moon: This Pokémon was created using the cutting-edge science of 20 years ago, so many parts of it have since become obsolete.
flavorText.lets-go-pikachu-eevee: The only Pokémon that people anticipate can fly into space. None has managed the feat yet, however.
flavorText.sword-shield: State-of-the-art technology was used to create Porygon. It was the first artificial Pokémon to be created via computer programming.
flavorText.legends-arceus: It has no discernible heartbeat and does not seem to draw breath, and yet it appears to function without issue. I cannot even begin to explain this utterly bizarre anomaly.

flavorText.red-blue: Although long extinct, in rare cases, it can be genetically resurrected from fossils.
flavorText.yellow: An ancient POKéMON that was recovered from a fossil. It swims by cleverly twisting its 10 tentacles about.
flavorText.gold-silver: Revived from an ancient fossil, this POKéMON uses air stored in its shell to sink and rise in water.
flavorText.crystal: In prehistoric times, it swam on the sea floor, eating plankton. Its fossils are sometimes found.
flavorText.ruby-sapphire: OMANYTE is one of the ancient and long- since-extinct POKéMON that have been regenerated from fossils by people. If attacked by an enemy, it withdraws itself inside its hard shell.
flavorText.emerald: One of the ancient and long-since-extinct POKéMON that have been regenerated from fossils by humans. If attacked, it withdraws into its hard shell.
flavorText.firered-leafgreen: A prehistoric POKéMON that lived in the primordial sea, it swims by twisting its 10 tentacles about.
flavorText.diamond-pearl: A Pokémon that was resurrected from a fossil using modern science. It swam in ancient seas.
flavorText.platinum: A Pokémon that was resurrected from a fossil using modern science. It swam in ancient seas.
flavorText.heartgold-soulsilver: Revived from an ancient fossil, this Pokémon uses air stored in its shell to sink and rise in water.
flavorText.black-white: A Pokémon that was resurrected from a fossil using modern science. It swam in ancient seas.
flavorText.black-2-white-2: A Pokémon that was resurrected from a fossil using modern science. It swam in ancient seas.
flavorText.x-y: A prehistoric Pokémon that lived in the primordial sea, it swims by twisting its 10 tentacles about.
flavorText.omega-ruby-alpha-sapphire: Omanyte is one of the ancient and long-since-extinct Pokémon that have been regenerated from fossils by people. If attacked by an enemy, it withdraws itself inside its hard shell.
flavorText.ultra-sun-ultra-moon: Omanyte lived in the seas of antiquity. Its fossils have been found bearing bite marks from Archeops, so apparently Archeops preyed on it.

flavorText.sword-shield: Because some Omanyte manage to escape after being restored or are released into the wild by people, this species is becoming a problem.

flavorText.red-blue: A prehistoric POKéMON that died out when its heavy shell made it impossible to catch prey.
flavorText.yellow: Sharp beaks ring its mouth. Its shell was too big for it to move freely, so it became extinct.
flavorText.gold-silver: Apparently, it cracked SHELLDER's shell with its sharp fangs and sucked out the insides.
flavorText.crystal: Its heavy shell allowed it to reach only nearby food. This could be the reason it is extinct.
flavorText.ruby-sapphire: OMASTAR uses its tentacles to capture its prey. It is believed to have become extinct because its shell grew too large and heavy, causing its movements to become too slow and ponderous.
flavorText.emerald: An OMASTAR uses its tentacles to capture its prey. It is believed to have become extinct because its shell grew too large, making its movements slow and ponderous.
flavorText.firered-leafgreen: Its tentacles are highly developed as if they are hands and feet. As soon as it ensnares prey, it bites.
flavorText.diamond-pearl: It is thought that this Pokémon became extinct because its spiral shell grew too large.
flavorText.platinum: It is thought that this Pokémon became extinct because its spiral shell grew too large.
flavorText.heartgold-soulsilver: Apparently, it cracked SHELLDER’s shell with its sharp fangs and sucked out the insides.
flavorText.black-white: It is thought that this Pokémon became extinct because its spiral shell grew too large.

flavorText.x-y: Its tentacles are highly developed as if they are hands and feet. As soon as it ensnares prey, it bites.
flavorText.omega-ruby-alpha-sapphire: Omastar uses its tentacles to capture its prey. It is believed to have become extinct because its shell grew too large and heavy, causing its movements to become too slow and ponderous.
flavorText.ultra-sun-ultra-moon: Its heavy shell is thought to be the reason this ancient Pokémon died out. It’s apparently a distant ancestor of Octillery.
flavorText.lets-go-pikachu-eevee: Its sharp beak rings its mouth. Its shell was too big for it to move freely, so it became extinct.
flavorText.sword-shield: Weighed down by a large and heavy shell, Omastar couldn’t move very fast. Some say it went extinct because it was unable to catch food.

flavorText.red-blue: A POKéMON that was resurrected from a fossil found in what was once the ocean floor eons ago.
flavorText.yellow: A POKéMON that was recovered from a fossil. It uses the eyes on its back while hiding on the sea floor.
flavorText.gold-silver: On rare occasions, some have been found as fossils which they became while hiding on the ocean floor.
flavorText.crystal: Three hundred million years ago, it hid on the sea floor. It also has eyes on its back that glow.
flavorText.ruby-sapphire: KABUTO is a POKéMON that has been regenerated from a fossil. However, in extremely rare cases, living examples have been discovered. The POKéMON has not changed at all for 300 million years.
flavorText.emerald: It is a POKéMON that has been regenerated from a fossil. However, in rare cases, living examples have been discovered. KABUTO have not changed for 300 million years.
flavorText.firered-leafgreen: This POKéMON was regenerated from the fossil of an ancient creature. It protects itself with a hard shell.
flavorText.diamond-pearl: It is thought to have inhabited beaches 300 million years ago. It is protected by a stiff shell.
flavorText.platinum: It is thought to have inhabited beaches 300 million years ago. It is protected by a stiff shell.
flavorText.heartgold-soulsilver: On rare occasions, some have been found as fossils which they became while hiding on the ocean floor.

flavorText.ultra-sun-ultra-moon: This Pokémon thrived 300 million years ago. It’s said that living specimens can still be seen in a certain region—a rare sight.
flavorText.lets-go-pikachu-eevee: A Pokémon that was recovered from a fossil. It used the eyes on its back while hiding on the seafloor.
flavorText.sword-shield: This species is almost entirely extinct. Kabuto molt every three days, making their shells harder and harder.
Kabutops slices its prey apart and sucks out the fluids. The discarded body parts become food for other Pokémon.
flavorText.red-blue: Its sleek shape is perfect for swim ming. It slashes prey with its claws and drains the body fluids.
flavorText.yellow: A slim and fast swimmer. It slices its prey with its sharp sickles and drinks the body fluids.
flavorText.gold-silver: In the water, it tucks in its limbs to become more compact, then it wiggles its shell to swim fast.
flavorText.crystal: It was able to swim quickly thro ugh the water by compactly folding up its razor-sharp sickles.
flavorText.ruby-sapphire: KABUTOPS swam underwater to hunt for its prey in ancient times. The POKéMON was apparently evolving from being a water-dweller to living on land as evident from the beginnings of change in its gills and legs.
flavorText.emerald: KABUTOPS once swam underwater to hunt for prey. It was apparently evolving from being a water dweller to living on land as evident from changes in its gills and legs.
flavorText.firered-leafgreen: It swims freely through water. It catches prey with its scythe-like arms and drains the victim’s fluids.
flavorText.diamond-pearl: It is thought that this Pokémon came onto land because its prey adapted to life on land.
flavorText.platinum: It is thought that this Pokémon came onto land because its prey adapted to life on land.
flavorText.heartgold-soulsilver: In the water, it tucks in its limbs to become more compact, then it wiggles its shell to swim fast.

flavorText.ultra-sun-ultra-moon: Its body had begun to change so it could function on land. But it didn’t adapt in time and went extinct.
flavorText.lets-go-pikachu-eevee: A slim and fast swimmer. It sliced its prey with its sharp sickles and drank the body fluids.

flavorText.red-blue: A ferocious, pre historic POKéMON that goes for the enemy's throat with its serrated saw-like fangs.
flavorText.yellow: A savage POKéMON that died out in ancient times. It was resurrected using DNA taken from amber.
flavorText.gold-silver: A vicious POKéMON from the distant past, it appears to have flown by spreading its wings and gliding.
flavorText.crystal: In prehistoric times, this POKéMON flew freely and fearlessly through the skies.
flavorText.ruby-sapphire: AERODACTYL is a POKéMON from the age of dinosaurs. It was regenerated from genetic material extracted from amber. It is imagined to have been the king of the skies in ancient times.
flavorText.emerald: AERODACTYL is a POKéMON from the age of dinosaurs. It was regenerated from DNA extracted from amber. It is imagined to have been the king of the skies.
flavorText.firered-leafgreen: It was regenerated from a dinosaur’s genetic matter that was found in amber. It flies with high-pitched cries.
flavorText.diamond-pearl: A Pokémon that roamed the skies in the dinosaur era. Its teeth are like saw blades.
flavorText.platinum: A Pokémon that roamed the skies in the dinosaur era. Its teeth are like saw blades.
flavorText.heartgold-soulsilver: A vicious Pokémon from the distant past, it appears to have flown by spreading its wings and gliding.
flavorText.black-white: A Pokémon that roamed the skies in the dinosaur era. Its teeth are like saw blades.

flavorText.sun-moon: A Pokémon from the age of the dinosaurs. It used its sawlike fangs to shred its prey before eating them.
flavorText.ultra-sun-ultra-moon: Restored from DNA found in amber, this Pokémon exhibited ferocity that was greater than expected. Some casualties resulted.
flavorText.lets-go-pikachu-eevee: A savage Pokémon that died out in ancient times. It was resurrected using DNA taken from amber.
flavorText.sword-shield: This is a ferocious Pokémon from ancient times. Apparently even modern technology is incapable of producing a perfectly restored specimen.

flavorText.red-blue: Very lazy. Just eats and sleeps. As its rotund bulk builds, it becomes steadily more slothful.
flavorText.yellow: Will eat anything, even if the food happens to be a little moldy. It never gets an upset stomach.
flavorText.gold-silver: What sounds like its cry may ac tually be its snores or the rumblings of its hungry belly.
flavorText.crystal: This POKéMON's stomach is so strong, even eating moldy or rotten food will not affect it.
flavorText.ruby-sapphire: SNORLAX’s typical day consists of nothing more than eating and sleeping. It is such a docile POKéMON that there are children who use its expansive belly as a place to play.
flavorText.emerald: SNORLAX’s typical day consists of nothing more than eating and sleeping. It is such a docile POKéMON that there are children who use its big belly as a place to play.
flavorText.firered-leafgreen: It is not satisfied unless it eats over 880 pounds of food every day. When it is done eating, it goes promptly to sleep.
flavorText.diamond-pearl: Its stomach can digest any kind of food, even if it happens to be moldy or rotten.
flavorText.platinum: When its belly is full, it becomes too lethargic to even lift a finger, so it is safe to bounce on its belly.
flavorText.heartgold-soulsilver: What sounds like its cry may actually be its snores or the rumblings of its hungry belly.
flavorText.black-white: When its belly is full, it becomes too lethargic to even lift a finger, so it is safe to bounce on its belly.
flavorText.black-2-white-2: When its belly is full, it becomes too lethargic to even lift a finger, so it is safe to bounce on its belly.

flavorText.omega-ruby-alpha-sapphire: Snorlax’s typical day consists of nothing more than eating and sleeping. It is such a docile Pokémon that there are children who use its expansive belly as a place to play.
flavorText.sun-moon: Its stomach is said to be incomparably strong. Even Muk’s poison is nothing more than a hint of spice on Snorlax’s tongue.
flavorText.ultra-sun-ultra-moon: It doesn’t do anything other than eat and sleep. When prompted to make a serious effort, though, it apparently displays awesome power.
flavorText.lets-go-pikachu-eevee: Will eat anything, even if the food happens to be a little moldy. It never gets an upset stomach.
flavorText.sword-shield: It is not satisfied unless it eats over 880 pounds of food every day. When it is done eating, it goes promptly to sleep.
flavorText.legends-arceus: This glutton appears in villages without warning and devours the entirety of their rice granaries—such occurrences have long been counted among the gravest of disasters.

flavorText.yellow: A legendary bird POKéMON. It freezes water that is contained in winter air and makes it snow.
flavorText.gold-silver: The magnificent, seemingly translu cent wings of this legendary bird POKéMON are said to be made of ice.
flavorText.crystal: Legendary bird POKéMON. As it flies through the sky, it cools the air, causing snow to fall.
flavorText.ruby-sapphire: ARTICUNO is a legendary bird POKéMON that can control ice. The flapping of its wings chills the air. As a result, it is said that when this POKéMON flies, snow will fall.
flavorText.emerald: ARTICUNO is a legendary bird POKéMON that can control ice. The flapping of its wings chills the air. As a result, it is said that when this POKéMON flies, snow will fall.
flavorText.firered-leafgreen: One of the legendary bird POKéMON. With its long tail trailing behind, its flying form is magnificent.
flavorText.diamond-pearl: A legendary bird Pokémon. It can create blizzards by freezing moisture in the air.
flavorText.platinum: A legendary bird Pokémon. It can create blizzards by freezing moisture in the air.
flavorText.heartgold-soulsilver: The magnificent, seemingly translucent wings of this legendary bird Pokémon are said to be made of ice.
flavorText.black-white: A legendary bird Pokémon. It can create blizzards by freezing moisture in the air.
flavorText.black-2-white-2: A legendary bird Pokémon. It can create blizzards by freezing moisture in the air.

flavorText.lets-go-pikachu-eevee: A legendary bird Pokémon. It freezes water that is contained in winter air and makes it snow.
flavorText.sword-shield: It’s said that this Pokémon’s beautiful blue wings are made of ice. Articuno flies over snowy mountains, its long tail fluttering along behind it.

flavorText.red-blue: A legendary bird POKéMON that is said to appear from clouds while dropping enormous lightning bolts.
flavorText.yellow: This legendary bird POKéMON is said to appear when the sky turns dark and lightning showers down.
flavorText.gold-silver: This legendary bird POKéMON causes savage thunderstorms by flapping its glit tering wings.
flavorText.crystal: Legendary bird POKéMON. They say lightning caused by the flapping of its wings causes summer storms.
flavorText.ruby-sapphire: ZAPDOS is a legendary bird POKéMON that has the ability to control electricity. It usually lives in thunderclouds. The POKéMON gains power if it is stricken by lightning bolts.
flavorText.emerald: ZAPDOS is a legendary bird POKéMON that has the ability to control electricity. It usually lives in thunderclouds. It gains power if it is stricken by lightning bolts.
flavorText.firered-leafgreen: One of the legendary bird POKéMON. While it is flying, it makes crackling and snapping sounds.
flavorText.diamond-pearl: A legendary Pokémon that is said to live in thunderclouds. It freely controls lightning bolts.
flavorText.platinum: A legendary Pokémon that is said to live in thunderclouds. It freely controls lightning bolts.
flavorText.heartgold-soulsilver: This legendary bird Pokémon causes savage thunderstorms by flapping its glittering wings.
flavorText.black-white: A legendary Pokémon that is said to live in thunderclouds. It freely controls lightning bolts.
flavorText.black-2-white-2: A legendary Pokémon that is said to live in thunderclouds. It freely controls lightning bolts.
flavorText.x-y: A legendary bird Pokémon that is said to appear from clouds while dropping enormous lightning bolts.

flavorText.lets-go-pikachu-eevee: This legendary bird Pokémon is said to appear when the sky turns dark and lightning showers down.
flavorText.sword-shield: This Pokémon has complete control over electricity. There are tales of Zapdos nesting in the dark depths of pitch-black thunderclouds.

flavorText.red-blue: Known as the legendary bird of fire. Every flap of its wings creates a dazzling flash of flames.
flavorText.yellow: A legendary bird POKéMON. As it flaps its flaming wings, even the night sky will turn red.
flavorText.gold-silver: This legendary POKéMON scatters embers with every flap of its wings. It is a thrilling sight to behold.
flavorText.crystal: Legendary bird POKéMON. It is said to migrate from the south along with the spring.
flavorText.ruby-sapphire: MOLTRES is a legendary bird POKéMON that has the ability to control fire. If this POKéMON is injured, it is said to dip its body in the molten magma of a volcano to burn and heal itself.
flavorText.emerald: MOLTRES is a legendary bird POKéMON that can control fire. If injured, it is said to dip its body in the molten magma of a volcano to burn and heal itself.
flavorText.firered-leafgreen: One of the legendary bird POKéMON. Those seeing it are overwhelmed by its orange wings that seem to be on fire.
flavorText.diamond-pearl: One of the legendary bird Pokémon. It is said that its appearance indicates the coming of spring.
flavorText.platinum: One of the legendary bird Pokémon. It is said that its appearance indicates the coming of spring.
flavorText.heartgold-soulsilver: This legendary Pokémon scatters embers with every flap of its wings. It is a thrilling sight to behold.
flavorText.black-white: One of the legendary bird Pokémon. It is said that its appearance indicates the coming of spring.
flavorText.black-2-white-2: One of the legendary bird Pokémon. It is said that its appearance indicates the coming of spring.
flavorText.x-y: It is said to be the legendary bird Pokémon of fire. Every flap of its wings creates a dazzling flare of flames.
flavorText.omega-ruby-alpha-sapphire: Moltres is a legendary bird Pokémon that has the ability to control fire. If this Pokémon is injured, it is said to dip its body in the molten magma of a volcano to burn and heal itself.

flavorText.sword-shield: It’s one of the legendary bird Pokémon. When Moltres flaps its flaming wings, they glimmer with a dazzling red glow.

flavorText.red-blue: Long considered a mythical POKéMON until recently when a small colony was found living underwater.
flavorText.yellow: The existence of this mythical POKéMON was only recently confirmed by a fisherman who caught one.
flavorText.gold-silver: It is born large to start with. It repeatedly sheds its skin as it steadily grows longer.
flavorText.crystal: It sheds many lay ers of skin as it grows larger. Dur ing this process, it is protected by a rapid waterfall.
flavorText.ruby-sapphire: DRATINI continually molts and sloughs off its old skin. It does so because the life energy within its body steadily builds to reach uncontrollable levels.
flavorText.emerald: A DRATINI continually molts and sloughs off its old skin. It does so because the life energy within its body steadily builds to reach uncontrollable levels.
flavorText.firered-leafgreen: Even the young can exceed 6.5 feet in length. It grows larger by repeatedly shedding skin.
flavorText.diamond-pearl: It is called the “Mirage Pokémon” because so few have seen it. Its shed skin has been found.
flavorText.platinum: It is called the “Mirage Pokémon” because so few have seen it. Its shed skin has been found.
flavorText.heartgold-soulsilver: It is born large to start with. It repeatedly sheds its skin as it steadily grows longer.
flavorText.black-white: It is called the “Mirage Pokémon” because so few have seen it. Its shed skin has been found.
flavorText.black-2-white-2: It is called the “Mirage Pokémon” because so few have seen it. Its shed skin has been found.
flavorText.x-y: It is called the “Mirage Pokémon” because so few have seen it. Its shed skin has been found.
flavorText.omega-ruby-alpha-sapphire: Dratini continually molts and sloughs off its old skin. It does so because the life energy within its body steadily builds to reach uncontrollable levels.
flavorText.sun-moon: It grows by molting repeatedly. Boots made from the tanned cast-off skin are a super luxury item.
flavorText.ultra-sun-ultra-moon: It’s still weak, so it lurks on the floor of bodies of water, eating whatever food sinks down and living a quiet life.
flavorText.lets-go-pikachu-eevee: Long thought to be a myth, this Pokémon’s existence was only recently confirmed by a fisherman who caught one.
flavorText.sword-shield: Dratini dwells near bodies of rapidly flowing water, such as the plunge pools of waterfalls. As it grows, Dratini will shed its skin many times.

flavorText.red-blue: A mystical POKéMON that exudes a gentle aura. Has the ability to change climate conditions.
flavorText.yellow: According to a witness, its body was surrounded by a strange aura that gave it a mystical look.
flavorText.gold-silver: They say that if it emits an aura from its whole body, the weather will begin to change instantly.
flavorText.crystal: It is called the divine POKéMON. When its entire body brightens slightly, the weather changes.
flavorText.ruby-sapphire: DRAGONAIR stores an enormous amount of energy inside its body. It is said to alter weather conditions in its vicinity by discharging energy from the crystals on its neck and tail.
flavorText.emerald: A DRAGONAIR stores an enormous amount of energy inside its body. It is said to alter the weather around it by loosing energy from the crystals on its neck and tail.
flavorText.firered-leafgreen: It is said to live in seas and lakes. Even though it has no wings, it has been seen flying occasionally.
flavorText.diamond-pearl: If its body takes on an aura, the weather changes instantly. It is said to live in seas and lakes.
flavorText.platinum: If its body takes on an aura, the weather changes instantly. It is said to live in seas and lakes.
flavorText.heartgold-soulsilver: They say that if it emits an aura from its whole body, the weather will begin to change instantly.
flavorText.black-white: If its body takes on an aura, the weather changes instantly. It is said to live in seas and lakes.
flavorText.black-2-white-2: If its body takes on an aura, the weather changes instantly. It is said to live in seas and lakes.
flavorText.x-y: Its crystalline orbs appear to give this Pokémon the power to freely control the weather.
flavorText.omega-ruby-alpha-sapphire: Dragonair stores an enormous amount of energy inside its body. It is said to alter weather conditions in its vicinity by discharging energy from the crystals on its neck and tail.
flavorText.sun-moon: It has long been thought that its crystalline orbs are imbued with the power to control the weather.
flavorText.ultra-sun-ultra-moon: Lakes where Dragonair live are filled with offerings from people, because they believe this Pokémon is able to control the weather.
flavorText.lets-go-pikachu-eevee: According to a witness, its body was surrounded by a strange aura that gave it a mystical look.
flavorText.sword-shield: This Pokémon lives in pristine oceans and lakes. It can control the weather, and it uses this power to fly into the sky, riding on the wind.
